StandardTimeUnits.name: Standard Time Units
StandardTimeUnits.def: For reason or reasons unknown to members of the Galaxy at the time of the era under discussion, Intergalactic Standard Time defines its fundamental unit, the second, as the time in which light travels 299,776 kilometers.

SundayIsBoring.name: Sunday is Boring
SundayIsBoring.def: Tracey: I hate the Sunday papers.

TakeYourTime.name: Take Your Time
TakeYourTime.def: A video game's plot establishes that the day must be saved within a time limit, but the actual game has no time limit and allows the player to take much longer to complete it if desired.

TemporalTrio.name: Temporal Trio
TemporalTrio.def: Shadow the Hedgehog: I will release you from the chains of your past!

ThousandYearReign.name: Thousand-Year Reign
ThousandYearReign.def: This is when someone boasts or predicts that a particular organization or accomplishment will endure for (at least) a certain amount of time, the prediction usually being wildly optimistic and incurring a high risk of Tempting Fate .

TimeAbyss.name: Time Abyss
TimeAbyss.def: A being who is much older than all recorded history.

TimeBomb.name: Time Bomb
TimeBomb.def: A bomb set to automatically detonate after a countdown has ended.

TimeCapsule.name: Time Capsule
TimeCapsule.def: By the time you get this note We'll no longer be alive We'll have all gone up in smoke There'll be no way to reply You'll be wondering about the world that vanished long ago And the words that reach you now That were buried underground — They Might Be Giants , "By The Time You Get This"

TimeCompressionMontage.name: Time-Compression Montage
TimeCompressionMontage.def: Jamie: We've filled 2 pontoons, it goes about 3 minutes a fill, we've got 48 yet to go.

TimedMission.name: Timed Mission
TimedMission.def: A goal must be reached quickly !

TimeFreezeTrollingSpree.name: Time-Freeze Trolling Spree
TimeFreezeTrollingSpree.def: Someone freezes time or takes advantage of time being frozen so they can play pranks on people without the risk of getting caught.

TimeIsDangerous.name: Time Is Dangerous
TimeIsDangerous.def: Harry took Paper-2 in his trembling hand, and unfolded it.

TimeMaster.name: Time Master
TimeMaster.def: Someone who has the power to manipulate time at will.

TimeSkip.name: Time Skip
TimeSkip.def: A sequel or continuation that takes place a specific amount of time after the original.

TimeStandsStill.name: Time Stands Still
TimeStandsStill.def: Someone or something causes time to freeze and everyone around them to become motionless.

TimeZonesDoNotExist.name: Time Zones Do Not Exist
TimeZonesDoNotExist.def: When a world logically should have different time zones, yet none are shown or mentioned.

TimeZoneTroubles.name: Time Zone Troubles
TimeZoneTroubles.def: Characters being in different time zones or having to shift between time zones causes issues.

UnnecessaryTimePrecision.name: Unnecessary Time Precision
UnnecessaryTimePrecision.def: Doing complicated time calculations just to say that the date requested is very recent.

WeaponRunningTime.name: Weapon Running Time
WeaponRunningTime.def: A projectile's time to hit its target is long enough for things to happen.

WeWait.name: We Wait
WeWait.def: Characters must wait for their enemy to fall into a trap.

WhenThePlanetsAlign.name: When the Planets Align
WhenThePlanetsAlign.def: A prison so big it requires eight keys.

WorldInStandby.name: World in Standby
WorldInStandby.def: During special events, time in the outside world stops for all people.

AYearAndADay.name: A Year and a Day
AYearAndADay.def: I'll sit and mourn all at her grave For a twelvemonth and a day.

YearInsideHourOutside.name: Year Inside, Hour Outside
YearInsideHourOutside.def: A long time in an alternate reality is only a short time in the regular universe.

YearOutsideHourInside.name: Year Outside, Hour Inside
YearOutsideHourInside.def: A short time in an alternate reality is much, much longer in the regular universe.

AgainstMyReligion.name: Against My Religion
AgainstMyReligion.def: Someone refuses to do something because they claim it goes against their religious beliefs.

AllHailTheGreatGodMickey.name: All Hail the Great God Mickey!
AllHailTheGreatGodMickey.def: When secular pop-culture icons become worshiped like gods.

AngelsDevilsAndSquid.name: Angels, Devils and Squid
AngelsDevilsAndSquid.def: Heaven versus Hell versus ... Lovecraftian cosmic horrors ?

AngelUnaware.name: Angel Unaware
AngelUnaware.def: An angel, deity, or similar being masquerades as a regular mortal in order to test people's goodwill.

AnimalReligion.name: Animal Religion
AnimalReligion.def: When non-human beasts develop religious beliefs.

AnswerToPrayers.name: Answer to Prayers
AnswerToPrayers.def: A character prays, and gets results.

ApocalypseCult.name: Apocalypse Cult
ApocalypseCult.def: A religious movement which is centered around the observance of a doomsday prophecy .

AppeaseTheVolcanoGod.name: Appease the Volcano God
AppeaseTheVolcanoGod.def: A Human Sacrifice is thrown into a volcano to appease the volcano god.

ArtisticLicenseReligion.name: Artistic License – Religion
ArtisticLicenseReligion.def: A work of fiction features an inaccurate portrayal of real-life religion.

BadHabits.name: Bad Habits
BadHabits.def: When villains disguise themselves as clergy.

BaldMystic.name: Bald Mystic
BaldMystic.def: Draws greatly from the practice of tonsure, so religious mystical characters are often bald.

BeliefMakesYouStupid.name: Belief Makes You Stupid
BeliefMakesYouStupid.def: A story portrays people with religious beliefs as being dumb and gullible.

BlasphemousBoast.name: Blasphemous Boast
BlasphemousBoast.def: Someone brags about themselves in a way that insults a deity.

BlasphemousPraise.name: Blasphemous Praise
BlasphemousPraise.def: Someone compliments another person in a way that insults a deity.

BloodStainedGlassWindows.name: Blood-Stained Glass Windows
BloodStainedGlassWindows.def: A fight occurs in a church or cathedral.

BookBurning.name: Book Burning
BookBurning.def: The physical desecration of literature, which may be done as an act of religiously motivated censorship (or protest).

BoringReligiousService.name: Boring Religious Service
BoringReligiousService.def: Religious services are presented as dull or tedious.

BurningAnEffigy.name: Burning an Effigy
BurningAnEffigy.def: Burning or destroying a representative effigy for spiritual cleansing or an offering.

TheCardinalVirtues.name: The Cardinal Virtues
TheCardinalVirtues.def: Allegories of the virtues on the façade of La Rochelle city hall.

CargoCult.name: Cargo Cult
CargoCult.def: A religion which worships an inanimate object that is mistaken for a deity or divine artifact.

CaughtUpInTheRapture.name: Caught Up in the Rapture
CaughtUpInTheRapture.def: Those who didn't get Left Behind .

TheChurch.name: The Church
TheChurch.def: A religious organization with centralized authority (especially, but not limited to, many various Christian denominations).

ChurchgoingVillain.name: Churchgoing Villain
ChurchgoingVillain.def: A bad guy who is devoutly religious despite their sinful lifestyle.

ChurchLady.name: Church Lady
ChurchLady.def: A female character is noted for her involvement in her local religious community.

ChurchOfHappyology.name: Church of Happyology
ChurchOfHappyology.def: A not-so-subtle parody of Scientology (a new religious movement founded by L. Ron Hubbard ).

ConfessInConfidence.name: Confess in Confidence
ConfessInConfidence.def: Mason Verger: I'm sure she's told you horrible things that I've done.

ConvertingForLove.name: Converting for Love
ConvertingForLove.def: Changing one's religious beliefs to match those of their romantic partner or spouse.

CorruptChurch.name: Corrupt Church
CorruptChurch.def: A religious organization that is run by hypocritical , self-serving priests .

CrossMeltingAura.name: Cross-Melting Aura
CrossMeltingAura.def: Some demons are so powerful that holy objects have little or no effect on them.

Cult.name: Cult
Cult.def: A minor religious sect, often relatively new, that doesn't get along very well with nonbelievers or mainstream society. The term "cult" is usually used with a negative connotation to refer to religions that are (considered to be) morally bankrupt.

CultDefector.name: Cult Defector
CultDefector.def: Someone who rebels against their brainwashing by a religious cult.

CulturallyReligious.name: Culturally Religious
CulturallyReligious.def: Someone who grew up religious, but no longer practices or believes it, yet their life is still influenced by it.

TheDayOfReckoning.name: The Day of Reckoning
TheDayOfReckoning.def: "It's been a long journey and no one is coming out without scars.

DemonLordsAndArchdevils.name: Demon Lords and Archdevils
DemonLordsAndArchdevils.def: Zariel , Archduchess of Avernus , Champion of Asmodeus , and proof that this trope has its fair share of Demon Ladies as well as Lords .

DruidicSickle.name: Druidic Sickle
DruidicSickle.def: Pagan priests carry sickles, often for usage in sacrifice.

EmergencyMultifaithPrayer.name: Emergency Multifaith Prayer
EmergencyMultifaithPrayer.def: When their life is in danger, someone starts pleading with multiple deities of different religions to save them.

FaithHeelTurn.name: Faith–Heel Turn
FaithHeelTurn.def: Loss of religious faith leads to adopting a sinful lifestyle.

FantasticNirvana.name: Fantastic Nirvana
FantasticNirvana.def: Fictional religions in which an aspirant must reach a final state of ultimate bliss/freedom while still living.

FantasticReligiousDenominations.name: Fantastic Religious Denominations
FantasticReligiousDenominations.def: A fictional religion has its own sects or real religions have fictional sects.

FantasticReligiousWeirdness.name: Fantastic Religious Weirdness
FantasticReligiousWeirdness.def: Real-world religions are practiced differently in fantasy or science-fiction settings .

FantasyCounterpartReligion.name: Fantasy Counterpart Religion
FantasyCounterpartReligion.def: The religious beliefs held by a fictional nation or ethnic group .

FirstChurchOfMecha.name: First Church of Mecha
FirstChurchOfMecha.def: "These fools worship Transformers!" — Astrotrain, The Transformers , " The God Gambit "

TheFundamentalist.name: The Fundamentalist
TheFundamentalist.def: A super-fanatical religious person who believes everyone else should follow their strictly pious lifestyle, and derides anyone who disagrees with them.

GodAndSatanAreBothJerks.name: God and Satan Are Both Jerks
GodAndSatanAreBothJerks.def: The forces of Heaven and Hell are both evil and antagonistic towards humanity.

GreedyTelevangelist.name: Greedy Televangelist
GreedyTelevangelist.def: A televangelist Only in It for the Money .

HammerOfTheHoly.name: Hammer of the Holy
HammerOfTheHoly.def: Priests, paladins, and other holy or religious fighters carry hammers, maces, staves, or other blunt weapons.

HeelFaithTurn.name: Heel–Faith Turn
HeelFaithTurn.def: A sinner turns good after finding religion.

HeavenVersusHell.name: Heaven Versus Hell
HeavenVersusHell.def: The respective forces of Heaven ( God , angels ) and Hell ( Satan , demons ) are opposed to each other.

HidingBehindReligion.name: Hiding Behind Religion
HidingBehindReligion.def: A hypocritical sinner who is outwardly religious.

HollywoodAtheist.name: Hollywood Atheist
HollywoodAtheist.def: The stereotype that atheists either lost their belief in God because of misfortune they suffered or are close-minded jerks to everyone who has religious beliefs.

HollywoodDreamtime.name: Hollywood Dreamtime
HollywoodDreamtime.def: Common stereotypes associated with followers of Aboriginal Australian religions .

HollywoodExorcism.name: Hollywood Exorcism
HollywoodExorcism.def: Holy rituals that are performed by a priest to rid someone of an invasive evil spirit .

HollywoodSatanism.name: Hollywood Satanism
HollywoodSatanism.def: Common stereotypes associated with people who worship the Devil .

HollywoodVoodoo.name: Hollywood Voodoo
HollywoodVoodoo.def: Common stereotypes associated with followers of Voodoo religions.

HolyBurnsEvil.name: Holy Burns Evil
HolyBurnsEvil.def: Religious objects can protect you from demons, vampires, and other unholy sinister creatures.

HolyCity.name: Holy City
HolyCity.def: A city that is especially sacred to a particular religion.

HolyHitman.name: Holy Hitman
HolyHitman.def: A Professional Killer who happens to be quite religious.

HolyIsNotSafe.name: Holy Is Not Safe
HolyIsNotSafe.def: Beings/entities/objects from Heaven are just as dangerous to mortals as anything from Hell can be.

HolyPipeOrgan.name: Holy Pipe Organ
HolyPipeOrgan.def: As the largest piece of equipment in churches, pipe organs are often beautiful to look at.

HolyWater.name: Holy Water
HolyWater.def: Water that has been specially blessed by a priest or comes from a sacred place .

HotForPreacher.name: Hot for Preacher
HotForPreacher.def: Someone grows attracted to a priest. Which may cause complications if said priest is (supposed to be) celibate .

HumanSacrifice.name: Human Sacrifice
HumanSacrifice.def: The ritualized murder of other people, done as an offering to the gods.

IllegalReligion.name: Illegal Religion
IllegalReligion.def: A religion that is banned and persecuted by the government.

ImprovisedCross.name: Improvised Cross
ImprovisedCross.def: Yes, we realize the irony of a demon-looking Mutant saying he believes in God while holding up an improvised cross against a vampire.

IncrediblyInconvenientDeity.name: Incredibly Inconvenient Deity
IncrediblyInconvenientDeity.def: "Lie on your left side, and let it bear the punishment of the House of Israel; for as many days as you lie on it you shall bear their punishment.

InspiringSermon.name: Inspiring Sermon
InspiringSermon.def: A religious sermon that deeply inspires the audience, in-universe

InterfaithSmoothie.name: Interfaith Smoothie
InterfaithSmoothie.def: A syncretic religion that combines the beliefs of multiple different religions.

LoveIsLikeReligion.name: Love Is Like Religion
LoveIsLikeReligion.def: "Love, for you, is larger than the usual romantic love.

MachineWorship.name: Machine Worship
MachineWorship.def: Religious devotion to a mechanical entity.

MagicVersusReligion.name: Magic Versus Religion
MagicVersusReligion.def: Organized religion is often opposed to magic.

MysteryCult.name: Mystery Cult
MysteryCult.def: A very secretive sect which keeps their beliefs and practices hidden from nonbelievers.

MythologyUpgrade.name: Mythology Upgrade
MythologyUpgrade.def: Need a totally awesome magical beast to make your show that much more awesome?

Mythopoeia.name: Mythopoeia
Mythopoeia.def: The creator of a fictional work invents a religious system and its beliefs for characters within the work to follow.

NatureWorship.name: Nature Worship
NatureWorship.def: The worship of nature or things within it such as trees, the wind, the moon, etc.

NotAfraidOfHell.name: Not Afraid of Hell
NotAfraidOfHell.def: Someone who is unconcerned that their sinful behavior may earn them eternal damnation.

OfferingsToTheGods.name: Offerings to the Gods
OfferingsToTheGods.def: Religious rituals which involve appeasing a deity with some sort of "gift" (most commonly food or animal sacrifices).

OhMyGods.name: Oh, My Gods!
OhMyGods.def: When just saying " Oh My God !" isn't sufficient if you're a polytheist.

OneTrueFaith.name: One True Faith
OneTrueFaith.def: Only one religion really matters in a setting.

OutgrownSuchSillySuperstitions.name: Outgrown Such Silly Superstitions
OutgrownSuchSillySuperstitions.def: A story takes place in a future where (almost) nobody is really religious anymore.

PaintingTheFrostOnWindows.name: Painting the Frost on Windows
PaintingTheFrostOnWindows.def: Natural phenomenon is attributed to gods or other mythic figures doing a mystical version of a mundane task.

PascalsWager.name: Pascal's Wager
PascalsWager.def: Choosing to believe in God to avoid hell just in case He exists.

PathOfInspiration.name: Path of Inspiration
PathOfInspiration.def: A seemingly benevolent religious movement which secretly has far more sinister goals.

PhlebotinumWorship.name: Phlebotinum Worship
PhlebotinumWorship.def: Worship of weird and fantastic substances as if divine - when they actually aren't.

Pilgrimage.name: Pilgrimage
Pilgrimage.def: A trip for a religious purpose.

PiousMonster.name: Pious Monster
PiousMonster.def: When creatures who are considered to be " evil " or " monstrous " (if not outright demonic and unholy ) still respect and worship God for some reason.

PrayerIsALastResort.name: Prayer Is a Last Resort
PrayerIsALastResort.def: When someone who's not particularly devout or pious about their faith starts praying as a desperate measure to find solutions to their problems.

PrayerOfMalice.name: Prayer of Malice
PrayerOfMalice.def: When a cruel and petty person prays to their god by asking for a divine curse on their enemies.

PrayerPose.name: Prayer Pose
PrayerPose.def: Common poses and gestures made while praying, which varies by religion.

PrecursorWorship.name: Precursor Worship
PrecursorWorship.def: When an ancient precursor civilization are revered as gods by people in the present day.

PreApprovedSermon.name: Pre-Approved Sermon
PreApprovedSermon.def: Part of the clergy's job is writing and delivering a sermon to their flock.

PurgatoryAndLimbo.name: Purgatory and Limbo
PurgatoryAndLimbo.def: The places where dead people who are neither good enough for Heaven nor bad enough for Hell end up going to.

PurificationBathing.name: Purification Bathing
PurificationBathing.def: A frequent custom of several real-world religions is washing one's body or parts of one's body for physical and spiritual purification purposes.

ReflexiveRemarkOfReverence.name: Reflexive Remark of Reverence
ReflexiveRemarkOfReverence.def: Deeply religious characters are passionate about their beliefs to the point of feeling that they have to bless the name of their religious figure whenever their name is dropped in conversation, no matter what.

ReligionIsMagic.name: Religion Is Magic
ReligionIsMagic.def: When prayers to your god can double as magical spells.

ReligionIsRight.name: Religion Is Right
ReligionIsRight.def: "Science, traditional enemy of mysticism and religion, has taken on a growing understanding that the model of the universe suggested by quantum physics differs very little from the universe that Taoists and other mystics have existed in for centuries." — Professor Milton Glass , Dr.

ReligionOfEvil.name: Religion of Evil
ReligionOfEvil.def: A religion that is explicitly evil and worships sinister deities or demons .

ReligionRantSong.name: Religion Rant Song
ReligionRantSong.def: A song that attacks religion or religious figures.

ReligiousAndMythologicalThemeNaming.name: Religious and Mythological Theme Naming
ReligiousAndMythologicalThemeNaming.def: Naming someone or something after a deity, prophet, saint, or anyone/anything else of religious significance.

ReligiousForBenefits.name: Religious for Benefits
ReligiousForBenefits.def: Someone joins a religious group to access benefits rather than actual belief for its creeds.

ReligiousHorror.name: Religious Horror
ReligiousHorror.def: A subgenre of (supernatural) horror fiction that relies on theological or mythological themes.

ReligiousRobot.name: Religious Robot
ReligiousRobot.def: A sapient machine with religious beliefs.

ReligiousStereotype.name: Religious Stereotype
ReligiousStereotype.def: Stereotypes associated with followers of particular religions.

ReligiousVampire.name: Religious Vampire
ReligiousVampire.def: Even vampires can choose to worship God and pray to Him.

RobotReligion.name: Robot Religion
RobotReligion.def: An organized religion developed by mechanical beings.

SacredLanguage.name: Sacred Language
SacredLanguage.def: A particular language is of great religious significance.

SadlyMythcharacterized.name: Sadly Mythcharacterized
SadlyMythcharacterized.def: Inaccurate portrayals of particular mythical/religious figures.

SadlyMythtaken.name: Sadly Mythtaken
SadlyMythtaken.def: When entire mythologies are radically altered in a fictional adaptation.

SaintlyChurch.name: Saintly Church
SaintlyChurch.def: A religious organization that actually wants to do good and righteous deeds for the world.

ScamReligion.name: Scam Religion
ScamReligion.def: A fake religion that is founded by its leader solely to fool gullible people out of their money.

ScaryAmoralReligion.name: Scary Amoral Religion
ScaryAmoralReligion.def: A religion founded on ruthless Blue-and-Orange Morality (as opposed to a Card Carrying Religion of Evil ).

Sermonette.name: Sermonette
Sermonette.def: A short message, usually delivered by a Christian clergyman, shown at the end of a TV station's broadcast day.

ShrinesAndTemples.name: Shrines and Temples
ShrinesAndTemples.def: Buildings and places that are dedicated to the worship of a deity.

SillyPrayer.name: Silly Prayer
SillyPrayer.def: A prayer that is comedic in some way.

SinEater.name: Sin Eater
SinEater.def: A person who literally or metaphorically takes on people's sins to purify them. Or who claims to be doing this by targeting people they believe to be sinners.

SinglePreceptReligion.name: Single-Precept Religion
SinglePreceptReligion.def: "Make it a double!" "You know what this Dragon Code reminds me of?

SmugSpiritualist.name: Smug Spiritualist
SmugSpiritualist.def: A "spiritual but not religious" person who is arrogant, irritating, or generally a Jerkass .

SongOfPrayer.name: Song of Prayer
SongOfPrayer.def: Singing and dancing to express one's thoughts to God.

TheSoulSaver.name: The Soul Saver
TheSoulSaver.def: A character who saves souls from some kind of literal or symbolic hell/limbo.

TargetedHumanSacrifice.name: Targeted Human Sacrifice
TargetedHumanSacrifice.def: They can't just grab any random person to kill, they need a specific type of individual for the sacrifice.

ThankTheMaker.name: Thank the Maker
ThankTheMaker.def: A robot or A.I. worships its creator.

TheTheocracy.name: The Theocracy
TheTheocracy.def: A system of government run by priests who rule through religious laws, as opposed to a secular government.

Theotech.name: Theotech
Theotech.def: A Science Fiction subgenre that borrows the aesthetics, symbolism and terminology of religion, the occult, and New Age conspiracy theories.

ThereIsAGod.name: There Is a God!
ThereIsAGod.def: Someone is happy about something they wanted to happen and sees it as proof that God does exist.

TribeOfPriests.name: Tribe of Priests
TribeOfPriests.def: A whole community of religious preachers.

UniversalChaplain.name: Universal Chaplain
UniversalChaplain.def: Military chaplains are priests who provide religious services to fellow soldiers, regardless of their faith.

UnwantedFalseFaith.name: Unwanted False Faith
UnwantedFalseFaith.def: Someone is dismayed that people worship them under the mistaken assumption that they're divine.

TheAlmightyDollar.name: The Almighty Dollar
TheAlmightyDollar.def: A deity associated with money and wealth.

AnswersToTheNameOfGod.name: Answers to the Name of God
AnswersToTheNameOfGod.def: Someone with a high opinion of themselves assumes that a person exclaiming "God" was referring to them.

BoltOfDivineRetribution.name: Bolt of Divine Retribution
BoltOfDivineRetribution.def: The gods punish people by having them struck with lightning.

CrossoverCosmology.name: Crossover Cosmology
CrossoverCosmology.def: In a world where All Myths Are True , multiple pantheons of deities from different religious mythologies all somehow coexist together.

DeityOfHumanOrigin.name: Deity of Human Origin
DeityOfHumanOrigin.def: A god who was formerly a mortal.

DeityOfMortalCreation.name: Deity of Mortal Creation
DeityOfMortalCreation.def: A god made by a mortal(s).

DevilButNoGod.name: Devil, but No God
DevilButNoGod.def: Satan appears in the story, but there's no sign of God being around for some reason.

DevilComplex.name: Devil Complex
DevilComplex.def: Someone believes themselves to be the Devil.

DivineDate.name: Divine Date
DivineDate.def: A mortal is literally in love with an actual god.

DivineIntervention.name: Divine Intervention
DivineIntervention.def: A god directly gets involved in mortal affairs.

DivinePunishment.name: Divine Punishment
DivinePunishment.def: When a god punishes someone (justified or not) for perceived transgressions.

DivineRaceLift.name: Divine Race Lift
DivineRaceLift.def: A deity's physical appearance is depicted differently depending on the adaptation.

DivineRanks.name: Divine Ranks
DivineRanks.def: All the deities in a pantheon are classified into a hierarchy.

DoubleStandardRapeDivineOnMortal.name: Double Standard: Rape, Divine on Mortal
DoubleStandardRapeDivineOnMortal.def: Being raped by a deity isn't considered as bad as being raped by another mortal.

ElIsForDivinity.name: El Is for Divinity
ElIsForDivinity.def: The prefix or suffix "El", one of the names of god, is used to denote a character's connection to the divine.

EverybodyLovesZeus.name: Everybody Loves Zeus
EverybodyLovesZeus.def: The leader of the gods gets all the positive attention.

FantasyPantheon.name: Fantasy Pantheon
FantasyPantheon.def: A group of deities that are worshipped in a fictional religion .

FertilityGod.name: Fertility God
FertilityGod.def: A god or goddess who can create life.

AFormYouAreComfortableWith.name: A Form You Are Comfortable With
AFormYouAreComfortableWith.def: Gods and spirits may assume forms that humans are accustomed to, in order to keep from driving the mortals buggo with how they really look .

AGodIAmNot.name: A God I Am Not
AGodIAmNot.def: A person has great power but does not believe that this makes them special or above others.

AGodIsYou.name: A God Is You
AGodIsYou.def: Sometimes playing as a mere mortal just isn't awesome enough.

GodBeforeDogma.name: God Before Dogma
GodBeforeDogma.def: "A man shall be known by his learning: but he that is vain and foolish, shall be exposed to contempt." — Proverbs 12:8 Image by Bojan Teodosijević , used with permission

GodCouple.name: God Couple
GodCouple.def: When two deities fall in love or get married.

GodIsEvil.name: God Is Evil
GodIsEvil.def: God is portrayed as cruel and malevolent.

GodIsFlawed.name: God Is Flawed
GodIsFlawed.def: God is not perfect and has the same faults as humans do.

GodIsGood.name: God Is Good
GodIsGood.def: God is portrayed as kind and benevolent.

GodIsLoveSongs.name: God-Is-Love Songs
GodIsLoveSongs.def: And so we sat and read various things like 'He Will Hold Me Fast...In Bed', 'Lord and Master of Us All...In Bed', 'When He Cometh...In Bed', 'Trust and Obey...In Bed', 'Come and Dine...In Bed' and giggled our heads off until Me : * reads * 'Christ, You Are My Fullness' Me : ...

GodKartingWithBeelzebub.name: God-Karting with Beelzebub
GodKartingWithBeelzebub.def: God and Satan are actually quite friendly to each other.

GodsHandsAreTied.name: God's Hands Are Tied
GodsHandsAreTied.def: God has reasons why He can't just fix everything.

GodsNeedPrayerBadly.name: Gods Need Prayer Badly
GodsNeedPrayerBadly.def: Gods can only exist or stay powerful just as long as there are people who still believe or worship them .

GodTest.name: God Test
GodTest.def: He can turn water into wine and dinner into dessert!

TheHandIsGod.name: The Hand Is God
TheHandIsGod.def: God or some similar all-powerful being is depicted as a disembodied hand.

HealerGod.name: Healer God
HealerGod.def: A god or goddess whose specialty is healing or medicine.

JerkassGods.name: Jerkass Gods
JerkassGods.def: Arrogant deities who look down on mortals or cruelly abuse them.

LoveGoddess.name: Love Goddess
LoveGoddess.def: A goddess associated with romantic love and/or sexual lust.

MarriageToAGod.name: Marriage to a God
MarriageToAGod.def: A mortal is (figuratively) married to a deity.

TheModernGods.name: The Modern Gods
TheModernGods.def: Gods that suit the here and now.

TheOldGods.name: The Old Gods
TheOldGods.def: The previous group of deities who ruled before the current pantheon came to power.

OurGodsAreDifferent.name: Our Gods Are Different
OurGodsAreDifferent.def: Exactly what kind of being gets to be defined as a deity can vary greatly depending on the story.

PantheonSitcom.name: Pantheon Sitcom
PantheonSitcom.def: The gods are up to some crazy antics.

PatronGod.name: Patron God
PatronGod.def: A god or goddess regularly rewards his or her followers for their devotion and piety.

StopWorshippingMe.name: Stop Worshipping Me!
StopWorshippingMe.def: Not all deities are flattered by mortals praying to them.

TricksterGod.name: Trickster God
TricksterGod.def: A deity who represents trickery and deceit, often fooling and manipulating both their fellow deities and mortals alike.

UnusualHalo.name: Unusual Halo
UnusualHalo.def: Despite what her Cool Crown -esque halo might entail, Paimon is just an average Fairy Companion and not at all royalty.

WarGod.name: War God
WarGod.def: A deity who represents warfare and violent conflict, whom soldiers and warriors are expected to pray to for winning battles.

BargainWithHeaven.name: Bargain with Heaven
BargainWithHeaven.def: Someone gets what they want by making a deal with God or some other divine being.

CrisisOfFaith.name: Crisis of Faith
CrisisOfFaith.def: Someone begins to doubt and question their religious beliefs.

DealWithTheDevil.name: Deal with the Devil
DealWithTheDevil.def: Someone gets what they want by making a deal with Satan or some other demonic being.

EvilStoleMyFaith.name: Evil Stole My Faith
EvilStoleMyFaith.def: Someone loses their religious beliefs because of a personal tragedy, or otherwise witnessing something grossly cruel and unfair.

HenotheisticSociety.name: Henotheistic Society
HenotheisticSociety.def: When it's the societal norm for someone or a group of people to worship one god of a Fantasy Pantheon far more than the others.

MissionFromGod.name: Mission from God
MissionFromGod.def: When someone believes their goals were given to them by orders from God.

TheMissionary.name: The Missionary
TheMissionary.def: A traveling priest who seeks to spread their faith by proselytizing and converting other people.

RageAgainstTheHeavens.name: Rage Against the Heavens
RageAgainstTheHeavens.def: Someone expresses anger and blame at God (or the gods) due to their life being so miserable.

SanctuaryOfSolitude.name: Sanctuary of Solitude
SanctuaryOfSolitude.def: A character is stressed or scared and is confused about what to do.

SecularHero.name: Secular Hero
SecularHero.def: A hero who lacks religious beliefs.

AmbiguouslyChristian.name: Ambiguously Christian
AmbiguouslyChristian.def: A character is implied but not confirmed outright to follow some sort of Christianity.

AmbivalentAnglican.name: Ambivalent Anglican
AmbivalentAnglican.def: A member of the Church of England who seems indifferent to Christian dogma.

AnimeCatholicism.name: Anime Catholicism
AnimeCatholicism.def: Inaccurate portrayals of Catholic Christianity in Japanese media.

AsTheGoodBookSays.name: As the Good Book Says...
AsTheGoodBookSays.def: A character quotes verses from the The Bible .

BigRedDevil.name: Big Red Devil
BigRedDevil.def: "I'm the Devil, I love metal!" "Well, at least I don't look like a giant ketchup bottle!" — Suction Cup Man to Satan , " Suction Cup Man 3: One Hell of a Climb "

CatholicHatingChristian.name: Catholic-Hating Christian
CatholicHatingChristian.def: Non-Catholic character who self-identifies as a Christian expresses disdain for or outright hostility against Catholicism.

ChristianityIsCatholic.name: Christianity Is Catholic
ChristianityIsCatholic.def: Roman Catholicism is the only Christian denomination that tends to get any depiction in most works of fiction.

CleanCutNaiveMormon.name: Clean-Cut Naïve Mormon
CleanCutNaiveMormon.def: A Mormon who is clean-cut and childish, or at least dorky.

Confessional.name: Confessional
Confessional.def: A private space in some churches where a priest listens to a parishioner confessing their sins.

CreepyCatholicism.name: Creepy Catholicism
CreepyCatholicism.def: The Roman Catholic Church depicted as being evil or at least associated with scary things.

CrucialCross.name: Crucial Cross
CrucialCross.def: The son of God always knows how to make an entrance.

CrystalDragonJesus.name: Crystal Dragon Jesus
CrystalDragonJesus.def: A fictional religion inspired by Christianity.

TheDescendantsOfCain.name: The Descendants of Cain
TheDescendantsOfCain.def: "Of [Cain] all evil broods were born, ogres and goblins and haunting shapes of hell, and the giants too, that long time warred with God—for that he gave them their reward." — J.

EasterBunny.name: Easter Bunny
EasterBunny.def: Lets just hope those eggs weren't that little chick's unborn siblings...

EveryoneIsChristianAtChristmas.name: Everyone Is Christian at Christmas
EveryoneIsChristianAtChristmas.def: The holiday of Christmas is widely celebrated even beyond the Christian world.

FantasticCatholicism.name: Fantastic Catholicism
FantasticCatholicism.def: The Roman Catholic Church are directly connected to the supernatural world .

FemalePope.name: Female Pope
FemalePope.def: A woman is elected as the Pope and becomes the head of the Catholic Church.

HijackedByJesus.name: Hijacked by Jesus
HijackedByJesus.def: Odin hanging from Yggdrasil for 9 days, in the darkness, with his side stabbed by a spear, and with no help from other gods.

HollywoodApocrypha.name: Hollywood Apocrypha
HollywoodApocrypha.def: Someone erroneously quotes a fake biblical verse .

HollywoodJehovahsWitness.name: Hollywood Jehovah's Witness
HollywoodJehovahsWitness.def: Common stereotypes associated with members of the Jehovah's Witnesses sect.

HollywoodNuns.name: Hollywood Nuns
HollywoodNuns.def: Common stereotypes associated with Roman Catholic nuns.

HorsemenOfTheApocalypse.name: Horsemen of the Apocalypse
HorsemenOfTheApocalypse.def: Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse , 1887, by Viktor Vasnetsov.

JesusTheEarlyYears.name: Jesus: The Early Years
JesusTheEarlyYears.def: And did those feet, in ancient time Walk upon England's mountains green?

JesusWasCrazy.name: Jesus Was Crazy
JesusWasCrazy.def: Pilate : Look at your Jesus Christ.

LockedAwayInAMonastery.name: Locked Away in a Monastery
LockedAwayInAMonastery.def: My cell is so narrow, you may say, but oh, how wide is the sky!

MalevolentMormon.name: Malevolent Mormon
MalevolentMormon.def: "We warned you at Syracuse, and you persisted.

NewEnglandPuritan.name: New England Puritan
NewEnglandPuritan.def: A particular group of English Protestant settlers who migrated to colonial America, whose super-strict religious practices gave rise to the term " puritanical ".

NunsAreMikos.name: Nuns Are Mikos
NunsAreMikos.def: This trope is about Japanese works that portray Christian nuns as being similar to Miko (shrine maidens, shamans, spirit mediums).

PassionPlay.name: Passion Play
PassionPlay.def: A re-telling of the story of the Passion of Jesus Christ .

PatronSaint.name: Patron Saint
PatronSaint.def: A guy like that 's sure to be level -headed.

ReligiousRedub.name: Religious Redub
ReligiousRedub.def: So you're watching a rerun of an old TV show you used to love as a kid, when suddenly the characters start saying "That reminds me of what the Bible tells us with [insert any Bible verse here]".

SantaClausmas.name: Santa Clausmas
SantaClausmas.def: A secularized version of Christmas without any religious elements. Typically revolves around Santa Claus instead of Jesus Christ .

SevenHeavenlyVirtues.name: Seven Heavenly Virtues
SevenHeavenlyVirtues.def: "The Virtues", designed by Sir Joshua Reynolds for the western end of New College Chapel, Oxford.

TakingTheVeil.name: Taking the Veil
TakingTheVeil.def: "What do you ask?" The ritual question was always put, and the postulant, kneeling, answered, "To try my vocation as a Benedictine, in this house of Brede." — In This House Of Brede

TwistedEucharist.name: Twisted Eucharist
TwistedEucharist.def: "Our thirst for blood satiates us, soothes our fears.

WhiteAngloSaxonProtestant.name: White Anglo-Saxon Protestant
WhiteAngloSaxonProtestant.def: A stereotypical snobby American white person.

AllJewsAreAshkenazi.name: All Jews Are Ashkenazi
AllJewsAreAshkenazi.def: The inaccurate stereotype that every Jew is an ethnic Ashkenazi from Central/Eastern Europe.

AmbiguouslyJewish.name: Ambiguously Jewish
AmbiguouslyJewish.def: A character is implied but not confirmed outright to be a Jew or follower of Judaism.

Golem.name: Golem
Golem.def: Clay sculptures made by rabbis in imitation of God's creation of humans. Its origins are based on the legendary tale of a clay creature that was said to have been brought to life by a rabbi in 16th century Prague.

GratuitousUseOfTheTallit.name: Gratuitous Use of the Tallit
GratuitousUseOfTheTallit.def: In the DC Animated Universe , not only can you wear a tallit to a funeral, but in a pinch a child's winter scarf is an acceptable substitute.

GreedyJew.name: Greedy Jew
GreedyJew.def: An Antisemitic stereotype and conspiracy theory, of Jews all being greedy money fetishists who control every major business industry ( especially finance ), and they often secretly manipulate politics in their favor as well .

InformedJudaism.name: Informed Judaism
InformedJudaism.def: A character is stated to be (religiously) Jewish, but doesn't really act much like it.

TzadikimNistarim.name: Tzadikim Nistarim
TzadikimNistarim.def: Hebrew for "The Hidden Righteous Ones", a number of people whose existence keeps the world going, usually 36. (The idea also exists in other religions, but this is the one which is most widely known.)

AllMuslimsAreArab.name: All Muslims Are Arab
AllMuslimsAreArab.def: The inaccurate stereotype that every Muslim is an ethnic Arab or speaks Arabic.

HidingInAHijab.name: Hiding in a Hijab
HidingInAHijab.def: Wearing a headscarf, face veil, or full-body cloak in order to disguise oneself as a devoutly religious Muslim woman.

MiddleEasternTerrorists.name: Middle Eastern Terrorists
MiddleEasternTerrorists.def: Although secular or even non-Muslim examples exist, the most common variation of this trope usually involves mujahideen (or jihadists) — Islamist religious militants who commit acts of violence in hopes of spreading their fundamentalist ideology, which demands the creation of an Islamic state govern

MistakenForTerrorist.name: Mistaken for Terrorist
MistakenForTerrorist.def: Most variations of this trope involve innocent Muslims (or non-Muslim people mistaken for being such, especially Sikhs) getting mistaken for violent Islamic extremists.

AllMonksKnowKungFu.name: All Monks Know Kung-Fu
AllMonksKnowKungFu.def: Buddhist monks are often stereotyped as being Warrior Monks that are proficient in the martial arts ( especially if they're Chinese ).

Aobozu.name: Aobōzu
Aobozu.def: Blue-skinned, one-eyed Buddhist monks who represent inexperience or harass people.

AsianRuneChant.name: Asian Rune Chant
AsianRuneChant.def: The Japanese Kuji-in , "Nine Syllable Seals", originated as a specialized form of Taoist mediation from the Chinese text Baopuzi .

AsleepNotMeditating.name: Asleep, Not Meditating
AsleepNotMeditating.def: He has got the relaxing part down but perhaps a bit too much.

TheFourGods.name: The Four Gods
TheFourGods.def: A quartet of deities associated with Chinese Mythology .

LevitatingLotusPosition.name: Levitating Lotus Position
LevitatingLotusPosition.def: Person/being levitates while in Lotus Position .

LotusPosition.name: Lotus Position
LotusPosition.def: A common meditation pose that is often used by Hindus and Buddhists.

MeditatingUnderAWaterfall.name: Meditating Under a Waterfall
MeditatingUnderAWaterfall.def: If one wishes to meditate in a place with nice scenery.

ShaolinMonk.name: Shaolin Monk
ShaolinMonk.def: A Warrior Monk that belongs to (or is inspired by) the Shaolin Monastery of Henan, China.

ZigzagPaperTassel.name: Zigzag Paper Tassel
ZigzagPaperTassel.def: The border between the sacred and the secular.

AcademiaElitism.name: Academia Elitism
AcademiaElitism.def: Disparaging someone's education relative to another's.

AdultsAreUseless.name: Adults Are Useless
AdultsAreUseless.def: Even if a teacher is around, kids can still break school rules.

AlwaysInClassOne.name: Always in Class One
AlwaysInClassOne.def: Works about or in a school usually take place in Class X-A or Class X-1.

AntiEducationMama.name: Anti-Education Mama
AntiEducationMama.def: Parents that dislike their kids getting an education.

AsleepInClass.name: Asleep in Class
AsleepInClass.def: A student who usually falls asleep during class.

AxesAtSchool.name: Axes at School
AxesAtSchool.def: A student brings a weapon to school and may or may not use it against someone.

BracesBasedBullying.name: Braces-Based Bullying
BracesBasedBullying.def: Bullying somebody because they have braces is, unfortunately, common among grade schoolers.

BullyingTheBespectacled.name: Bullying the Bespectacled
BullyingTheBespectacled.def: Bullying somebody because they wear glasses is, unfortunately, common among grade schoolers.

ChekhovsClassroom.name: Chekhov's Classroom
ChekhovsClassroom.def: Someone learns something in school and unexpectedly applies that knowledge later in the story.

CuteSportsClubManager.name: Cute Sports Club Manager
CuteSportsClubManager.def: A cute, athletic person who runs a sports club.

DodgeballIsHell.name: Dodgeball Is Hell
DodgeballIsHell.def: In works of fiction, dodgeball will always be delightful for The Bully and despairing for the nerds and unpopular kids.

EducationMama.name: Education Mama
EducationMama.def: A parent will get angry at their kid for not taking their studies seriously.

EducationThroughPyrotechnics.name: Education Through Pyrotechnics
EducationThroughPyrotechnics.def: A lesson in science class often involves Stuff Blowing Up .

EEqualsMCHammer.name: E = MC Hammer
EEqualsMCHammer.def: Incorrect or nonsensical equations that look like real math.

EggSitting.name: Egg Sitting
EggSitting.def: Students are tasked with looking after eggs, bags of flour, or robots to determine whether they'd make responsible parents.

EternalStudent.name: Eternal Student
EternalStudent.def: Someone remains in school for far longer than should be necessary to graduate.

EveryoneWentToSchoolTogether.name: Everyone Went to School Together
EveryoneWentToSchoolTogether.def: The adult cast of a show turn out to have known each other for years and even went to the same school.

ExperimentedInCollege.name: Experimented in College
ExperimentedInCollege.def: A naturally straight character entertained their bicuriosity while in high school or college. Usually female.

FightingBackIsWrong.name: Fighting Back Is Wrong
FightingBackIsWrong.def: When the nerd is punished for trying to fight back against The Bully .

FoodFight.name: Food Fight
FoodFight.def: A group of students in the cafeteria start throwing food at each other.

FreeTheFrogs.name: Free the Frogs
FreeTheFrogs.def: Protesting against frogs being dissected in science class.

GlassesCuriosity.name: Glasses Curiosity
GlassesCuriosity.def: Wanting to try on the glasses of others, which is quite common in grade school.

GrownUpsFormerAuthorityFigure.name: Grown-Up's Former Authority Figure
GrownUpsFormerAuthorityFigure.def: An adult runs into their former teacher or other school staff member from their youth.

GymClassHell.name: Gym Class Hell
GymClassHell.def: Works of fiction portray gym class as torturous, especially for unpopular kids and nerds.

GymClassRopeClimb.name: Gym Class Rope Climb
GymClassRopeClimb.def: An activity in gym class that involves students having to climb up a rope hanging from the ceiling.

HandsGoDown.name: Hands Go Down
HandsGoDown.def: The teacher asks a question: everyone raises their hands. The teacher asks a follow up question: everyone lowers their hands.

HigherEducationIsForWomen.name: Higher Education Is for Women
HigherEducationIsForWomen.def: When a cast of characters graduate high school, it is more likely that the girls will to college.

IntraScholasticRivalry.name: Intra-Scholastic Rivalry
IntraScholasticRivalry.def: Different groups within a school consider each other rivals.

JockDadNerdSon.name: Jock Dad, Nerd Son
JockDadNerdSon.def: A nerdy kid has a father who was a jock in school.

KeepAway.name: Keep Away
KeepAway.def: A group of bullies take away someone's stuff and toss it around to each other to keep them from getting it back.

LiceEpisode.name: Lice Episode
LiceEpisode.def: One student (or even the entire class) gets lice.

MysteriousTeachersLounge.name: Mysterious Teacher's Lounge
MysteriousTeachersLounge.def: A group of students discuss what wonders could be hiding in the teacher's lounge.

NominatedAsAPrank.name: Nominated as a Prank
NominatedAsAPrank.def: Student is nominated for Class President or Prom King or Queen as part of a malicious prank.

NotWearingPantsDream.name: "Not Wearing Pants" Dream
NotWearingPantsDream.def: A character dreams they are in a state of undress. These kinds of dreams often have the character dreaming they are naked or in their underwear while at school.

PassingNotesInClass.name: Passing Notes in Class
PassingNotesInClass.def: A student passes a note to their crush while class is in session.

ThePermanentRecord.name: The Permanent Record
ThePermanentRecord.def: A collection of a student's misdeeds.

PersecutedIntellectuals.name: Persecuted Intellectuals
PersecutedIntellectuals.def: A person is feared, mistrusted, and persecuted because of their intelligence.

PickedLast.name: Picked Last
PickedLast.def: A student is humiliated because they are the last one picked during gym class.

PopularIsDumb.name: Popular Is Dumb
PopularIsDumb.def: A character who is popular in school is portrayed as unintelligent.

PopularIsEvil.name: Popular Is Evil
PopularIsEvil.def: A character who is popular in school is portrayed as mean and ruthless.

PromWrecker.name: Prom Wrecker
PromWrecker.def: A character tries to ruin the school dance.

PubescentBraces.name: Pubescent Braces
PubescentBraces.def: Braces signify puberty and highlight awkwardness or geekiness.

SchoolgirlSeries.name: Schoolgirl Series
SchoolgirlSeries.def: A Slice of Life series starring a group of female students.

SchoolIsForLosers.name: School Is for Losers
SchoolIsForLosers.def: A person who believes that going to school is a waste of time.

SchoolRivalry.name: School Rivalry
SchoolRivalry.def: A rivalry between two or more schools.

ShamedBeforeTheWholeSchool.name: Shamed Before the Whole School
ShamedBeforeTheWholeSchool.def: A child is shamed or humiliated before the whole school.

Swirlie.name: Swirlie
Swirlie.def: A bully sticks a kid's head in the toilet.

TeenHorror.name: Teen Horror
TeenHorror.def: Horror stories about high school or college students.

TextbookHumor.name: Textbook Humor
TextbookHumor.def: Jokes in textbooks that you'd expect to keep a serious tone.

ToastOfTardiness.name: Toast of Tardiness
ToastOfTardiness.def: A student who is late for school sticks a piece of toast in their mouth to eat for breakfast while they run.

TooSmartForEducation.name: Too Smart for Education
TooSmartForEducation.def: Characters who are either genuinely more intelligent than their current school level, or merely think they're too clever for formal education.

TrendAesop.name: Trend Aesop
TrendAesop.def: A character learns a lesson about trying to fit in with the crowd.

UnconventionalElectives101.name: Unconventional Electives 101
UnconventionalElectives101.def: A course that covers a fringe topic.

WackyFratboyHijinx.name: Wacky Fratboy Hijinx
WackyFratboyHijinx.def: A movie in which the humor comes from the antics of college fratboys.

WakeUpGoToSchoolSaveTheWorld.name: Wake Up, Go to School, Save the World
WakeUpGoToSchoolSaveTheWorld.def: A Kid Hero has to juggle heroics and their personal life.

Wedgie.name: Wedgie
Wedgie.def: A bully pulls on a kid's underwear.

WetWillie.name: Wet Willie
WetWillie.def: A bully sticks a spit-covered finger in someone's ear and twirls.

AbsurdlyDividedSchool.name: Absurdly Divided School
AbsurdlyDividedSchool.def: The school is divided into at least two viciously antagonistic groups.

AbsurdlyPowerfulSchoolJurisdiction.name: Absurdly Powerful School Jurisdiction
AbsurdlyPowerfulSchoolJurisdiction.def: School officials attempt to punish a student for their actions outside of school grounds.

AcademyOfEvil.name: Academy of Evil
AcademyOfEvil.def: A school dedicated to training future villains.

AssimilationAcademy.name: Assimilation Academy
AssimilationAcademy.def: A school that discourages creativity and crushes spirits.

BoardingSchool.name: Boarding School
BoardingSchool.def: A school where students live on campus. Boarding School of Horrors : A boarding school that is horrible to the students.

ClassPet.name: Class Pet
ClassPet.def: An animal that is kept in a classroom and cared for by the students.

ClownSchool.name: Clown School
ClownSchool.def: A school where people go to learn comedy.

CollegeIsHighSchoolPart2.name: College Is "High School, Part 2"
CollegeIsHighSchoolPart2.def: A college that has all the high school stereotypes.

CollegeRadio.name: College Radio
CollegeRadio.def: A radio station run by college students.

CoolSchool.name: Cool School
CoolSchool.def: A school that has an amazing curriculum.

CorrespondenceCourse.name: Correspondence Course
CorrespondenceCourse.def: A school that offers distant learning.

CramSchool.name: Cram School
CramSchool.def: A school where you have to study reeeeeally hard to achieve certain goals.

DetentionEpisode.name: Detention Episode
DetentionEpisode.def: An episode of the show where one of the characters gets detention.

DustbinSchool.name: Dustbin School
DustbinSchool.def: A school where all the problem children go.

EducationalShort.name: Educational Short
EducationalShort.def: A short, educational film is used for classroom instruction.

ElevatorSchool.name: Elevator School
ElevatorSchool.def: A school has students from every grade in it.

FoulCafeteriaFood.name: Foul Cafeteria Food
FoulCafeteriaFood.def: Public school lunch will make you lose your lunch.

GettingSuspendedIsAwesome.name: Getting Suspended Is Awesome
GettingSuspendedIsAwesome.def: Students see out-of-school suspensions as cool because they don't have to go to school.

HeroAcademy.name: Hero Academy
HeroAcademy.def: A school that trains students specifically on how to be a hero.

HighSchoolRocks.name: High School Rocks
HighSchoolRocks.def: High school being shown as a fun place to be.

JuniorHigh.name: Junior High
JuniorHigh.def: Otherwise known as middle school, the place of education between elementary and high school. Middle School Is Miserable : Middle school is shown to be a cesspool.

LockerMail.name: Locker Mail
LockerMail.def: Mail is delivered to someone's locker.

MilitarySchool.name: Military School
MilitarySchool.def: A school which aims to instill military-style discipline in students.

NoFantasySchoolGeneralEd.name: No Fantasy School General Ed
NoFantasySchoolGeneralEd.def: Supernatural schools don't have "boring" mundane classes.

PrisonsAreSchools.name: Prisons Are Schools
PrisonsAreSchools.def: Using the time behind bars to learn.

RidiculouslyCompetitiveSchool.name: Ridiculously Competitive School
RidiculouslyCompetitiveSchool.def: A school setting encourages competition to a ridiculous, unhealthy degree by instituting policies like expulsion for minor infractions.

RoyalSchool.name: Royal School
RoyalSchool.def: A school that teaches girls how to be princesses.

SchoolForScheming.name: School for Scheming
SchoolForScheming.def: A school that is used as a cover for an elaborate plot-centric scheme.

SchoolOfHardKnocks.name: School of Hard Knocks
SchoolOfHardKnocks.def: A school that allows students to fight each other.

SchoolSettingSimulation.name: School Setting Simulation
SchoolSettingSimulation.def: A video game level taking place in a school, college, university, or other academic institution.

SensitivityTraining.name: Sensitivity Training
SensitivityTraining.def: A school that sensitize people to their attitudes and behaviors that may unwittingly cause offense to others.

ShopClass.name: Shop Class
ShopClass.def: A high school course where students are taught industrial arts.

SuckySchool.name: Sucky School
SuckySchool.def: A school that isn't very good at teaching.

SummerSchoolSucks.name: Summer School Sucks
SummerSchoolSucks.def: A student has to attend summer school to catch up on missing credits.

ThemedSchoolHouses.name: Themed School Houses
ThemedSchoolHouses.def: A school with a grouping system based on certain themes.

TwoTeacherSchool.name: Two-Teacher School
TwoTeacherSchool.def: Works set in schools that don't show more than two teachers.

WackyCollege.name: Wacky College
WackyCollege.def: A college with strange faculty and students.

AnimalGoesToSchool.name: Animal Goes to School
AnimalGoesToSchool.def: An animal not normally seen in a school setting is in one.

ArtisticLicenseUniversityAdmissions.name: Artistic License – University Admissions
ArtisticLicenseUniversityAdmissions.def: In the United States, university admissions are a long, tedious process, and involve a lot of hard work filling out forms and sending supporting documents, waiting, and even more hoping and praying.

BackToSchool.name: Back to School
BackToSchool.def: The story has a character having to attend school again.

CompulsorySchoolAge.name: Compulsory School Age
CompulsorySchoolAge.def: Characters must attend school at the grade typical of their physical age, regardless of their mental age, knowledge, or maturity.

ExpelledFromEveryOtherSchool.name: Expelled from Every Other School
ExpelledFromEveryOtherSchool.def: A character who can't go to school because they have gotten expelled so many times.

FirstDayOfSchoolEpisode.name: First Day of School Episode
FirstDayOfSchoolEpisode.def: An episode where a character has their first day of school.

FreshmanFears.name: Freshman Fears
FreshmanFears.def: Students on their first year at a secondary or tertiary level of education usually have struggles at school.

GottaPassTheClass.name: Gotta Pass the Class
GottaPassTheClass.def: A student is failing their classes and needs to get their grades up.

HeldBackInSchool.name: Held Back in School
HeldBackInSchool.def: A student who is older than their classmates because they had to repeat at least one school year.

IncomprehensibleEntranceExam.name: Incomprehensible Entrance Exam
IncomprehensibleEntranceExam.def: Getting into this school requires a test that makes no sense whatsoever.

IvyLeagueForEveryone.name: Ivy League for Everyone
IvyLeagueForEveryone.def: Fictional characters have a much easier time getting into prestigious schools than real people.

LastDayOfSchoolPlot.name: "Last Day of School" Plot
LastDayOfSchoolPlot.def: An episode where a character has their last day of school.

LateForSchool.name: Late for School
LateForSchool.def: A character is shown running to school because they overslept.

NewYearSameClass.name: New Year, Same Class
NewYearSameClass.def: The classroom of the students and teacher from the previous grade are together in the new grade.

ObsessedWithPerfectAttendance.name: Obsessed with Perfect Attendance
ObsessedWithPerfectAttendance.def: A character goes to extreme lengths to avoid being late or absent.

SchoolGradeHacking.name: School Grade Hacking
SchoolGradeHacking.def: A student hacks the school's database to improve their grades.

SchoolOfNoStudying.name: School of No Studying
SchoolOfNoStudying.def: A story that takes place in a school setting where no one is seen doing school work or worrying about their grades.

SeniorYearStruggles.name: Senior Year Struggles
SeniorYearStruggles.def: Stress and angst about facing your future as a senior student.

ShouldntWeBeInSchoolRightNow.name: Shouldn't We Be in School Right Now?
ShouldntWeBeInSchoolRightNow.def: It's pointed out that younger characters are cutting class when the plot clearly has them nowhere near school grounds.

SkippingSchool.name: Skipping School
SkippingSchool.def: A student decides not to go to school and goes off to do something else instead.

AllCheeringAllTheTime.name: All-Cheering All the Time
AllCheeringAllTheTime.def: Cheerleaders speak as though they're cheering all the time, even in ordinary conversation.

ApatheticStudent.name: Apathetic Student
ApatheticStudent.def: A character does not care about school or grades in the slightest.

AwkwardRelatableSchoolkid.name: Awkward Relatable Schoolkid
AwkwardRelatableSchoolkid.def: A dorky student who struggles to fit in at school.

BookSmart.name: Book Smart
BookSmart.def: A character is shown as being very academically competent.

Chuunibyou.name: Chuunibyou
Chuunibyou.def: A Junior High student who walks around acting like I Just Want to Be Special .

ClassClown.name: Class Clown
ClassClown.def: The one kid in the class who has to be the center of attention.

ClassPrincess.name: Class Princess
ClassPrincess.def: The most popular girl in school who is as sweet and nice as she is pretty and admired.

ClassRepresentative.name: Class Representative
ClassRepresentative.def: The student who leads the class in following all the school activities.

Delinquents.name: Delinquents
Delinquents.def: Students who are usually up to no good.

DorkHorseCandidate.name: Dork Horse Candidate
DorkHorseCandidate.def: Someone utterly unsuited for the student council leadership runs for it and wins.

ExtracurricularEnthusiast.name: Extracurricular Enthusiast
ExtracurricularEnthusiast.def: A student who's involved in loads of extracurricular activities.

ForeignExchangeStudent.name: Foreign Exchange Student
ForeignExchangeStudent.def: An exotic new student introduced as a source of comedy and/or drama.

FormerFriendOfAlphaBitch.name: Former Friend of Alpha Bitch
FormerFriendOfAlphaBitch.def: A character who used to be friends with the school's Alpha Bitch .

FratBro.name: Frat Bro
FratBro.def: A college-aged male who loves drinking , partying , and sex .

Goth.name: Goth
