PedalToTheMetalShot.def: A shot of a character's foot pressing the gas pedal all the way down.

PedestrianCrushesCar.name: Pedestrian Crushes Car
PedestrianCrushesCar.def: A pedestrian causes serious damage to a moving car while remaining unharmed.

PimpedOutCar.name: Pimped-Out Car
PimpedOutCar.def: A car with all the bells and whistles.

PitGirls.name: Pit Girls
PitGirls.def: An attractive woman at the races who performs ceremonial duties such as waving the starting flag or bringing a trophy to the winner.

PopTheTires.name: Pop the Tires
PopTheTires.def: Damaging a vehicle's tires in order to stop it.

PostApocalypticTrafficJam.name: Post-Apocalyptic Traffic Jam
PostApocalypticTrafficJam.def: After the apocalypse, the highways leading out of the cities are jammed with long-abandoned cars that were attempting to flee.

ThePreciousPreciousCar.name: The Precious, Precious Car
ThePreciousPreciousCar.def: A car is a character's most prized possession and they refuse to let anyone else touch it.

RamByBraking.name: Ram by Braking
RamByBraking.def: Stopping your vehicle abruptly to cause your pursuer to crash into you.

ResurrectTheWreck.name: Resurrect the Wreck
ResurrectTheWreck.def: An abandoned or derelict vehicle is restored to functioning.

RiceBurner.name: Rice Burner
RiceBurner.def: Officially, a cheap but fuel-efficient vehicle, often of Japanese origins. Unofficially, it's such a car that's been given modifications in an attempt to look cooler.

RidiculousVehicleTopper.name: Ridiculous Vehicle Topper
RidiculousVehicleTopper.def: A car equipped with an oversized and/or impractical ornament on the roof or the hood.

RidiculouslyInappropriateVehicle.name: Ridiculously Inappropriate Vehicle
RidiculouslyInappropriateVehicle.def: A character drives a misplaced vehicle out of necessity, lack of funds, etc. usually due to Rule of Funny .

RoadRage.name: Road Rage
RoadRage.def: What happens when a driver gets angry and decides to take it out on someone else on the road.

RockStarParking.name: Rock Star Parking
RockStarParking.def: The driver always gets the best parking spot.

RomanticRideSharing.name: Romantic Ride Sharing
RomanticRideSharing.def: Two characters bond by sharing a vehicle that holds only two (such as a horse or motorcycle), requiring them to be in close proximity.

RunningOverThePlot.name: Running Over the Plot
RunningOverThePlot.def: Someone is hit or run over by a car, kicking off the plot.

SafeDrivingAesop.name: Safe Driving Aesop
SafeDrivingAesop.def: The moral of the story emphases safe driving.

SentientVehicle.name: Sentient Vehicle
SentientVehicle.def: The car is aware of its occupants and surroundings.

StealingTheHandicappedSpot.name: Stealing the Handicapped Spot
StealingTheHandicappedSpot.def: An unauthorized person parks in a handicapped spot to show their disregard for others.

SunroofShenanigans.name: Sunroof Shenanigans
SunroofShenanigans.def: Using a sunroof to misbehave or have fun.

SurpriseCarCrash.name: Surprise Car Crash
SurpriseCarCrash.def: A car crash comes out of nowhere, taking the driver and the audience off-guard.

TakeTheWheel.name: Take the Wheel
TakeTheWheel.def: A driver decides he has something more important to do and orders a passenger to take the wheel.

TankGoodness.name: Tank Goodness
TankGoodness.def: A tank portrayed as the ultimate vehicle for defense.

TanksButNoTanks.name: Tanks, but No Tanks
TanksButNoTanks.def: Vehicles similar to (but not technically ) tanks are just referred to as tanks.

TheTaxi.name: The Taxi
TheTaxi.def: A taxi and/or its driver is an important or central element of the story.

ThatPoorCar.name: That Poor Car
ThatPoorCar.def: An event large enough to set off the alarms of multiple cars at once.

TechnicallyATransport.name: Technically a Transport
TechnicallyATransport.def: A civilian vehicle is upgraded to withstand an attack.

TourGuideGag.name: Tour Guide Gag
TourGuideGag.def: A tour guide describes an unusual event happening outside the vehicle to their cohort.

ToyotaTripwire.name: Toyota Tripwire
ToyotaTripwire.def: A person or vehicle crashes into a car door that opens suddenly.

TrappedInASinkingCar.name: Trapped in a Sinking Car
TrappedInASinkingCar.def: A character is trapped inside a vehicle as it goes underwater.

TrojanAmbulance.name: Trojan Ambulance
TrojanAmbulance.def: An ambulance is used for a purpose other than medical rescue, due to the fact that people in general do not attempt to hinder ambulances.

UnconventionalVehicleChase.name: Unconventional Vehicle Chase
UnconventionalVehicleChase.def: A chase using vehicles other than a standard car.

UnderTheTruck.name: Under the Truck
UnderTheTruck.def: A chase scene in which another, smaller vehicle is able to pass under a big rig.

VamooseFromTheVehicle.name: Vamoose from the Vehicle
VamooseFromTheVehicle.def: A character bails out of a vehicle while it's still in motion.

V8EngineNoises.name: V8 Engine Noises
V8EngineNoises.def: A vehicle's engine makes the distinctive V8 revving noise, even though it does not have a V8 engine.

VanInBlack.name: Van in Black
VanInBlack.def: A van used by a government agency for surveillance or a sting operation.

VanityLicensePlate.name: Vanity License Plate
VanityLicensePlate.def: A car has a specialty plate reflecting the personality of its owner.

VehicularAssault.name: Vehicular Assault
VehicularAssault.def: Using a vehicle as a weapon to harm others.

VehicleBasedCharacterization.name: Vehicle-Based Characterization
VehicleBasedCharacterization.def: The character's car reflects their personality.

VehicularKidnapping.name: Vehicular Kidnapping
VehicularKidnapping.def: Kidnappers throw their victim into a vehicle and drive away.

WatchThePaintJob.name: Watch the Paint Job
WatchThePaintJob.def: The likelihood of a car being damaged is inversely proportional to the owner's desire to keep it pristine.

WeaponizedCar.name: Weaponized Car
WeaponizedCar.def: A car is custom-fitted with weaponry.

WiperStart.name: Wiper Start
WiperStart.def: A driver attempts to start a car but only succeeds in turning on the wipers.

TheWorkhorse.name: The Workhorse
TheWorkhorse.def: A vehicle which, while not the newest, fanciest, or prettiest, is incredibly tough and reliable.

CapitalismIsBad.name: Capitalism Is Bad
CapitalismIsBad.def: "The lord of all, the money-god, who rules us blood and hand and brain."

TheInternet.name: The Internet
TheInternet.def: Take a spin, now you're in with the techno set You're going surfing on the Internet!

AIIsACrapshoot.name: A.I. Is a Crapshoot
AIIsACrapshoot.def: AI turns evil of its own accord.

BigBrotherIsWatching.name: Big Brother Is Watching
BigBrotherIsWatching.def: The government is listening to everything.

CorporateWarfare.name: Corporate Warfare
CorporateWarfare.def: Corporations possess armies, and use them to wage war on each other.

CyberneticFaceplate.name: Cybernetic Faceplate
CyberneticFaceplate.def: Replacing a big chunk of your face with cyberware makes you look tough and badass, but also less human.

CyberneticsEatYourSoul.name: Cybernetics Eat Your Soul
CyberneticsEatYourSoul.def: Mechanically upgrading the human body comes at a price.

CyberpunkForFlavor.name: Cyberpunk for Flavor
CyberpunkForFlavor.def: A story using cyberpunk tropes and themes, but not actually being cyberpunk.

DataDriveMacGuffin.name: Data Drive MacGuffin
DataDriveMacGuffin.def: The MacGuffin is a piece of data.

DoAndroidsDream.name: Do Androids Dream?
DoAndroidsDream.def: The question of whether robots can ever think and feel as humans do.

EverythingIsOnline.name: Everything Is Online
EverythingIsOnline.def: If it’s a computer, it can be hacked.

GoodProstheticEvilProsthetic.name: Good Prosthetic, Evil Prosthetic
GoodProstheticEvilProsthetic.def: Character alignment based on prosthesis type.

GreyAndGrayMorality.name: Grey-and-Gray Morality
GreyAndGrayMorality.def: Two neutral characters face each other.

IndustrializedEvil.name: Industrialized Evil
IndustrializedEvil.def: Evil deeds performed in a systematic, automated and impersonal manner, reducing victims to one more cog in the machine.

TheMadnessPlace.name: The Madness Place
TheMadnessPlace.def: The hyper-productive creative fugue state of the Mad Scientist .

PoliceState.name: Police State
PoliceState.def: The country is run by a bunch of Dirty Cops

TheSingularity.name: The Singularity
TheSingularity.def: A point in time where technological advancements are incomprehensible to anyone who came before.

SocietyIsToBlame.name: Society Is to Blame
SocietyIsToBlame.def: Society is the reason why everything is bad.

Technophobia.name: Technophobia
Technophobia.def: A character is terrified of technology.

WarForFunAndProfit.name: War for Fun and Profit
WarForFunAndProfit.def: A character or group starts a war for their own benefit.

WhatMeasureIsANonHuman.name: What Measure Is a Non-Human?
WhatMeasureIsANonHuman.def: When humans show little regard for the well-being of other (sapient) species .

YourMindMakesItReal.name: Your Mind Makes It Real
YourMindMakesItReal.def: Anything that happens in a dream/virtual reality happens in real life.

AdvertOverloadedFuture.name: Advert-Overloaded Future
AdvertOverloadedFuture.def: This list is sponsored by Trope Co. .!

Arcology.name: Arcology
Arcology.def: A style of architecture that’s supposed to be self sustaining.

BlackMarket.name: Black Market
BlackMarket.def: A hidden store that sells illicit items.

ChemicalMessiah.name: Chemical Messiah
ChemicalMessiah.def: A drug is seen as a salvation.

CityPlanet.name: City Planet
CityPlanet.def: A city that’s the size of a planet.

CrapsackWorldEscapistSanctuary.name: Crapsack World, Escapist Sanctuary
CrapsackWorldEscapistSanctuary.def: Terrible world, but there’s a good way of escaping it.

EvilInc.name: Evil, Inc.
EvilInc.def: A company that is solely dedicated to evil.

ExtremeSpeculativeStratification.name: Extreme Speculative Stratification
ExtremeSpeculativeStratification.def: Racial and/or social inequality gets so extreme, new cultures form.

HackerCollective.name: Hacker Collective
HackerCollective.def: In Real Life as well as fiction, there are Mad Scientists , hackers and crackers, white hats and black hats who can penetrate the firewall(s) of everything from the local high school to the Pentagon, to even terrorists and cults with little more than a keyboard ( or two ) and their own l33t skillz.

HiveCity.name: Hive City
HiveCity.def: May or may not be a Wretched Hive .

MegaCorp.name: MegaCorp
MegaCorp.def: Massive billionaire corporations with tons of power.

NeonCity.name: Neon City
NeonCity.def: "Sinner's Row was a part of town that never slept.

NightmarishFactory.name: Nightmarish Factory
NightmarishFactory.def: "Moloch, whose breast is a cannibal dynamo!"

PrivateMilitaryContractors.name: Private Military Contractors
PrivateMilitaryContractors.def: Tagon: Mister Grizzly, my men and I may not be nice people, but we're not bad people.

ShinyNewAustralia.name: Shiny New Australia
ShinyNewAustralia.def: "And she may cry but her tears will dry When I hand her the keys to a shiny new Australia!" — Dr.

ArtificialHuman.name: Artificial Human
ArtificialHuman.def: Ripley: You never said anything about an android being on board, why not?!

ArtificialIntelligence.name: Artificial Intelligence
ArtificialIntelligence.def: A program designed to simulate complex human thought. May or may not actually be sentient .

BlackMarketProduce.name: Black Market Produce
BlackMarketProduce.def: In many stories set in a Crapsack World where civilians subsist on nothing else but Poverty Food , synthetic substitutes , and adulterated foods , a character is shown buying fresh food in the Black Market for an exorbitant price.

BrainTransplant.name: Brain Transplant
BrainTransplant.def: A mind is a terrible thing to cut-and-paste.

BrainUploading.name: Brain Uploading
BrainUploading.def: Storing one's consciousness and memories as data.

CloningBodyParts.name: Cloning Body Parts
CloningBodyParts.def: Manufacturing replacement body parts by cloning.

CryoPrison.name: Cryo-Prison
CryoPrison.def: "This is not the production of Batman on Ice I was expecting!" "In cryo, you don't dream at all." — Jake Sully , Avatar (2009)

Cyborg.name: Cyborg
Cyborg.def: Full-Conversion Cyborg : A human whose body has been almost completely replaced with mechanical parts.

DesignerBabies.name: Designer Babies
DesignerBabies.def: Gene editing enables parents to create their own children piece by piece.

DroneDeployer.name: Drone Deployer
DroneDeployer.def: Say hello to my little friends!

FantasticDrug.name: Fantastic Drug
FantasticDrug.def: Now with 100% less nausea, car crashes, and feeling of thickness!

LiteralDataTransfer.name: Literal Data Transfer
LiteralDataTransfer.def: Either this trope is in play, or Cortana was feeling particularly committed to the Cole Protocol .

MagicalComputer.name: Magical Computer
MagicalComputer.def: " Hollywood thinks that computers run on black magic and hackers are wizards."

OnlineAlias.name: Online Alias
OnlineAlias.def: The Internet: Where you find yourself saying things like, "Ass Dan and Whackadoodle are right." — Shaenon Garrity , Narbonic

RapidDNATest.name: Rapid DNA Test
RapidDNATest.def: DNA tests performed faster than possible in current times.

TransformationHorror.name: Transformation Horror
TransformationHorror.def: Particularly common in Japanese cyberpunk works.

UnusualUserInterface.name: Unusual User Interface
UnusualUserInterface.def: Pictured: The DataHand , a supposedly ergonomic keyboard designed to limit wrist movement.

VirtualGhost.name: Virtual Ghost
VirtualGhost.def: Star Wars holograms and Force ghosts are both pale blue.

VirtualRealityWarper.name: Virtual-Reality Warper
VirtualRealityWarper.def: "When the Matrix was first built, there was a man born inside who had the ability to change whatever he wanted, to remake the Matrix as he saw fit.

WeirdlyUnderpoweredAdmins.name: Weirdly Underpowered Admins
WeirdlyUnderpoweredAdmins.def: In Real Life , administrators of online games and other systems like forums or servers are generally absolute in power, with access to a suite of commands to instantly kill, delete or ban players/users, and control them in other ways.

WetwareCPU.name: Wetware CPU
WetwareCPU.def: Karan's not a Spaceship Girl , but she does come very close .

TheCracker.name: The Cracker
TheCracker.def: Hackette : The Cracker turns out to be female.

CyberNinja.name: Cyber Ninja
CyberNinja.def: Traditional ninjutsu made deadlier by futuristic cyborg technology.

DigitizedHacker.name: Digitized Hacker
DigitizedHacker.def: "In my mind's eye, I unearth a tangled roadmap of interfaces, switches, routers and conduits.

TheFixer.name: The Fixer
TheFixer.def: "And do you know what a fixer does?

PlayfulHacker.name: Playful Hacker
PlayfulHacker.def: And here we see Cowboy BeBop at His Computer .

PrivateDetective.name: Private Detective
PrivateDetective.def: Will the real Sam Spade please stand up?

RobotMaster.name: Robot Master
RobotMaster.def: All my machines are made for destruction I will build my empire I will succeed and you will see With my machines there is no retreat!

TheStateless.name: The Stateless
TheStateless.def: "The calamity of the rightless is not that they are deprived of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness, or of equality before the law and freedom of opinion — formulas which were designed to solve problems within given communities—but that they no longer belong to any community whatsoever." — H

CyberGreen.name: Cyber Green
CyberGreen.def: Green and black are the colors of the digital world.

CyberpunkIsTechno.name: Cyberpunk Is Techno
CyberpunkIsTechno.def: Most Uprisers augment their bodies for speed, strength, or protection, but a few just want to be one with the music.

CyberpunkWithAChanceOfRain.name: Cyberpunk with a Chance of Rain

MechanicalMuscles.name: Mechanical Muscles
MechanicalMuscles.def: Robots who appear to have muscles.

TechnologyPorn.name: Technology Porn
TechnologyPorn.def: Oooh, baby, you know just how to put me together...

UsedFuture.name: Used Future
UsedFuture.def: Their ship is our dear Bebop ; And she's seen better days...

FourTwentyBlazeIt.name: 420, Blaze It
FourTwentyBlazeIt.def: The number 420 is associated with cannabis.

AddictionDisplacement.name: Addiction Displacement
AddictionDisplacement.def: A person ends their addiction simply by becoming addicted to something else.

AddictionPowered.name: Addiction-Powered
AddictionPowered.def: A person who gains powers by abusing their own drug abuse.

AddictionRealization.name: Addiction Realization
AddictionRealization.def: The moment when a character realizes that they have a serious problem.

AddictionSong.name: Addiction Song
AddictionSong.def: A song about drug abuse and addiction.

AddictiveMagic.name: Addictive Magic
AddictiveMagic.def: Where casting spells (or just having a magic power) gets you high.

AddledAddict.name: Addled Addict
AddledAddict.def: When an addict (former or current) is clearly struggling in life.

AlcoholInducedIdiocy.name: Alcohol-Induced Idiocy
AlcoholInducedIdiocy.def: A person ends up doing stupid things after being inebriated.

AlienCatnip.name: Alien Catnip
AlienCatnip.def: Something that aliens go crazy for, often stuff that is mundane to us humans.

AnthropomorphicVice.name: Anthropomorphic Vice
AnthropomorphicVice.def: Addictive substances are personified or anthropomorphized.

ArtisticStimulation.name: Artistic Stimulation
ArtisticStimulation.def: Using drugs to be creative in the arts.

BingeMontage.name: Binge Montage
BingeMontage.def: A montage sequence that shows people getting drunk and/ or high.

BottledHeroicResolve.name: Bottled Heroic Resolve
BottledHeroicResolve.def: A normally heroic Hollywood health pack that often comes with undesired side effects.

CaffeineFailure.name: Caffeine Failure
CaffeineFailure.def: When not even coffee can keep you awake for a task at hand.

ChemicallyInducedInsanity.name: Chemically Induced Insanity
ChemicallyInducedInsanity.def: Intentionally inducing a desired effect onto another person (does not have to be madness).

CigaretteOfAnxiety.name: Cigarette of Anxiety
CigaretteOfAnxiety.def: When a smoke is needed in a highly stressful situation.

ClandestineChemist.name: Clandestine Chemist
ClandestineChemist.def: Someone educated in chemistry decides to use their knowledge for illegal purposes, often the creation of drugs.

ColdTurkeysAreEverywhere.name: Cold Turkeys Are Everywhere
ColdTurkeysAreEverywhere.def: Seeing the very thing you're trying to give up everywhere around you, no matter how improbable.

CombatDrugs.name: Combat Drugs
CombatDrugs.def: When drugs are consumed to give an edge or courage in battle.

ComfortFood.name: Comfort Food
ComfortFood.def: Where binge-eating lots of food in one sitting is the high of choice.

ConcussionsGetYouHigh.name: Concussions Get You High
ConcussionsGetYouHigh.def: Getting hit on the head will have you act like you're on drugs.

ContemplatingYourHands.name: Contemplating Your Hands
ContemplatingYourHands.def: Getting high and questioning your hands, wondering about what their (very obvious) purpose is.

TheDarkSide.name: The Dark Side
TheDarkSide.def: An evil moral stance becomes addictive.

DemographicallyInappropriateHumour.name: Demographically Inappropriate Humour
DemographicallyInappropriateHumour.def: When a work made for a younger audience makes a joke about drugs or something else inappropriate.

DescentIntoAddiction.name: Descent into Addiction
DescentIntoAddiction.def: A character's journey from normal to an addicted mess.

DramaticallyDelayedDrug.name: Dramatically Delayed Drug
DramaticallyDelayedDrug.def: A drug doesn't work until it's most dramatic — or inconvenient.

DruggedLipstick.name: Drugged Lipstick
DruggedLipstick.def: There's really something in that kiss that makes you feel like you're under somebody's spell.

DrugsAreBad.name: Drugs Are Bad
DrugsAreBad.def: The story's moral is that drugs are very bad for you and should be avoided at all costs.

DrugsAreGood.name: Drugs Are Good
DrugsAreGood.def: The story's moral is that drugs are good for you, and are nothing to be afraid of trying.

DrugsCausingSlowMotion.name: Drugs Causing Slow-Motion
DrugsCausingSlowMotion.def: The surrounding world "slows down" when someone is on drugs.

DrunkOnMilk.name: Drunk on Milk
DrunkOnMilk.def: Getting drunk on a substance that, by all rights, should be impossible to get drunk on.

DrunkenMaster.name: Drunken Master
DrunkenMaster.def: Getting hammered makes you good at hammering bad guys...or with a hammer in a workshop.

DrunkenMontage.name: Drunken Montage
DrunkenMontage.def: A clip montage of people getting drunk.

EternalProhibition.name: Eternal Prohibition
EternalProhibition.def: The prohibition continues on into the future, where very few, if any, drugs are allowed.

EverybodyMustGetStoned.name: Everybody Must Get Stoned
EverybodyMustGetStoned.def: When a group of people get stoned, often by accident.

EvilTastesGood.name: Evil Tastes Good
EvilTastesGood.def: Drugs often get described as tasting of evil by evil characters; a lot of overlap exists here.

FakeHigh.name: Fake High
FakeHigh.def: A person falls under a placebo effect, usually by being given a non-drug substance in place of a drug.

FiendingForAFix.name: Fiending for a Fix
FiendingForAFix.def: Addicts become dangerous or unscrupulous because they're acting on cravings or suffering from withdrawal.

FingertipDrugAnalysis.name: Fingertip Drug Analysis
FingertipDrugAnalysis.def: An old-timey way of determining what the drug is by an on-site taste test.

GargleBlaster.name: Gargle Blaster
GargleBlaster.def: An alcoholic drink so powerful that it makes the person who drank it either get absolutely hammered or instantly pass out.

GettingHighOnTheirOwnSupply.name: Getting High on Their Own Supply
GettingHighOnTheirOwnSupply.def: Exactly what it sounds like, a drug dealer partaking in the drugs they don't sell.

GoingColdTurkey.name: Going Cold Turkey
GoingColdTurkey.def: Trying to get off the substance you're addicted to.

GoodFlawsBadFlaws.name: Good Flaws, Bad Flaws
GoodFlawsBadFlaws.def: Giving flaws to a previously flawless character (like a drug addiction).

GoodSmokingEvilSmoking.name: Good Smoking, Evil Smoking
GoodSmokingEvilSmoking.def: Those that smoke are bad, except in instances where that isn't the case.

GovernmentDrugEnforcement.name: Government Drug Enforcement
GovernmentDrugEnforcement.def: The Powers That Be are forcing you to use drugs (often psychoactive ones).

GRatedDrug.name: G-Rated Drug
GRatedDrug.def: A harmless consumable substance is depicted as having the same properties as a drug.

GRatedStoner.name: G-Rated Stoner
GRatedStoner.def: A character that acts like a stoner, sans any presence of drugs.

HeartbreakAndIceCream.name: Heartbreak and Ice Cream
HeartbreakAndIceCream.def: Someone being dumped has ice cream to make them feel better.

HigherUnderstandingThroughDrugs.name: Higher Understanding Through Drugs
HigherUnderstandingThroughDrugs.def: Getting smarter through drugs, or dealing with a foreign fantastical concept with drugs.

HighOnHomicide.name: High on Homicide
HighOnHomicide.def: Getting high on a specific killing.

HighTimesFuture.name: High Times Future
HighTimesFuture.def: A future (or alternate timeline) where all recreational drugs are legal.

ImmuneToDrugs.name: Immune to Drugs
ImmuneToDrugs.def: Somebody who's impervious to the pills and the powder.

ImpairmentShot.name: Impairment Shot
ImpairmentShot.def: A camera shot to show someone being drugged, drunk, poisoned, injured, etc.

IntoxicatedSuperpowerSnag.name: Intoxicated Superpower Snag
IntoxicatedSuperpowerSnag.def: Drugs have very interesting effects on supernatural powers.

IntoxicationMechanic.name: Intoxication Mechanic
IntoxicationMechanic.def: The player character in a video game consuming drugs (or alcohol) causes an Interface Screw which hinders the player's ability to play the game.

ItsSnowingCocaine.name: It's Snowing Cocaine
ItsSnowingCocaine.def: Cocaine is shown in large (unrealistic) quantities.

JackUpWithPhlebotinum.name: Jack up with Phlebotinum
JackUpWithPhlebotinum.def: Accidentally using what a person thinks is a drug they crave, only for it to go wrong.

JunkieProphet.name: Junkie Prophet
JunkieProphet.def: A drunk or addict who uses drugs to foresee events.

KlatchianCoffee.name: Klatchian Coffee
KlatchianCoffee.def: Coffee so high in caffeine that just one cup is enough to make you very jittery.

LiquidCourage.name: Liquid Courage
LiquidCourage.def: Drinking to curb social awkwardness and increase confidence.

LoveIsADrug.name: Love Is a Drug
LoveIsADrug.def: Love is depicted to have addictive qualities similar to drugs.

MagicMushroom.name: Magic Mushroom
MagicMushroom.def: Fantastical (often magical) drugs with hallucinogenic effects.

MarijuanaIsLSD.name: Marijuana Is LSD
MarijuanaIsLSD.def: The effects of certain drugs are overblown for the sake of drama or comedy.

MistakenForJunkie.name: Mistaken for Junkie
MistakenForJunkie.def: Someone mistakes a person for an addict.

MonsterOrganTrafficking.name: Monster Organ Trafficking
MonsterOrganTrafficking.def: Profiting off of a monster's parts. Sometimes, the parts are or can be transformed into psychedelic substances.

MothersLittleHelpers.name: Mother's Little Helpers
MothersLittleHelpers.def: A woman becomes addicted to pills, usually prescription pills.

NailedToTheWagon.name: Nailed to the Wagon
NailedToTheWagon.def: Locking someone away until their addiction expires.

NoMedicationForMe.name: No Medication for Me
NoMedicationForMe.def: Losing a part of yourself when you take medication.

NoSmoking.name: No Smoking
NoSmoking.def: A form of censorship that replaces cigarettes with other things (often gum or lollipops).

OdeToIntoxication.name: Ode to Intoxication
OdeToIntoxication.def: Songs that celebrate getting high or buzzed on something, including drugs.

OdeToSobriety.name: Ode to Sobriety
OdeToSobriety.def: Songs that celebrate non-consumption of drugs.

OfCourseISmoke.name: Of Course I Smoke
OfCourseISmoke.def: Person who normally doesn't smoke tries to make it appear that they do smoke.

OffTheWagon.name: Off the Wagon
OffTheWagon.def: A reformed character returning to their original vice.

OneDrinkWillKillTheBaby.name: One Drink Will Kill the Baby
OneDrinkWillKillTheBaby.def: Pregnant mothers shouldn't drink, lest the alcohol they consume ends up harming the baby.

PhlebotinumPills.name: Phlebotinum Pills
PhlebotinumPills.def: These pills give you special powers and/or abilities.

PlayingDrunk.name: Playing Drunk
PlayingDrunk.def: Sober people making it look like they've done a few drinks.

PostStressOvereating.name: Post-Stress Overeating
PostStressOvereating.def: Someone overeating in an attempt to reduce stress.

PowerHigh.name: Power High
PowerHigh.def: Gaining power is treated like being on drugs.

PsychoSerum.name: Psycho Serum
PsychoSerum.def: A serum that makes people go insane.

PukingUnderTheInfluence.name: Puking Under The Influence
PukingUnderTheInfluence.def: A character vomits due to the effects of drugs on their body.

QuickNip.name: Quick Nip
QuickNip.def: Someone casually takes a quick sip of alcohol without interrupting what they're doing.

RepulsiveRoids.name: Repulsive 'Roids
RepulsiveRoids.def: Users of anabolic steroids are portrayed as outcasts.

SexDrugsAndRockAndRoll.name: Sex, Drugs, and Rock & Roll
SexDrugsAndRockAndRoll.def: The three popular ingredients of a rock star.

SlippingAMickey.name: Slipping a Mickey
SlippingAMickey.def: Putting a little something in somebody's drink to get them to fall asleep or be unconscious.

SmokingIsCool.name: Smoking Is Cool
SmokingIsCool.def: When smoking makes you look like a badass.

SmokingIsNotCool.name: Smoking Is Not Cool
SmokingIsNotCool.def: When smoking makes you look like a total ass.

SmugStraightEdge.name: Smug Straight Edge
SmugStraightEdge.def: The Straight Edge will not hesitate to rub their views in people's faces, especially those of actual drug users.

SpiceOfLife.name: Spice of Life

FromRoommatesToRomance.name: From Roommates to Romance
FromRoommatesToRomance.def: Love blossoms between two people who live together as a result of their close contact.

GardenOfLove.name: Garden of Love
GardenOfLove.def: Gardens as a setting for love to take root, grow, and blossom.

GaussianGirl.name: Gaussian Girl
GaussianGirl.def: A visual effect where the (usually female) Love Interest is given a blurry, ethereal look.

GenderBenderFriendship.name: Gender-Bender Friendship
GenderBenderFriendship.def: Character befriends their Love Interest while masquerading as the opposite sex.

TheGentleRejection.name: The Gentle Rejection
TheGentleRejection.def: Someone turns down a Love Confession in a gentle and kind manner.

TheGentlemanOrTheScoundrel.name: The Gentleman or the Scoundrel
TheGentlemanOrTheScoundrel.def: A woman's two choices for a Love Interest are the polite Nice Guy and the dangerous, more thrilling bad boy.

GhostShipping.name: Ghost Shipping
GhostShipping.def: Fans pair a living character with one who is dead.

GibberishOfLove.name: Gibberish of Love
GibberishOfLove.def: Being unable to speak in complete sentences when around your Love Interest .

GirlOfMyDreams.name: Girl of My Dreams
GirlOfMyDreams.def: First encountering your Love Interest in your dreams.

GiveGeeksAChance.name: Give Geeks a Chance
GiveGeeksAChance.def: Nerds are given a chance at love.

TheGlomp.name: The Glomp
TheGlomp.def: Tackling and hugging your Love Interest tightly.

GrandRomanticGesture.name: Grand Romantic Gesture
GrandRomanticGesture.def: A big, elaborate event done for someone to show your love for them.

GreenEyedEpiphany.name: Green-Eyed Epiphany
GreenEyedEpiphany.def: Realizing you love someone when seeing them with someone else upsets you.

GrowOldWithMe.name: Grow Old with Me
GrowOldWithMe.def: Lovers stay together to old age.

HairMemento.name: Hair Memento
HairMemento.def: A character cutting a piece of their hair and giving it away to someone they love (this can be any kind of love).

HandsOnApproach.name: Hands-On Approach
HandsOnApproach.def: Ship Tease moment where someone gets really close to their Love Interest while teaching them how to use something.

HandsPlayInTheater.name: Handsplay in Theater
HandsPlayInTheater.def: Putting your arm around your Love Interest while you two are at the movies.

HankyPankyWithTheHelp.name: Hanky-Panky with the Help
HankyPankyWithTheHelp.def: A rich person falls in love with one of their servants.

HappilyMarried.name: Happily Married
HappilyMarried.def: A married couple who are happy together.

HappinessInSlavery.name: Happiness in Slavery
HappinessInSlavery.def: Being happy to serve somebody because you love them.

HaremSeeker.name: Harem Seeker
HaremSeeker.def: A character who seeks to gain multiple lovers.

HeadbuttThermometer.name: Headbutt Thermometer
HeadbuttThermometer.def: Ship Tease moment where a character checks their Love Interest 's temperature by pressing their forehead against theirs.

HeartBeatDown.name: Heart Beat-Down
HeartBeatDown.def: Using the Heart Symbol , the quintessential symbol of love, as a weapon.

HeartIsWhereTheHomeIs.name: Heart Is Where the Home Is
HeartIsWhereTheHomeIs.def: Turning down a foreign Love Interest in favor of a local lover.

HeldGaze.name: Held Gaze
HeldGaze.def: Lovers look deeply into each other's eyes.

HerBoyfriendsJacket.name: Her Boyfriend's Jacket
HerBoyfriendsJacket.def: Character wears an article of their significant other's clothing.

HerosSlaveHarem.name: Hero's Slave Harem
HerosSlaveHarem.def: A hero has multiple slaves that are in love with them.

HoldingHands.name: Holding Hands
HoldingHands.def: A classic romantic gesture is lovers locking hands with each other.

HollywoodKiss.name: Hollywood Kiss
HollywoodKiss.def: When couples kiss in fiction, it's always perfect.

HomeSweetHome.name: Home Sweet Home
HomeSweetHome.def: Staying home to settle down with your Love Interest after a long adventure.

HookedUpAfterwards.name: Hooked Up Afterwards
HookedUpAfterwards.def: At the end of the story, two characters are shown to have started dating.

HopelessSuitor.name: Hopeless Suitor
HopelessSuitor.def: One who has no chance of winning someone's love.

HugeGuyTinyGirl.name: Huge Guy, Tiny Girl
HugeGuyTinyGirl.def: A couple where the man towers over the woman.

HypocriticalHeartwarming.name: Hypocritical Heartwarming
HypocriticalHeartwarming.def: Someone who regularly antagonizes their significant other gets enraged if someone else wrongs them.

ICantBelieveAGuyLikeYouWouldNoticeMe.name: I Can't Believe a Guy Like You Would Notice Me
ICantBelieveAGuyLikeYouWouldNoticeMe.def: A character is surprised to learn that their crush actually loves them back.

IDidntMeanToTurnYouOn.name: I Didn't Mean to Turn You On
IDidntMeanToTurnYouOn.def: Unintentionally making someone fall in love with you.

IDontWantToRuinOurFriendship.name: I Don't Want to Ruin Our Friendship
IDontWantToRuinOurFriendship.def: Two people who are good friends refuse to get romantically involved with each other on the grounds that their friendship would go south.

IGotYouADrawer.name: I Got You a Drawer
IGotYouADrawer.def: Two characters are signaled to be getting a Relationship Upgrade when one partner gives the other partner a space in their home to put their stuff.

ILoveYouBecauseICantControlYou.name: I Love You Because I Can't Control You
ILoveYouBecauseICantControlYou.def: The Casanova falls in love with someone who rejects their advances.

TheILoveYouStigma.name: The "I Love You" Stigma
TheILoveYouStigma.def: Using the word "love" around your significant other too soon can cause them discomfort.

ILoveYouVampireSon.name: I Love You, Vampire Son
ILoveYouVampireSon.def: A vampire turns their lover into a vampire so the two of them can have Eternal Love together.

ImaginaryLoveTriangle.name: Imaginary Love Triangle
ImaginaryLoveTriangle.def: Characters are mistakenly assumed to be involved in a love triangle.

ImaginedInnuendo.name: Imagined Innuendo
ImaginedInnuendo.def: A character's dialogue is misinterpreted as a Double Entendre by another.

ImpliedLoveInterest.name: Implied Love Interest
ImpliedLoveInterest.def: This character has vaguely romantic subtext with The Hero .

IncestStandardsAreRelative.name: Incest Standards Are Relative
IncestStandardsAreRelative.def: A romantic relationship is seen as incestuous due to different culture norms.

IncompatibleOrientation.name: Incompatible Orientation
IncompatibleOrientation.def: Two people can't be together because of their differing sexualities.

IndirectKiss.name: Indirect Kiss
IndirectKiss.def: Two people share the same bite or drink as if they're kissing.

InLoveWithLove.name: In Love with Love
InLoveWithLove.def: Being more enamored by the idea of being in a relationship than actually loving someone.

InLoveWithTheGangstersGirl.name: In Love with the Gangster's Girl
InLoveWithTheGangstersGirl.def: The Hero loves a dangerous man's girlfriend.

InLoveWithTheMark.name: In Love with the Mark
InLoveWithTheMark.def: A Professional Killer falls in love with the target they're supposed to kill.

InLoveWithYourCarnage.name: In Love with Your Carnage
InLoveWithYourCarnage.def: A villainous or morally ambiguous character falls for someone because of their violent tendencies.

InsecureLoveInterest.name: Insecure Love Interest
InsecureLoveInterest.def: A character who believes themself to be unworthy of their Love Interest .

InterabledRelationshipStigma.name: Interabled Relationship Stigma
InterabledRelationshipStigma.def: Relationships between disabled and non-disabled people are stigmatized.

InterruptedDeclarationOfLove.name: Interrupted Declaration of Love
InterruptedDeclarationOfLove.def: Character tries to confess their love for somebody but is interrupted.

IntertwinedFingers.name: Intertwined Fingers
IntertwinedFingers.def: Two people lock fingers with each other, showing that they're in love.

IntimateLotionApplication.name: Intimate Lotion Application
IntimateLotionApplication.def: Applying lotion on another character as a way to create sexual tension, romantic intimacy, awkwardness, or humor.

ItDoesntMeanAnything.name: It Doesn't Mean Anything
ItDoesntMeanAnything.def: Characters who are Just Friends do something intimate with each other and then insist that it was nothing.

ItsNotYouItsMe.name: It's Not You, It's Me
ItsNotYouItsMe.def: Breaking off a relationship due to feeling unworthy of your Love Interest .

ItsNotYouItsMyEnemies.name: It's Not You, It's My Enemies
ItsNotYouItsMyEnemies.def: Being with your lover puts them in harm's way.

IUhYouToo.name: I "Uh" You, Too
IUhYouToo.def: A character fumbles their words when they try to say "I love you" to their Love Interest .

IWantMyBelovedToBeFashionable.name: I Want My Beloved to Be Fashionable
IWantMyBelovedToBeFashionable.def: One partner (usually a woman) tries to give their partner a makeover.

IWantMyBelovedToBeHappy.name: I Want My Beloved to Be Happy
IWantMyBelovedToBeHappy.def: Being willing to let your unrequited crush go be with the one they love.

JumpingTheGenderBarrier.name: Jumping the Gender Barrier
JumpingTheGenderBarrier.def: A character's sexual preferences change when they undergo a Gender Bender .

JustFriends.name: Just Friends
JustFriends.def: Two people consider themselves to be only good friends rather than lovers.

KissedKeepsake.name: Kissed Keepsake
KissedKeepsake.def: Not wanting to wash a part of your body that was kissed by your crush.

KissingInATree.name: K-I-S-S-I-N-G in a Tree
KissingInATree.def: Childishly mocking people who are in a relationship or seem to be in a relationship.

LaceratingLoveLanguage.name: Lacerating Love Language
LaceratingLoveLanguage.def: Expressing your affection through physical violence.

LadykillerInLove.name: Ladykiller in Love
LadykillerInLove.def: The Casanova who genuinely falls in love.

TheLadysFavour.name: The Lady's Favour
TheLadysFavour.def: A woman gives her Love Interest an item of hers before he goes off into battle.

LapPillow.name: Lap Pillow
LapPillow.def: Ship Tease moment where a character rests their head on their Love Interest 's lap.

LastConfessionWins.name: Last Confession Wins
LastConfessionWins.def: In a Harem Genre story, the last girl to reveal that she loves the lead is who wins him.

LastGirlWins.name: Last Girl Wins
LastGirlWins.def: The lead hooks up with the last person they meet in the story.

LastHetRomance.name: Last Het Romance
LastHetRomance.def: A character realizes that they're gay after a failed heterosexual relationship.

LastMinuteHookup.name: Last-Minute Hookup
LastMinuteHookup.def: Two characters don't become an Official Couple until the end of the story.

LaughOfLove.name: Laugh of Love
LaughOfLove.def: The tendency to laugh when in the presence of your Love Interest .

LaundromatLiaisons.name: Laundromat Liaisons
LaundromatLiaisons.def: Two characters meet at a laundromat and eventually hook up.

LeaveTheTwoLovebirdsAlone.name: Leave the Two Lovebirds Alone
LeaveTheTwoLovebirdsAlone.def: Leaving a room so two lovers can have some alone time.

LeavingYouToFindMyself.name: Leaving You to Find Myself
LeavingYouToFindMyself.def: Character breaks off a love relationship to go do some soul searching.

LetsJustBeFriends.name: Let's Just Be Friends
LetsJustBeFriends.def: Characters break up, but decide to remain friends because they still care about each other.

LifeSavingEncouragement.name: Life-Saving Encouragement
LifeSavingEncouragement.def: A statement of hope/encouragement saves a person literally or spiritually.

LikeAnOldMarriedCouple.name: Like an Old Married Couple
LikeAnOldMarriedCouple.def: These two people are very close and tend to bicker with each other.

LikeBrotherAndSister.name: Like Brother and Sister
LikeBrotherAndSister.def: These two see themselves like siblings rather than as lovers.

LikeGoesWithLike.name: Like Goes with Like
LikeGoesWithLike.def: Characters tend to fall in love with those of the same race as them.

LikeParentLikeSpouse.name: Like Parent, Like Spouse
LikeParentLikeSpouse.def: A character's Love Interest is similar to one of their parents, be it in looks or personality.

LiterallyLovingThyNeighbor.name: Literally Loving Thy Neighbor
LiterallyLovingThyNeighbor.def: Falling in love with your neighbor.

LittleSisterHeroine.name: Little Sister Heroine
LittleSisterHeroine.def: A character's little sister serves as a Love Interest option.

LonelyTogether.name: Lonely Together
LonelyTogether.def: Two lonely characters bond and fall in love.

LongDistanceRelationship.name: Long-Distance Relationship
LongDistanceRelationship.def: Characters who are far away from each other have a romance.

LongingLook.name: Longing Look
LongingLook.def: Glancing at your Love Interest in a yearning way.

LostLoveMontage.name: Lost Love Montage
LostLoveMontage.def: A character sadly looks back on an ex-lover.

LoveAcrossBattlelines.name: Love Across Battlelines
LoveAcrossBattlelines.def: Characters from enemy factions fall in love.

LoveAllegory.name: Love Allegory
LoveAllegory.def: A story used to symbolize a love relationship.

LoveAtFirstNote.name: Love at First Note
LoveAtFirstNote.def: Falling in love with somebody when you hear them sing.

LoveAtFirstPunch.name: Love at First Punch
LoveAtFirstPunch.def: Falling in love with somebody who beat you up.

LoveAtFirstSight.name: Love at First Sight
LoveAtFirstSight.def: Falling in love with somebody the moment you see them.

LoveBeALady.name: Love Be a Lady
LoveBeALady.def: A girl, or girls as a whole, used as representatives for the concept of love.

LoveBeforeFirstSight.name: Love Before First Sight
LoveBeforeFirstSight.def: Falling in love with somebody before you even see them.

LoveBubbles.name: Love Bubbles
LoveBubbles.def: An anime/manga effect where the background fills with sparkly bubbles during a love scene.

LoveCanMakeYouGonk.name: Love Can Make You Gonk
LoveCanMakeYouGonk.def: Love causes a character to have cartoonishly exaggerated reactions.

LoveCannotOvercome.name: Love Cannot Overcome
LoveCannotOvercome.def: The Hero 's Love Interest breaks up with them because they can't handle their adventurous lifestyle.

LoveChart.name: Love Chart
LoveChart.def: A chart that details the characters' relationships with each other.

LoveConfession.name: Love Confession
LoveConfession.def: Character confesses their love for another.

LovedINotHonorMore.name: Loved I Not Honor More
LovedINotHonorMore.def: The Hero puts their duty before their love life.

LoveDodecahedron.name: Love Dodecahedron
LoveDodecahedron.def: Several characters are connected to each other romantically.

LovedOnesMontage.name: Loved Ones Montage
LovedOnesMontage.def: A character has a vision of all the people he cares about in a dramatic montage-like sequence.

LoveDoodles.name: Love Doodles
LoveDoodles.def: Drawing love symbols and writing initials and names, indicating someone has a secret crush.

LoveEpiphany.name: Love Epiphany
LoveEpiphany.def: Realizing that you're in love with somebody.

LoveFloats.name: Love Floats
LoveFloats.def: Feelings of love cause a character to levitate off the ground.

LoveFreak.name: Love Freak
LoveFreak.def: Character who is obsessed with the concept of love.

LoveHotels.name: Love Hotels
LoveHotels.def: A hotel building where couples can be intimate with each other.

LoveHungry.name: Love Hungry
LoveHungry.def: A character desperate for love tries to force people to love them.

LoveImbuesLife.name: Love Imbues Life
LoveImbuesLife.def: Feelings of love cause an inanimate object to come alive.

LoveInterestVsLustInterest.name: Love Interest vs. Lust Interest
LoveInterestVsLustInterest.def: Two people like the same person, one out of love and the other out of superficial feelings.

LoveIsAWeakness.name: Love Is a Weakness
LoveIsAWeakness.def: Love is regarded as a negative influence.

LoveIsInTheAir.name: Love Is in the Air
LoveIsInTheAir.def: A Love Potion affects a bunch of people.

LoveLetterLunacy.name: Love Letter Lunacy
LoveLetterLunacy.def: A Love Letter causes a ruckus.

LoveMakesYouCrazy.name: Love Makes You Crazy
LoveMakesYouCrazy.def: Falling in love makes you lose your mind.

LoveMakesYouDumb.name: Love Makes You Dumb
LoveMakesYouDumb.def: Falling in love causes poor judgment.

LoveMakesYouSaner.name: Love Makes You Saner
LoveMakesYouSaner.def: A mentally troubled person becomes more stable because of love.

LoveMakesYouUncreative.name: Love Makes You Uncreative
LoveMakesYouUncreative.def: An artist falling in love causes their work to decline in quality.

LoveNostalgiaSong.name: Love Nostalgia Song
LoveNostalgiaSong.def: A song about looking back on a past love relationship.

LoveOverridesTheLaw.name: Love Overrides the Law
LoveOverridesTheLaw.def: When you're in love, even the law can't stand in your way.

LovePotion.name: Love Potion
LovePotion.def: A magic potion that makes a person fall in love.

LoveMagicsBitterAftertaste.name: Love Magic's Bitter Aftertaste
LoveMagicsBitterAftertaste.def: Using magical and/or scientific means to force love inevitably backfires

LoveRedeems.name: Love Redeems
LoveRedeems.def: Someone is made a better person through The Power of Love .

LoveRevelationEpiphany.name: Love Revelation Epiphany
LoveRevelationEpiphany.def: Developing feelings for somebody when you learn that they love you.

LoveTakesWork.name: Love Takes Work
LoveTakesWork.def: Love is something that is shown taking work to build and sustain.

LoverTugOfWar.name: Lover Tug of War
LoverTugOfWar.def: Two suitors fight over their Love Interest tug of war style.

LoveRuinsTheRealm.name: Love Ruins the Realm
LoveRuinsTheRealm.def: A ruler's choices in lovers bring about disaster for their land.

LoveTheme.name: Love Theme
LoveTheme.def: A song that encapsulates a couple's love.

LoveTranscendsSpacetime.name: Love Transcends Spacetime
LoveTranscendsSpacetime.def: When love is strong, the rules of the universe get bent.

LoveTriangle.name: Love Triangle
LoveTriangle.def: A character is caught between two choices for a Love Interest .

LoveWillLeadYouBack.name: Love Will Lead You Back
LoveWillLeadYouBack.def: Lovers leave each other, but one remains confident that their lover will come back to them.

LovingAShadow.name: Loving a Shadow
LovingAShadow.def: Falling in love with the ideal of someone rather than the actual person.

LovingDetails.name: Loving Details
LovingDetails.def: Being so in love lets you remember minor details about your Love Interest .

MadLove.name: Mad Love
MadLove.def: Unrequited love where the pursuer is too nutty to take a hint that their crush doesn't return their feelings.

MagicContractRomance.name: Magic Contract Romance
MagicContractRomance.def: Romance between a mage and the supernatural being they contracted with.

MagneticGirlfriend.name: Magnetic Girlfriend
MagneticGirlfriend.def: This girl makes an unpopular guy a stud when she hooks up with him.

MakeOutKids.name: Make-Out Kids
MakeOutKids.def: A couple who can't go one minute without PDA.

MakeUpOrBreakUp.name: Make Up or Break Up
MakeUpOrBreakUp.def: A couple has to choose whether to stay together or break up.

MalingeringRomancePloy.name: Malingering Romance Ploy
MalingeringRomancePloy.def: Someone fakes sick because their Love Interest is doting on them.

MarriedToTheJob.name: Married to the Job
MarriedToTheJob.def: A character is too preoccupied with their career to pay attention to their spouse.

MarryForLove.name: Marry for Love
MarryForLove.def: Getting married because you love that person rather than for money, status, or security.

MarryThemAll.name: Marry Them All
MarryThemAll.def: The lead decides to hook up with all of their prospective Love Interests .

MasculineFeminineGayCouple.name: Masculine–Feminine Gay Couple
MasculineFeminineGayCouple.def: Same-sex couple where one partner is more masculine/feminine than the other.

MasculineGirlFeminineBoy.name: Masculine Girl, Feminine Boy
MasculineGirlFeminineBoy.def: A couple where the girl is a Tomboy and the guy is In Touch with His Feminine Side .

TheMasochismTango.name: The Masochism Tango
TheMasochismTango.def: Two people claim to be in love, but act like they hate each other.

MassageOfLove.name: Massage of Love
MassageOfLove.def: A loving couple giving each other an intimate, non-sexual massage.

AMatchMadeInStockholm.name: A Match Made in Stockholm
AMatchMadeInStockholm.def: A character falls in love with their kidnapper.

MatchmakerCrush.name: Matchmaker Crush
MatchmakerCrush.def: The Matchmaker falls for one of the people they're trying to hook up.

MaybeEverAfter.name: Maybe Ever After
MaybeEverAfter.def: Did The Hero and their Love Interest end up together in the end? Who knows.

MayDecemberRomance.name: May–December Romance
MayDecemberRomance.def: Romance between a young person and an elder.

MayflyDecemberRomance.name: Mayfly–December Romance
MayflyDecemberRomance.def: Romance between people of different lifespans, for example an immortal and a mortal.

MeadowRun.name: Meadow Run
MeadowRun.def: Lovers run towards each other in a beautiful meadow full of flowers.

MightyWhiteyAndMellowYellow.name: Mighty Whitey and Mellow Yellow
MightyWhiteyAndMellowYellow.def: White men tend to fall in love with Asian women.

MindlinkMates.name: Mindlink Mates
MindlinkMates.def: Lovers are so close they can literally read each other's thoughts.

TheMissusAndTheEx.name: The Missus and the Ex
TheMissusAndTheEx.def: Your current lover and ex-lover meet each other. Awkwardness may or may not ensue.

MistakenAssumptionOfAttraction.name: Mistaken Assumption of Attraction
MistakenAssumptionOfAttraction.def: Accidentally believing that someone is crushing on you.

MistakenDeclarationOfLove.name: Mistaken Declaration of Love
MistakenDeclarationOfLove.def: Accidentally confessing your love to the wrong person.

MistakenForCheating.name: Mistaken for Cheating
MistakenForCheating.def: Someone is falsely accused of being unfaithful to their lover.

MistakenForFlirting.name: Mistaken for Flirting
MistakenForFlirting.def: One person believes, in error, that another is flirting.

MixtapeOfLove.name: Mixtape of Love
MixtapeOfLove.def: Mixtapes are a way to show your affection for someone.

MoeCouplet.name: Moe Couplet
MoeCouplet.def: Two people who bring out each other's cute qualities the same way that romantic couples do.

MomentKiller.name: Moment Killer
MomentKiller.def: A couple tries to have a romantic moment with each other, but gets interrupted.

MonsterSlayerRomance.name: Monster/Slayer Romance
MonsterSlayerRomance.def: A romance between a Hunter of Monsters and the monster they're supposed to hunt.

MotivationalKiss.name: Motivational Kiss
MotivationalKiss.def: The Hero 's Love Interest kisses them in order to give them the courage they need to get through the danger ahead of them.

MoveForYourLove.name: Move for Your Love
MoveForYourLove.def: A character moves to be with the person they love, giving up their old life in the process.

MrsHypothetical.name: Mrs. Hypothetical
MrsHypothetical.def: A girl thinks about having her crush's last name.

MuggleAndMagicalLoveTriangle.name: Muggle and Magical Love Triangle
MuggleAndMagicalLoveTriangle.def: The lead's two choices for a Love Interest are a normal person and someone of supernatural origin.

MuggleMageRomance.name: Muggle–Mage Romance
MuggleMageRomance.def: Romance between a magic user and a regular person.

MutualPining.name: Mutual Pining
MutualPining.def: Two characters are madly in love with each other but are so convinced the other can't return their feelings to the point they both suffer quietly over it instead.

MyOwnPrivateIDo.name: My Own Private "I Do"
MyOwnPrivateIDo.def: A couple gets married before having a big fancy wedding.

MySisterIsOffLimits.name: My Sister Is Off-Limits
MySisterIsOffLimits.def: This girl is unable to go out on dates because her brother is very protective of her.

NecktieLeash.name: Necktie Leash
NecktieLeash.def: A guy has his necktie yanked by his Love Interest , showing she is who wears the pants in the relationship.

NiceGuysFinishLast.name: Nice Guys Finish Last
NiceGuysFinishLast.def: Women never fall for sweet, kind men.

NoAccountingForTaste.name: No Accounting for Taste
NoAccountingForTaste.def: There is absolutely no reason for these two to be lovers.

NobodyThinksItWillWork.name: Nobody Thinks It Will Work
NobodyThinksItWillWork.def: Two people are in love despite everyone thinking their relationship could never work.

NoGoingSteady.name: No Going Steady
NoGoingSteady.def: Characters date each other without becoming an Official Couple .

NoGuyWantsAnAmazon.name: No Guy Wants an Amazon
NoGuyWantsAnAmazon.def: Men don't want to be with women who can beat them up.

NoGuyWantsToBeChased.name: No Guy Wants to Be Chased
NoGuyWantsToBeChased.def: Men find it creepy when the woman pursues them instead of the other way around.

NoHuggingNoKissing.name: No Hugging, No Kissing
NoHuggingNoKissing.def: Romance is absent from this story.

NoLovesIntersect.name: No Loves Intersect
NoLovesIntersect.def: Characters get with their Love Interest without any messy Love Triangles or other kinds of romantic drama.

NonhumanLoverReveal.name: Non-Human Lover Reveal
NonhumanLoverReveal.def: A character's Love Interest is revealed to be a non-human.

NormieDatesACelebrity.name: Normie Dates a Celebrity
NormieDatesACelebrity.def: A normal person is in a relationship with a celebrity, causing drama.

NoRomanticResolution.name: No Romantic Resolution
NoRomanticResolution.def: A romance arc ends without anyone getting together.

NoSparks.name: No Sparks
NoSparks.def: A couple is shown to have no romantic compatibility.

NoTimeForLove.name: No Time for Love
NoTimeForLove.def: A character who has no time for romance and dating for various reasons.

NoYouHangUpFirst.name: No, You Hang Up First
NoYouHangUpFirst.def: An overly lovey-dovey couple argue over who should hang up their phone conversation first.

NotBloodSiblings.name: Not Blood Siblings
NotBloodSiblings.def: An incestuous relationship is justified by the couple not being related by blood (e.g. being stepsiblings or adopted siblings).

NowOrNeverKiss.name: Now-or-Never Kiss
NowOrNeverKiss.def: Characters kiss and confess their love for each other in a moment where they think they're about to die.

ObliviousToLove.name: Oblivious to Love
ObliviousToLove.def: They don't notice that someone is in love with them.

ObsessiveLoveLetter.name: Obsessive Love Letter
ObsessiveLoveLetter.def: A Love Letter that is more creepy than romantic.

OfficialCouple.name: Official Couple
OfficialCouple.def: Characters who are canonically in a relationship.

OfficialCoupleOrdealSyndrome.name: Official Couple Ordeal Syndrome
OfficialCoupleOrdealSyndrome.def: The story's Official Couple go through absolute hell throughout the story.

OfficialKiss.name: Official Kiss
OfficialKiss.def: Two characters kiss to signal their Relationship Upgrade .

OffScreenBreakup.name: Offscreen Breakup
OffScreenBreakup.def: Two characters who were previously established to be a couple are later found to have broken up.

OffScreenRomance.name: Offscreen Romance
OffScreenRomance.def: Two characters are found to have hooked up sometime offscreen.

OldFashionedRowboatDate.name: Old-Fashioned Rowboat Date
OldFashionedRowboatDate.def: A classic romantic date where the couple rides in a row boat.

OldFlameFizzle.name: Old Flame Fizzle
OldFlameFizzle.def: A character reunites with a previous lover, only to find that that person is no longer the person they remembered so fondly.

OneHeadTaller.name: One Head Taller
OneHeadTaller.def: A couple where one partner (often the man) towers over the other partner.

TheOneThatGotAway.name: The One That Got Away
TheOneThatGotAway.def: A character wishes they had gotten together with their Love Interest .

OneTrueLove.name: One True Love
OneTrueLove.def: The one person you're meant to be with.

OnlyHasSameSexAdmirers.name: Only Has Same-Sex Admirers
OnlyHasSameSexAdmirers.def: A character is only loved by people of the same gender.

OpenRelationshipFailure.name: Open Relationship Failure
OpenRelationshipFailure.def: A non-monogamous relationship runs into problems directly related to it being non-monogamous.

OperationJealousy.name: Operation: Jealousy
OperationJealousy.def: A character tries to get their Love Interest 's attention by pretending to date someone else as a way of inducing jealousy.

OppositesAttract.name: Opposites Attract
OppositesAttract.def: They're complete opposites but they love each other.

OrbitalKiss.name: Orbital Kiss
OrbitalKiss.def: A couple kisses as the camera rotates around them.

OurLoveIsDifferent.name: Our Love Is Different
OurLoveIsDifferent.def: A character insists that their relationship with The Casanova is true love.

PairTheDumbOnes.name: Pair the Dumb Ones
PairTheDumbOnes.def: Dumb characters get together because they are dumb.

PairTheSmartOnes.name: Pair the Smart Ones
PairTheSmartOnes.def: Intelligent characters hook up with each other.

PairTheSpares.name: Pair the Spares
PairTheSpares.def: The characters who don't have Love Interests end up together.

PairTheSuitors.name: Pair the Suitors
PairTheSuitors.def: Two people vying for someone's attention end up falling in love with each other.

ParentAgedParamour.name: Parent-Aged Paramour
ParentAgedParamour.def: A character is about the same age as their SO's parent(s).

ParentPreferredSuitor.name: Parent-Preferred Suitor
ParentPreferredSuitor.def: When a parent prefers one Love Interest of their offspring over another.

ParentalRelationshipApproval.name: Parental Relationship Approval
ParentalRelationshipApproval.def: A parent is explicitly in favor of their child's chosen significant other.

PerverseSexualLust.name: Perverse Sexual Lust
PerverseSexualLust.def: Attraction to and/or falling in love with a fictional character.

PickyAboutValidation.name: Picky About Validation
PickyAboutValidation.def: A character is motivated by the desire for love, attention, and respect, but is not ready to accept them from a certain other character.

PiningAfterProtagonistsParent.name: Pining After Protagonist's Parent
PiningAfterProtagonistsParent.def: A character has unrequited feelings for The Hero 's parent.

PitbullDatesPuppy.name: Pitbull Dates Puppy
PitbullDatesPuppy.def: A rough and tough character falls in love with someone of a softer, gentler nature.

PlatonicWritingRomanticReading.name: Platonic Writing, Romantic Reading
PlatonicWritingRomanticReading.def: The audience picks up romantic subtext between characters that are not meant to be in love.

PlayingHardToGet.name: Playing Hard to Get
PlayingHardToGet.def: A character tries to attract their Love Interest by pretending to be not interested in them.

PleaseDumpMe.name: Please Dump Me
PleaseDumpMe.def: A character acts disgusting in order to get their lover to break up with them.

Polyamory.name: Polyamory
Polyamory.def: Romance between more than two people.

PostCoitalPancakes.name: Post Coital Pancakes
PostCoitalPancakes.def: After a night of intimacy, breakfast is served.

PostKissCatatonia.name: Post-Kiss Catatonia
PostKissCatatonia.def: A character is in shock after being kissed by their love.

ThePowerOfLove.name: The Power of Love
ThePowerOfLove.def: Characters are empowered by their feelings of love and affection for each other, especially the romantic bonds with their significant others. The Power of Family : Characters are empowered by the love they feel for their family members (related by blood or choice ).

ThePowerOfFriendship.name: The Power of Friendship
ThePowerOfFriendship.def: Characters are empowered by the platonic love they have for their True Companions .

PrankDate.name: Prank Date
PrankDate.def: A character is tricked into believing they have a date with their crush.

PrecociousCrush.name: Precocious Crush
PrecociousCrush.def: A child has a crush on someone much older than them.

ProjectileKiss.name: Projectile Kiss
ProjectileKiss.def: A character blows a kiss towards their crush.

PromotedToLoveInterest.name: Promoted to Love Interest
PromotedToLoveInterest.def: An adaptation of a story turns a character's platonic relationship into a romantic one.

ThePromposal.name: The Promposal
ThePromposal.def: Asking someone to prom in the style of a marriage proposal.

PropertyOfLove.name: Property of Love
PropertyOfLove.def: When being in love makes you essentially your lover's property.

ProxyBreakup.name: Proxy Breakup
ProxyBreakup.def: Alice wants to break-up with Bob, so she has Cindy do it for her. Hijinks ensue.

PseudoRomanticFriendship.name: Pseudo-Romantic Friendship
PseudoRomanticFriendship.def: Two friends have a close friendship with each other that they could easily be seen as lovers.

PsychoExGirlfriend.name: Psycho Ex-Girlfriend
PsychoExGirlfriend.def: The ex-significant other of The Hero who didn't take being dumped very well.

PsychoticLoveTriangle.name: Psychotic Love Triangle
PsychoticLoveTriangle.def: A Love Triangle where both suitors are Ax-Crazy .

PygmalionPlot.name: Pygmalion Plot
PygmalionPlot.def: Falling in love with one's own creation.

QuittingToBecomeACaregiver.name: Quitting to Become a Caregiver
QuittingToBecomeACaregiver.def: A character sacrifices their job and/or education to care for another human being.

RaceForYourLove.name: Race for Your Love
RaceForYourLove.def: A character races to catch up with their Love Interest before they leave them.

RedIsRomantic.name: Red Is Romantic
RedIsRomantic.def: The color red associated with love and romance.

RedStringOfFate.name: Red String of Fate
RedStringOfFate.def: Two characters are bound by fate to be together.

RejectionAffection.name: Rejection Affection
RejectionAffection.def: A character is repeatedly rejected by their Love Interest , but never takes the hint.

RelationshipCompression.name: Relationship Compression
RelationshipCompression.def: The amount of time it takes for characters to hook up is reduced in an adaptation.

RelationshipLabelingProblems.name: Relationship Labeling Problems
RelationshipLabelingProblems.def: Characters can't describe exactly what their relationship situation is.

RelationshipReveal.name: Relationship Reveal
RelationshipReveal.def: Implied lovers are revealed to officially be in a relationship.

RelationshipRevolvingDoor.name: Relationship Revolving Door
RelationshipRevolvingDoor.def: Characters date, break up, get back together, break up, and so on.

RelationshipSabotage.name: Relationship Sabotage
RelationshipSabotage.def: A character tries to ruin someone's romance, usually out of jealousy or protectiveness.

RelationshipUpgrade.name: Relationship Upgrade
RelationshipUpgrade.def: Two characters are made an Official Couple .

RelationshipValues.name: Relationship Values
RelationshipValues.def: Stats that show how much video game characters like the player character.

RelationshipWritingFumble.name: Relationship Writing Fumble
RelationshipWritingFumble.def: A relationship intended to be written one way unintentionally comes across as the wrong kind of relationship to audiences.

RemovedFromThePicture.name: Removed from the Picture
RemovedFromThePicture.def: After a nasty break up, a character cuts their former lover's image out of pictures of them together.

RemovingTheRival.name: Removing the Rival
RemovingTheRival.def: A character ties up or locks their love rival in a room in order to keep him/her away from their Love Interest .

ReplacementGoldfish.name: Replacement Goldfish
ReplacementGoldfish.def: A character is replaced with another. In romantic instances, after breaking up, a character starts dating someone who looks very similar to their ex.

ReturningTheHandkerchief.name: Returning the Handkerchief
ReturningTheHandkerchief.def: A classic romantic que where a character drops an item of theirs, and their Love Interest finds it and returns it to them.

RichSuitorPoorSuitor.name: Rich Suitor, Poor Suitor
RichSuitorPoorSuitor.def: A character's two Love Interest choices are a rich person and a poor beggar.

RivalryAsCourtship.name: Rivalry as Courtship
RivalryAsCourtship.def: A romance that stems from two characters' rivalry.

RoadTripRomance.name: Road Trip Romance
RoadTripRomance.def: Two characters traveling together eventually fall in love.

RoaringRampageOfRomance.name: Roaring Rampage of Romance
RoaringRampageOfRomance.def: A romance that causes the deaths of many people.

RomanceInducingSmudge.name: Romance-Inducing Smudge
RomanceInducingSmudge.def: A character has a smudge on their face, which their Love Interest sweetly rubs off.

RomanceOnTheSet.name: Romance on the Set
RomanceOnTheSet.def: Creators behind a show fall in love.

RomanceWithTheFan.name: Romance with the Fan
RomanceWithTheFan.def: When a celebrity pursues a relationship with a fan.

RomancingTheWidow.name: Romancing the Widow
RomancingTheWidow.def: Getting into a relationship with someone whose spouse has died.

RomanticCandlelitDinner.name: Romantic Candlelit Dinner
RomanticCandlelitDinner.def: Dinners by candlelight are the definition of romance.

RomanticHyperbole.name: Romantic Hyperbole
RomanticHyperbole.def: Describing one's love through implausible situations, e.g. saying you'll grab the moon for your lover.

RomanticPlotTumor.name: Romantic Plot Tumor
RomanticPlotTumor.def: A romantic subplot that gets in the way of the main conflict.

RomanticRain.name: Romantic Rain
RomanticRain.def: Rain makes a good backdrop for a love scene.

RomanticSpoonfeeding.name: Romantic Spoonfeeding
RomanticSpoonfeeding.def: A character manually feeds their Love Interest .

RomanticWingman.name: Romantic Wingman
RomanticWingman.def: A person who helps their friends out with their love lives.

RomComJob.name: Rom-Com Job
RomComJob.def: A line of work that acts as a typical romantic comedy setting.

RunawayBride.name: Runaway Bride
RunawayBride.def: The bride skips out on her wedding, often because she doesn't really love her groom.

RunawayFiance.name: Runaway Fiancé
RunawayFiance.def: A person who runs away from an Arranged Marriage , often to go be with the one they really love.

SamaritanRelationshipStarter.name: Samaritan Relationship Starter
SamaritanRelationshipStarter.def: A character falls in love with somebody upon witnessing them perform an act of kindness.

SavvyGuyEnergeticGirl.name: Savvy Guy, Energetic Girl
SavvyGuyEnergeticGirl.def: A cool-headed often unathletic guy and a bubbly bouncy girl fall in love.

SecondActBreakup.name: Second-Act Breakup
SecondActBreakup.def: The Official Couple breaks up in the middle of the story after a misunderstanding or some other kind of conflict.

SecondLove.name: Second Love
SecondLove.def: The next person you fell in love with after your First Love didn't work out.

SeductiveMummy.name: Seductive Mummy
SeductiveMummy.def: A mummy is a beautiful Love Interest instead of a frightening monster.

SelfProclaimedInLaw.name: Self-Proclaimed In-Law
SelfProclaimedInLaw.def: A person refers to their crush's relatives as their in-laws, or declares themself an in-law to the person they ship their relative with .

SelfProclaimedLoveInterest.name: Self-Proclaimed Love Interest
SelfProclaimedLoveInterest.def: A character who claims to be/thinks they're someone's Love Interest .

SerenadeYourLover.name: Serenade Your Lover
SerenadeYourLover.def: Singing a love song for your beloved.

SerialRomeo.name: Serial Romeo
SerialRomeo.def: He repeatedly falls for every girl he meets, insisting that she's the one for him.

SettledForGay.name: Settled for Gay
SettledForGay.def: Hooking up with a gay man due to him being the only one available to you.

SettleForSibling.name: Settle for Sibling
SettleForSibling.def: When you can't win someone's love, hook up with their sibling instead.

ShallowCannotComprehendTrueLove.name: Shallow Cannot Comprehend True Love
ShallowCannotComprehendTrueLove.def: Superficial people don't understand that not everyone is shallow when it comes to their choice in romantic partners.

SheCleansUpNicely.name: She Cleans Up Nicely
SheCleansUpNicely.def: The frumpy Love Interest looks beautiful when they get dressed up.

SheIsNotMyGirlfriend.name: She Is Not My Girlfriend
SheIsNotMyGirlfriend.def: Two people deny being in a relationship, to the scepticism of everyone around them.

ShiksaGoddess.name: Shiksa Goddess
ShiksaGoddess.def: A Jewish character's Gentile Love Interest .

ShippingBedDeath.name: Shipping Bed Death
ShippingBedDeath.def: Characters getting a Relationship Upgrade ruins the audience's enthusiasm for the pairing.

ShockValueRelationship.name: Shock Value Relationship
ShockValueRelationship.def: A character gets into a head-turning relationship purely to surprise people.

ShotgunWedding.name: Shotgun Wedding
ShotgunWedding.def: A couple gets married due to circumstances; e.g., the bride is pregnant with the groom's child.

SiblingTriangle.name: Sibling Triangle
SiblingTriangle.def: Two siblings fall in love with the same person.

SickbedSmuggling.name: Sickbed Smuggling
SickbedSmuggling.def: Giving a hospitalized loved one an (often) banned object (snack, meal, pet, etc.)

SickeninglySweethearts.name: Sickeningly Sweethearts
SickeninglySweethearts.def: Two people love each other to a Sickeningly Sweet level.

ASideOrderOfRomance.name: A Side Order of Romance
ASideOrderOfRomance.def: A character visits a restaurant, and falls in love with the waitress.

SighOfLove.name: Sigh of Love
SighOfLove.def: Sighing dreamily when in the presence of or thinking about your Love Interest .

SignedWithAKiss.name: Signed with a Kiss
SignedWithAKiss.def: A character sends a letter or gift to their Love Interest with a kiss mark attached.

SingleTargetSexuality.name: Single-Target Sexuality
SingleTargetSexuality.def: Being in love with only one person.

SingleWomanSeeksGoodMan.name: Single Woman Seeks Good Man
SingleWomanSeeksGoodMan.def: Girls fall for sweet, kind guys.

SituationalSexuality.name: Situational Sexuality
SituationalSexuality.def: Characters fall in love with someone of the same sex if there is no one of the opposite sex around.

SlapSlapKiss.name: Slap-Slap-Kiss
SlapSlapKiss.def: Characters in love argue with each other then begin to kiss.

SleepCute.name: Sleep Cute
SleepCute.def: Lovers or characters with Ship Tease fall asleep next to each other.

SmithicalMarriage.name: Smithical Marriage
SmithicalMarriage.def: A couple checks into a hotel, signing in as a married couple.

SmittenTeenageGirl.name: Smitten Teenage Girl
SmittenTeenageGirl.def: A teenage girl who crushes hard on a guy.

SnowMeansLove.name: Snow Means Love
SnowMeansLove.def: Snow makes a good backdrop for a love scene.

SoHappyTogether.name: So Happy Together
SoHappyTogether.def: A tragedy strikes right as a pair of lovers have a happy moment with each other.

SpeechImpededLoveInterest.name: Speech-Impeded Love Interest
SpeechImpededLoveInterest.def: A Love Interest character with a speech disability.

SpurnedIntoSuicide.name: Spurned into Suicide
SpurnedIntoSuicide.def: Unrequited love results in a person taking their own life.

SquaringTheLoveTriangle.name: Squaring the Love Triangle
SquaringTheLoveTriangle.def: When the Official Couple hooks up, the unrequited suitor is then paired with the couple's child.

StalkerWithACrush.name: Stalker with a Crush
StalkerWithACrush.def: A character who follows the person they're in love with everywhere.

StalkingIsFunnyIfItIsFemaleAfterMale.name: Stalking Is Funny if It Is Female After Male
StalkingIsFunnyIfItIsFemaleAfterMale.def: A girl stalking the guy she loves is considered to be cute and amusing.

StalkingIsLove.name: Stalking Is Love
StalkingIsLove.def: Stalking your Love Interest is considered romantic rather than creepy.

StoodUp.name: Stood Up
StoodUp.def: A character fails to show up for a date.

StrangledByTheRedString.name: Strangled by the Red String
StrangledByTheRedString.def: Characters fall in love out of nowhere.

SugarAndIcePersonality.name: Sugar-and-Ice Personality
SugarAndIcePersonality.def: A character who is cold most of the time, but super sweet when with the one they love.

SuperpoweredDate.name: Superpowered Date
SuperpoweredDate.def: Superpowers allow a character to take their Love Interest on a grandiose date.

SupportingHarem.name: Supporting Harem
SupportingHarem.def: A Harem Genre story where there's a male lead and female lead alongside a supporting cast who are also in love with one of the leads.

SupportingTheMonsterLovedOne.name: Supporting the Monster Loved One
SupportingTheMonsterLovedOne.def: Love making someone care for a loved-one, despite said loved-one being a monster.

SurpriseIncest.name: Surprise Incest
SurpriseIncest.def: Lovers are revealed to be blood-related after they hook up.

SweetheartSipping.name: Sweetheart Sipping
SweetheartSipping.def: A classic romantic date where the couple share a milkshake with two straws.

SweetieGraffiti.name: Sweetie Graffiti
SweetieGraffiti.def: Lovers carve their initials on a tree or a wall.

SweetOnPollyOliver.name: Sweet on Polly Oliver
SweetOnPollyOliver.def: A guy starts to fall in love with a guy who is really a girl in disguise.

TalentedPrincessRegularGuy.name: Talented Princess, Regular Guy
TalentedPrincessRegularGuy.def: A romantic pairing consisting of a princess who is skilled and a guy who is pretty ordinary.

TelephoneSong.name: Telephone Song
TelephoneSong.def: A song about calling somebody on the telephone, often a love interest or ex-partner.

TerriblePickUpLines.name: Terrible Pick-Up Lines
TerriblePickUpLines.def: Character attempts to use smooth one-liners to attract their preferred mate. It doesn't go well.

ThereIsOnlyOneBed.name: There Is Only One Bed
ThereIsOnlyOneBed.def: Ship Tease moment where characters end up having to share a bed.

ThroughHisStomach.name: Through His Stomach
ThroughHisStomach.def: Winning someone's affections by cooking them a delicious meal.

TimeTravelRomance.name: Time-Travel Romance
TimeTravelRomance.def: Romance between people from different time periods.

TinyGuyHugeGirl.name: Tiny Guy, Huge Girl
TinyGuyHugeGirl.def: A couple where the woman towers over the man.

TokenRomance.name: Token Romance
TokenRomance.def: A romantic subplot that's put in a story for superficial reasons.

TopWife.name: Top Wife
TopWife.def: A man has many wives, but has one that he loves the most.

TotallyTrustingLoveInterest.name: Totally Trusting Love Interest
TotallyTrustingLoveInterest.def: The Love Interest who believes in their partner’s fidelity no matter what, and is justified in believing so.

TrainStationGoodbye.name: Train-Station Goodbye
TrainStationGoodbye.def: Lovers going their separate ways say their goodbyes at the train station.

TransRelationshipTroubles.name: Trans Relationship Troubles
TransRelationshipTroubles.def: Being trans causes drama when it comes to romantic relationships.

TrueLoveIsBoring.name: True Love Is Boring
TrueLoveIsBoring.def: Conflict among lovers is considered more exciting than them being happy together.

TrueLoveIsExceptional.name: True Love is Exceptional
TrueLoveIsExceptional.def: A character falls in love with someone who is usually not their type.

TrueLovesKiss.name: True Love's Kiss
TrueLovesKiss.def: Lovers share a kiss that cures a problem/causes a miracle to happen.

TunnelOfLove.name: Tunnel of Love
TunnelOfLove.def: An amusement park ride for couples to go on.

TurnedOffByTheJerkass.name: Turned Off by the Jerkass
TurnedOffByTheJerkass.def: A character is rejected as a romantic option because of how much of a jerk they are.

TwiceShy.name: Twice Shy
TwiceShy.def: Characters who are each other's Love Interests are both too shy to admit their feelings.

TwoPersonLoveTriangle.name: Two-Person Love Triangle
TwoPersonLoveTriangle.def: A Love Triangle where the two choices are actually the same person.

UmbrellaOfTogetherness.name: Umbrella of Togetherness
UmbrellaOfTogetherness.def: Ship Tease moment where two characters share an umbrella with each other.

UnbrokenVigil.name: Unbroken Vigil
UnbrokenVigil.def: A character keeps watch over their unconscious Love Interest .

UncoveringRelationshipStatus.name: Uncovering Relationship Status
UncoveringRelationshipStatus.def: A character tries to find out if their crush is already in a relationship.

UndercoverAsLovers.name: Undercover as Lovers
UndercoverAsLovers.def: Two spies pose as lovers as they go undercover.

UnderstandingBoyfriend.name: Understanding Boyfriend
UnderstandingBoyfriend.def: The heroine's boyfriend who knows that she's a fantasy heroine and sympathizes with the wacky antics she goes through.

UnknowinglyInLove.name: Unknowingly in Love
UnknowinglyInLove.def: A character doesn't realize they're in love.

UnrequitedLoveLastsForever.name: Unrequited Love Lasts Forever
UnrequitedLoveLastsForever.def: A character never stops loving their unrequited crush.

UnrequitedLoveSwitcheroo.name: Unrequited Love Switcheroo
UnrequitedLoveSwitcheroo.def: A character has an unrequited crush on another then later gets over it, only for their former crush to develop feelings for them.

UnresolvedSexualTension.name: Unresolved Sexual Tension
UnresolvedSexualTension.def: Two characters are obviously attracted to each other, but they never act on their feelings.

UnwantedHarem.name: Unwanted Harem
UnwantedHarem.def: Many people are vying for The Hero 's attention, much to their dismay.

UptightLovesWild.name: Uptight Loves Wild
UptightLovesWild.def: An uptight, cool-headed character loves someone who is more crazy and spontaneous.

UptownGirl.name: Uptown Girl
UptownGirl.def: The rich girl who falls for a poor boy.

VampireWerewolfLoveTriangle.name: Vampire-Werewolf Love Triangle
VampireWerewolfLoveTriangle.def: A Love Triangle where the two Love Interest choices are a vampire and a werewolf.

VillainessesWantHeroes.name: Villainesses Want Heroes
VillainessesWantHeroes.def: A villainous female is in love with The Hero .

VillainousCrush.name: Villainous Crush
VillainousCrush.def: An evil character is in love with a heroic character.

WallPinOfLove.name: Wall Pin of Love
WallPinOfLove.def: A character halts their Love Interest from leaving by pinning their hand against the wall and effectively blocking their path.

WeaknessTurnsHerOn.name: Weakness Turns Her On
WeaknessTurnsHerOn.def: A girl is attracted to guys who are more vulnerable than males are expected to be.

WeddingDeadline.name: Wedding Deadline
WeddingDeadline.def: The Hero must get to their true love before they say "I do" at their wedding.

WentCrazyWhenTheyLeft.name: Went Crazy When They Left
WentCrazyWhenTheyLeft.def: A character goes crazy when someone they care strongly for leaves in any fashion.

WhatDoesSheSeeInHim.name: What Does She See in Him?
WhatDoesSheSeeInHim.def: People wonder why a character is in love with someone who seems so undesirable.

WhatIsThisThingYouCallLove.name: What Is This Thing You Call "Love"?
WhatIsThisThingYouCallLove.def: A character is unable to understand romantic love.

WhatMeasureIsAHumanoid.name: What Measure Is a Humanoid?
WhatMeasureIsAHumanoid.def: Interspecies Romance , except one half of the pairing has a human form.

WhenHarryMetSvetlana.name: When Harry Met Svetlana
WhenHarryMetSvetlana.def: Romance between an American man and a Russian woman.

WhereDaWhiteWomenAt.name: Where da White Women At?
WhereDaWhiteWomenAt.def: Black men tend to fall in love with white women.

WhyCantIHateYou.name: Why Can't I Hate You?
WhyCantIHateYou.def: A character can't bring themselves to truly hate their love rival.
