WhyWouldAnyoneTakeHimBack.name: Why Would Anyone Take Him Back?
WhyWouldAnyoneTakeHimBack.def: Giving a former lover another chance when they don't deserve it.

WifeHusbandry.name: Wife Husbandry
WifeHusbandry.def: A man falls in love with a woman he's raised since she was a little girl.

WindowLove.name: Window Love
WindowLove.def: Lovers meet at a window and kiss or touch hands through it.

WinningBackTheEx.name: Winning Back the Ex
WinningBackTheEx.def: Winning back the heart of an ex lover through heroics or personal growth

WithThisRing.name: With This Ring
WithThisRing.def: When a man proposes to his lady love, anything can go wrong with securing the ring.

WomenPreferStrongMen.name: Women Prefer Strong Men
WomenPreferStrongMen.def: Women fall for men who are strong and muscular.

WorkingWithTheEx.name: Working with the Ex
WorkingWithTheEx.def: A character has to work with their ex-significant other.

YandereCouple.name: Yandere Couple
YandereCouple.def: Two people driven murderous with love end up together.

YawnAndReach.name: Yawn and Reach
YawnAndReach.def: A guy pretends to yawn so he can wrap his arm around his girlfriend.

YouHaveWaitedLongEnough.name: You Have Waited Long Enough
YouHaveWaitedLongEnough.def: When a character's true love doesn't return, they're forced to move on.

YouMustBeCold.name: You Must Be Cold
YouMustBeCold.def: Ship Tease moment where a man offers his jacket to a woman.

YoungLoveVersusOldHate.name: Young Love Versus Old Hate
YoungLoveVersusOldHate.def: Young people fall in love while their older relatives still cling to hatred.

YourFavorite.name: Your Favorite
YourFavorite.def: A sign that you really love someone is that you know what their favorite food is.

YourUniverseOrMine.name: Your Universe or Mine?
YourUniverseOrMine.def: Lovers from different worlds or countries must decide where they will go.

ZipMeUp.name: Zip Me Up
ZipMeUp.def: Ship Tease moment where a man helps a woman zip up her clothes.

EleventhHourSuperpower.name: 11th-Hour Superpower
EleventhHourSuperpower.def: A new superpower at the last minute.

BadPowersGoodPeople.name: Bad Powers, Good People
BadPowersGoodPeople.def: A good-aligned person with cruel or morally questionable powers.

ByThePowerOfGrayskull.name: By the Power of Grayskull!
ByThePowerOfGrayskull.def: Something you shout to activate your superpowers.

ChunkyUpdraft.name: Chunky Updraft
ChunkyUpdraft.def: Chunks of debris float around a powerful character/force.

CraterPower.name: Crater Power
CraterPower.def: Powerful characters create craters under them.

DrunkWithPower.name: Drunk with Power
DrunkWithPower.def: Getting more power can make you overbearing or even evil.

GreatBow.name: Great Bow
GreatBow.def: An enormous bow and its enormous arrows.

LastDiscMagic.name: Last Disc Magic
LastDiscMagic.def: A very powerful late-game item or ability.

LastOnesPloy.name: Last One's Ploy
LastOnesPloy.def: A member of an endangered species or other category uses this to push others around.

TheLawOfPowerProportionateToEffort.name: The Law of Power Proportionate to Effort

MagikarpPower.name: Magikarp Power
MagikarpPower.def: Very weak at first, very strong with enough effort.

MarkedChange.name: Marked Change
MarkedChange.def: Achieving full power creates marks on the user's skin.

MonstrosityEqualsWeakness.name: Monstrosity Equals Weakness
MonstrosityEqualsWeakness.def: Monstrous characters are actually less powerful.

MostCommonSuperpower.name: Most Common Superpower
MostCommonSuperpower.def: Female superheroes tend to have supernaturally supported breasts.

NewLifeInAnotherWorldBonus.name: New Life in Another World Bonus

NewPowersAsThePlotDemands.name: New Powers as the Plot Demands

NoManShouldHaveThisPower.name: No Man Should Have This Power

NoPowerNoColor.name: No Power, No Color
NoPowerNoColor.def: Running out of power causes someone/something to turn gray.

PowerDyesYourHair.name: Power Dyes Your Hair
PowerDyesYourHair.def: Supernatural powers cause hair to change color.

PowerGlows.name: Power Glows
PowerGlows.def: Emitting light due to sheer power.

PowerHair.name: Power Hair
PowerHair.def: Women in politics with short hair.

PowerUp.name: Power-Up
PowerUp.def: A temporary new ability in a video-game, usually obtained from finding an item.

PurpleIsPowerful.name: Purple Is Powerful
PurpleIsPowerful.def: The color purple used to represent powerful or supernatural things.

RequiredSecondaryPowers.name: Required Secondary Powers
RequiredSecondaryPowers.def: Secondary abilities a character naturally must have in order for their superpowers to work safely and correctly.

ReUnlockingPower.name: Re-Unlocking Power
ReUnlockingPower.def: A character has an ability or level of strength that they can't use willy-nilly; they have to do something to gain the ability to use it.

StoryBreakerPower.name: Story-Breaker Power
StoryBreakerPower.def: When a character possesses an ability that is too powerful for the story.

SuperpowerLottery.name: Superpower Lottery
SuperpowerLottery.def: An extreme range in the strength/utility of superpowers among characters.

SuperpowerRussianRoulette.name: Superpower Russian Roulette
SuperpowerRussianRoulette.def: As Superpower Lottery, but some of the "superpowers" are net detriments.

SwirlingDust.name: Swirling Dust
SwirlingDust.def: Dust swirling around a powerful character.

TimedPowerUp.name: Timed Power-Up
TimedPowerUp.def: As Hour of Power, but specifically for power-ups in video games.

UnstablePoweredWoman.name: Unstable Powered Woman
UnstablePoweredWoman.def: Female supers tend to have unstable powers, often due to emotion.

WithGreatPowerComesGreatHotness.name: With Great Power Comes Great Hotness

WithGreatPowerComesGreatInsanity.name: With Great Power Comes Great Insanity

WithGreatPowerComesGreatOpposition.name: With Great Power Comes Great Opposition

WithGreatPowerComesGreatPerks.name: With Great Power Comes Great Perks

WithGreatPowerComesGreatResponsibility.name: With Great Power Comes Great Responsibility

AffectionHatingKid.name: Affection-Hating Kid
AffectionHatingKid.def: Expressions of affection (hugs, kisses, etc) are hated by kids.

BadMoodRetreat.name: Bad Mood Retreat
BadMoodRetreat.def: A special place a character goes to when unhappy.

ColdHam.name: Cold Ham
ColdHam.def: A character who doesn't speak dramatically, but still has dialogue that is hammy.

CryForTheDevil.name: Cry for the Devil
CryForTheDevil.def: All of a sudden, a character previously thought to be utterly beyond any sympathy reveals past traumas that may open the waterworks.

EmotionControl.name: Emotion Control
EmotionControl.def: A form of mind control that is focused on manipulating someone's emotional state. Emotion Bomb : A magic spell or psychological weapon that can force people to feel certain emotions.

HatePlague.name: Hate Plague
HatePlague.def: Something that forces people to feel enraged, hateful, and even violently aggressive towards other people.

SupernaturalFearInducer.name: Supernatural Fear Inducer
SupernaturalFearInducer.def: Something that forces people to feel frightened, often by making them hallucinate their own worst nightmares.

EmotionPersonification.name: Emotion Personification
EmotionPersonification.def: An entity that's a living emotion.

EmotionEater.name: Emotion Eater
EmotionEater.def: A being or creature which derives power from the emotional state of other people, usually by exploiting their negative emotions or draining their positive emotions.

EmotionlessReptile.name: Emotionless Reptile
EmotionlessReptile.def: Reptiles portrayed as cold, stoic, or unempathetic.

TheEverCalm.name: The Ever-Calm
TheEverCalm.def: A character is depicted as calm and calming, even in dire situations.

FaintInShock.name: Faint in Shock
FaintInShock.def: The emotions (positive or negative) just got to be too much.

ForcedToFeelEmpathy.name: Forced to Feel Empathy
ForcedToFeelEmpathy.def: The Sociopath is forced to feel horror and shame for all of their sins.

GetTheSensation.name: Get the Sensation
GetTheSensation.def: "This is how using Product X will make you feel!"

TheHollywoodFormula.name: The Hollywood Formula
TheHollywoodFormula.def: A three-role, Three-Act Structure that utilizes goal outcomes, as well as character reconciliation and conflict resolution, to maximize Emotional Torque .

IntrospectiveArt.name: Introspective Art
IntrospectiveArt.def: A character creates a piece of art that showcases their emotions.

ImmuneToJumpscares.name: Immune to Jump Scares
ImmuneToJumpscares.def: When jump scares fail In-Universe and in Real Life .

LackOfEmpathy.name: Lack of Empathy
LackOfEmpathy.def: Not giving a shit about other people's feelings or suffering.

LivingMoodRing.name: Living Mood Ring
LivingMoodRing.def: When a character's appearance changes to reflect their emotions.

MellowFellow.name: Mellow Fellow
MellowFellow.def: A peaceful and generally relaxed person.

TheMisophonic.name: The Misophonic
TheMisophonic.def: Misophonia, or 'sound rage', creates feelings of intense, sometimes even violent anger in those who experience it.

MoodSwinger.name: Mood-Swinger
MoodSwinger.def: Someone changes emotions at the drop of a hat.

NarrativeBeats.name: Narrative Beats
NarrativeBeats.def: Events, decisions, or discoveries that induce a change in emotional direction of the story, whether positive or negative.

NegativeEmotionsArentBad.name: Negative Emotions Arent Bad
NegativeEmotionsArentBad.def: '': Emotions considered negative are portrayed as positive or not inherently bad.

NoTimeToThink.name: No Time to Think
NoTimeToThink.def: Pressed for time, a character bases a decision on their emotions instead of logic and reasoning.

OffendedByAnothersCalmness.name: Offended by Another's Calmness
OffendedByAnothersCalmness.def: A character gets offended when someone else doesn't express emotions when they feel they should.

SoulfulPlantStory.name: Soulful Plant Story
SoulfulPlantStory.def: A plot or scene focusing on a plant that's deeply emotional.

SunnySunflowerDisposition.name: Sunny Sunflower Disposition
SunnySunflowerDisposition.def: A character whose personality and emotions are just as bright as the golden flowers they surround themselves with.

SurprisinglyMovingSong.name: Surprisingly Moving Song
SurprisinglyMovingSong.def: A character has a profound emotional reaction to a piece of music.

ThatMakesMeFeelAngry.name: That Makes Me Feel Angry
ThatMakesMeFeelAngry.def: A character states out loud the emotion they are feeling.

TooUnhappyToBeHungry.name: Too Unhappy to Be Hungry
TooUnhappyToBeHungry.def: Someone loses their appetite because they're scared, sad, or angry.

ATragedyOfImpulsiveness.name: A Tragedy of Impulsiveness
ATragedyOfImpulsiveness.def: An unfortunate outcome befalls a character because they acted on their emotions without considering the ramifications of their actions.

ActuallyIAmHim.name: Actually, I Am Him
ActuallyIAmHim.def: A character meets an individual on their quest to meet someone and ends up discovering that this person is the person they're looking for.

AndThatLittleGirlWasMe.name: ...And That Little Girl Was Me
AndThatLittleGirlWasMe.def: A character tells another person a story that they reveal to be about themselves.

AssimilationPlot.name: Assimilation Plot
AssimilationPlot.def: A type of ploy where the end goal is the elimination of all individual identity

BeneathTheMask.name: Beneath the Mask
BeneathTheMask.def: A character's true self is very different from how they act in public.

CollectiveIdentity.name: Collective Identity
CollectiveIdentity.def: An alias is used by more than one person at the same time.

ADarkerMe.name: A Darker Me
ADarkerMe.def: The Darker and Edgier version of someone's personality.

DeliriousMisidentification.name: Delirious Misidentification
DeliriousMisidentification.def: Someone in a state of delirium mistakes one character for another.

DelusionsOfDoghood.name: Delusions of Doghood
DelusionsOfDoghood.def: A human character thinks they're an animal.

DoubleConsciousness.name: Double Consciousness
DoubleConsciousness.def: A character has two or more social identities that conflict with each other.

DramaticUnmask.name: Dramatic Unmask
DramaticUnmask.def: Someone pulls a character's mask off to reveal their identity.

EnemyWithin.name: Enemy Within
EnemyWithin.def: An evil force inside of a character struggles to gain control of them.

FreakyFridaySabotage.name: "Freaky Friday" Sabotage
FreakyFridaySabotage.def: A character switches their mind with another character, intending to cause them negative consequences.

FriendOfMaskedSelf.name: Friend of Masked Self
FriendOfMaskedSelf.def: Someone claims to be friends with their own Secret Identity .

FrightBesideThem.name: Fright Beside Them
FrightBesideThem.def: A character realizes they're in danger when the friend or loved one who they thought was right next to them is actually revealed to be somewhere else.

FutureSelfReveal.name: Future Self Reveal
FutureSelfReveal.def: A character is revealed to be another character's future self.

GenuineImposter.name: Genuine Imposter
GenuineImposter.def: A character who is supposedly impersonating someone else turns out to be who they were impersonating.

GoToAlias.name: Go-to Alias
GoToAlias.def: Someone consistently uses the same name as an alias.

HisQuirkLivesOn.name: His Quirk Lives On
HisQuirkLivesOn.def: A character adopts the trait of a deceased character as a way of keeping the dead character alive.

IAmWhatIAm.name: I Am What I Am
IAmWhatIAm.def: A character learns to accept a part of their identity they previously rejected.

IAmWho.name: I Am Who?
IAmWho.def: Someone is unaware of their status as The Chosen One .

IdentityAbsorption.name: Identity Absorption
IdentityAbsorption.def: Someone absorbs the personality and memories of someone else.

IdentityBreakdown.name: Identity Breakdown
IdentityBreakdown.def: A character suffers a mental break because of issues or revelations regarding who or what they are.

IdentityDenial.name: Identity Denial
IdentityDenial.def: Someone is recognized, but denies that they are that person or alter ego.

ImpersonationExclusiveCharacter.name: Impersonation-Exclusive Character
ImpersonationExclusiveCharacter.def: All or almost all knowledge of a character is gained through their impersonator.

ImpostorAllAlong.name: Impostor All Along
ImpostorAllAlong.def: A major character turns out to be an impersonator of said character.

ImposterForgotOneDetail.name: Imposter Forgot One Detail
ImposterForgotOneDetail.def: Going undercover, but forgetting an essential part of your disguise or cover identity that gets you blown.

IndividualityIsIllegal.name: Individuality Is Illegal
IndividualityIsIllegal.def: A society controlled by a Hive Mind is not compatible with any individualized identities.

JekyllAndHyde.name: Jekyll & Hyde
JekyllAndHyde.def: A good person has an evil alter-ego.

TheJekyllIsAJerk.name: The Jekyll Is a Jerk
TheJekyllIsAJerk.def: The alter-ego might be bad, but the original persona isn't much better.

TheKillerInMe.name: The Killer in Me
TheKillerInMe.def: A character that is chasing or is chased by a rampant killer is revealed to the audience (and sometimes to themself) to be the killer in question.

LegacyCharacter.name: Legacy Character
LegacyCharacter.def: An identity is taken on by a new character after the original holder of the identity stops using it for whatever reason.

LikesClarkKentHatesSuperman.name: Likes Clark Kent, Hates Superman
LikesClarkKentHatesSuperman.def: Someone is friends with a superhero's alter ego, but despises the superhero.

LostInCharacter.name: Lost in Character
LostInCharacter.def: A character becomes so immersed in acting as their In-Universe character, they stop acting like themselves or forget who they are.

LouisCypher.name: Louis Cypher
LouisCypher.def: Satan disguises himself using an alias that fails to be subtle.

MistakenFromBehind.name: Mistaken from Behind
MistakenFromBehind.def: Someone mistakes a stranger for someone they know because the stranger resembles the person they know when viewed from the back.

MyCard.name: My Card
MyCard.def: A character hands someone their business card, or a similar card with identifying information.

MyselfMyAvatar.name: Myself, My Avatar
MyselfMyAvatar.def: Someone's mind is "implanted" into a physical or virtual body, often while their original body is unconscious or "asleep."

MySiblingWillLiveThroughMe.name: My Sibling Will Live Through Me
MySiblingWillLiveThroughMe.def: Someone takes on the identity of a deceased relative.

NoDoubtTheYearsHaveChangedMe.name: No Doubt the Years Have Changed Me
NoDoubtTheYearsHaveChangedMe.def: A character is virtually unrecognizable after a long absence.

NoLivingRecord.name: No Living Record
NoLivingRecord.def: A character's birth went unregistered or undocumented, and as a consequence, they don't exist in official records or the eyes of the law.

NotHimself.name: Not Himself
NotHimself.def: A character's Out of Character behavior is central to the plot.

ObliviousToHisOwnDescription.name: Oblivious to His Own Description
ObliviousToHisOwnDescription.def: Someone hears a description of themselves, but doesn't realize that they are the one being described.

OldFriendNewGender.name: Old Friend, New Gender
OldFriendNewGender.def: A character discovers that their Childhood Friend is transgender when they meet after many years apart.

PainfulPersona.name: Painful Persona
PainfulPersona.def: Someone is forced to adopt a personality that is at odds with their true self.

PersonalitySwap.name: Personality Swap
PersonalitySwap.def: People swap personality traits, but not minds.

PhotoDoodleRecognition.name: Photo Doodle Recognition
PhotoDoodleRecognition.def: Doodling details on a photograph of a person reveals the identity of said person.

PreferableImpersonator.name: Preferable Impersonator
PreferableImpersonator.def: The imposter is more liked than the original.

RealNameAsAnAlias.name: Real Name as an Alias
RealNameAsAnAlias.def: A character's real name serves as the basis for their alias.

RediscoveringRootsTrip.name: "Rediscovering Roots" Trip
RediscoveringRootsTrip.def: Someone was raised in another culture, but returns to their family's motherland in a quest for self-identity.

SecondSuperIdentity.name: Second Super-Identity
SecondSuperIdentity.def: A superhero who already has an alter-ego creates another alter-ego.

SecretIdentityIdentity.name: Secret-Identity Identity
SecretIdentityIdentity.def: It's called into question on whether the alias or the secret identity is the real person.

SharedIdentity.name: Shared Identity
SharedIdentity.def: Without trying to impersonate each other, multiple characters simultaneously use the same identity.

SelfProclaimedKnight.name: Self-Proclaimed Knight
SelfProclaimedKnight.def: Someone claims to be a knight when they aren't.

ShapeshifterIdentityCrisis.name: Shapeshifter Identity Crisis
ShapeshifterIdentityCrisis.def: A character that can shapeshift loses their sense of self, and thus control of their abilities.

SplitPersonality.name: Split Personality
SplitPersonality.def: One character is "host" to two or more entirely separate personalities.

SplitPersonalityMerge.name: Split-Personality Merge
SplitPersonalityMerge.def: The conflicting personalities merge into a single stable personality, often with traits from both.

SplitPersonalityTakeover.name: Split-Personality Takeover
SplitPersonalityTakeover.def: The crazier personality either completely erases or puts into submission the weaker, sane personality to become the dominant personality.

SpotTheImposter.name: Spot the Imposter
SpotTheImposter.def: The character is seen with their impersonator, resulting in their friends having to figure out which is the real person and which is the phony.

StartingANewLife.name: Starting a New Life
StartingANewLife.def: A character, unable to return to their previous life, decides to start anew (possibly with a new identity).

ThatManIsDead.name: That Man Is Dead
ThatManIsDead.def: Upon taking a new identity, the person regards their original identity as dead.

ThemedAliases.name: Themed Aliases
ThemedAliases.def: Someone has multiple aliases, all of which share a similar pattern or theme.

ThisIsMyNameOnForeign.name: This Is My Name on Foreign
ThisIsMyNameOnForeign.def: A character uses a foreign language version of their name as an alias.

ThoroughlyMistakenIdentity.name: Thoroughly Mistaken Identity
ThoroughlyMistakenIdentity.def: Someone's diminished mental capacity or delusions cause them to believe a character is someone else.

TomatoInTheMirror.name: Tomato in the Mirror
TomatoInTheMirror.def: A person's true nature is revealed and it turns out that even they were unaware of the secret.

TwinTest.name: Twin Test
TwinTest.def: A character is tasked with differentiating between identical siblings by at least one of those siblings.

TwoAliasesOneCharacter.name: Two Aliases, One Character
TwoAliasesOneCharacter.def: Two characters are revealed to be the same person.

WarCriminalInVictimsClothing.name: War Criminal in Victim's Clothing
WarCriminalInVictimsClothing.def: A fugitive War Criminal adopts the identity of one of their own victims to hide from the authorities.

YouAreAlreadyCheckedIn.name: You Are Already Checked In
YouAreAlreadyCheckedIn.def: Someone arrives at a secure facility and is told they're already checked in, which must mean someone impersonating them is inside.

AccentUponTheWrongSyllable.name: AcCENT upon the Wrong SylLABle
AccentUponTheWrongSyllable.def: A character emphasizes the wrong parts of a word when pronouncing it.

AcquiredErrorAtThePrinter.name: Acquired Error at the Printer
AcquiredErrorAtThePrinter.def: A minor mistake in a printed sign renders the meaning completely different, usually something inappropriate.

AcronymAndAbbreviationOverload.name: Acronym and Abbreviation Overload
AcronymAndAbbreviationOverload.def: A character has a tendency to use acronyms and abbreviations constantly.

AcronymConfusion.name: Acronym Confusion
AcronymConfusion.def: One abbreviation is mistaken for another.

AcronymsAreEasyAsAybeecee.name: Acronyms Are Easy as Aybeecee
AcronymsAreEasyAsAybeecee.def: A character mishears or miswrites an acronym as if it's a normal word.

AICronym.name: A.I.-cronym
AICronym.def: AI/Robots/machines are often given names. These names are typically an acronym for a phrase at least tangentially related to their purpose.

AliensSpeakingEnglish.name: Aliens Speaking English
AliensSpeakingEnglish.def: Aliens are already able to speak English in spite of never visiting Earth before.

AlternateCatchphraseInflection.name: Alternate Catchphrase Inflection
AlternateCatchphraseInflection.def: When a character says their catchphrase in a different tone of voice than normal.

AlternateCharacterReading.name: Alternate Character Reading
AlternateCharacterReading.def: When Japanese words have different pronunciations and thus meanings.

AmbiguousSyntax.name: Ambiguous Syntax
AmbiguousSyntax.def: The phrasing of a sentence allows for more than one interpretation of what the sentence means.

AnimalTalk.name: Animal Talk
AnimalTalk.def: All animal species can communicate with each other, except for humans.

AntiquatedLinguistics.name: Antiquated Linguistics
AntiquatedLinguistics.def: The antiquated speech patterns of 18th-19th century English are used in a modern-day setting

ApeSignLanguage.name: Ape Sign Language
ApeSignLanguage.def: Apes can use American Sign Language to communicate with humans.

ArabBeobleTalk.name: Arab Beoble Talk
ArabBeobleTalk.def: Stereotypical depictions of Middle Eastern accents.

ArtificialScript.name: Artificial Script
ArtificialScript.def: When a work uses an original alphabet or writing system.

AsianSpeekeeEngrish.name: Asian Speekee Engrish
AsianSpeekeeEngrish.def: East Asian people speaking in stereotypical broken English.

AsLongAsItSoundsForeign.name: As Long as It Sounds Foreign
AsLongAsItSoundsForeign.def: A foreign language is depicted with not a single ounce of accuracy.

AtomicFBomb.name: Atomic F-Bomb
AtomicFBomb.def: Someone hollers the word "fuck" or another swear word as loud as they can.

AuthorVocabularyCalendar.name: Author Vocabulary Calendar
AuthorVocabularyCalendar.def: A work gratuitously uses a rarely-used word several times.

AutoIncorrect.name: Auto-Incorrect
AutoIncorrect.def: Autocorrect or speech-to-text software screws up a statement.

BabysFirstWords.name: Baby's First Words
BabysFirstWords.def: A baby's first words, which are often heartwarming or funny.

BabyTalk.name: Baby Talk
BabyTalk.def: Babies and toddlers speak, but have speech impediments because of their age.

BilingualAnimal.name: Bilingual Animal
BilingualAnimal.def: An animal that speaks both a human language and its animal language.

BilingualBackfire.name: Bilingual Backfire
BilingualBackfire.def: Trash-talking someone in another language is not the stealth move you think it is when the subject knows that language.

BilingualBonus.name: Bilingual Bonus
BilingualBonus.def: A work has some untranslated words in a different language.

BilingualDialogue.name: Bilingual Dialogue
BilingualDialogue.def: Two characters understand each other perfectly despite each talking in a different language.

BilingualRhyme.name: Bilingual Rhyme
BilingualRhyme.def: Rhyming words of one language with another.

BinomiumRidiculus.name: Binomium ridiculus
BinomiumRidiculus.def: A creature is given a fictitious, silly-sounding Latin name.

BiteTheWaxTadpole.name: Bite the Wax Tadpole
BiteTheWaxTadpole.def: Names and slogans sound ridiculous or inappropriate when imported into another language.

BlackSpeech.name: Black Speech
BlackSpeech.def: An evil language that hurts non-evil listeners.

BlindIdiotTranslation.name: "Blind Idiot" Translation
BlindIdiotTranslation.def: Something ends up translated too literally.

BrandNameTakeover.name: Brand Name Takeover
BrandNameTakeover.def: A brand becomes the generic word for something.

BrokenDialectImpactfulSpeech.name: Broken Dialect, Impactful Speech
BrokenDialectImpactfulSpeech.def: A character's lack of fluency doesn't stop their words from holding weight.

BuffySpeak.name: Buffy Speak
BuffySpeak.def: Someone doesn't know the word for something and does things like add "Y"s on the end, call it a "thingy", etc.

BusmansVocabulary.name: Busman's Vocabulary
BusmansVocabulary.def: Someone's vocabulary coincides with their job.

ByNoIMeanYes.name: By "No", I Mean "Yes"
ByNoIMeanYes.def: A character says one thing and then follows up that they meant to say the opposite.

CalculatorSpelling.name: Calculator Spelling
CalculatorSpelling.def: Using the seven-segment display on a calculator (usually turned upside-down) to spell out something.

CallAnApeAMonkey.name: Call an Ape a "Monkey"
CallAnApeAMonkey.def: Incorrectly referring to apes as "monkeys" or vice versa.

CallARabbitASmeerp.name: Call a Rabbit a "Smeerp"
CallARabbitASmeerp.def: A mundane animal is given an unusual name.

CallASmeerpARabbit.name: Call a Smeerp a "Rabbit"
CallASmeerpARabbit.def: A bizarre creature is given the name of a mundane animal.

ClassicalTongue.name: Classical Tongue
ClassicalTongue.def: A language that isn't extinct, but is so rare that it's only used by educated elites.

Cloudcuckoolanguage.name: Cloudcuckoolanguage
Cloudcuckoolanguage.def: A goofy character has their own language.

ClusterFBomb.name: Cluster F-Bomb
ClusterFBomb.def: Someone repeatedly uses cuss words (commonly the F-word, hence the name) in a single sentence.

CommonTongue.name: Common Tongue
CommonTongue.def: Disparate groups, which might have their own cultural languages, nevertheless use a shared language to communicate.

CongestionSpeak.name: Congestion Speak
CongestionSpeak.def: A character's written dialogue is misspelled (for instance, replacing "N"s with "D"s) to indicate they have a stuffy nose.

Conlang.name: Conlang
Conlang.def: A language that has been intentionally designed instead of developing organically.

ConvenientlyPreciseTranslation.name: Conveniently Precise Translation
ConvenientlyPreciseTranslation.def: Nothing ever gets Lost in Translation in fiction, unless it's relevant to the plot.

ConversationHog.name: Conversation Hog
ConversationHog.def: When a character keeps another from getting a word or a defense in-edgewise.

Crunchtastic.name: Crunchtastic
Crunchtastic.def: An ad uses nonsense adjectives that sound positive, either as Weasel Words or for comedy.

CurseOfBabel.name: Curse of Babel
CurseOfBabel.def: A character loses the ability to speak intelligibly.

CypherLanguage.name: Cypher Language
CypherLanguage.def: Writing dialogue in your own language, then doing a simple cypher that replaces one letter with another and having characters speak in the cypher. Ov xuslt qsivva ximm og auy hu wuxim vu wuxim epf duptupepv vu duptupepv. note But not great. Some consonants are always going to cause problems. The vow

DelusionsOfEloquence.name: Delusions of Eloquence
DelusionsOfEloquence.def: A character tries to use big words to look smart, and fails.

DidNotDoTheBloodyResearch.name: Did Not Do the Bloody Research
DidNotDoTheBloodyResearch.def: A work imported to another country causes controversy over the use of words that are more offensive there than in the country of origin.

DinnerOrderFlub.name: Dinner Order Flub
DinnerOrderFlub.def: A waiter gets an order wrong.

Dissimile.name: Dissimile
Dissimile.def: Comparing two things that are nothing alike.

DoesNotSpeakCommon.name: Does Not Speak Common
DoesNotSpeakCommon.def: A character mostly speaks in a different language from the rest of the cast.

DontCallMeSir.name: Don't Call Me "Sir"
DontCallMeSir.def: A person doesn't like formal titles.

EitherWorldDominationOrSomethingAboutBan.name: Either "World Domination", or Something About Bananas
EitherWorldDominationOrSomethingAboutBan.def: A character translates another character as having said either a logical phrase or a silly one.

ElNinoIsSpanishForTheNino.name: "El Niño" Is Spanish for "The Niño"
ElNinoIsSpanishForTheNino.def: Words are translated identically between languages.

ElmuhFuddSyndwome.name: Elmuh Fudd Syndwome
ElmuhFuddSyndwome.def: A speech impediment where Ls and Rs are pronounced as if they were Ws.

EloquentInMyNativeTongue.name: Eloquent in My Native Tongue
EloquentInMyNativeTongue.def: A character is highly articulate in their native language.

EntendreFailure.name: Entendre Failure
EntendreFailure.def: The more risque meaning of a Double Entendre is lost on someone.

EternalEnglish.name: Eternal English
EternalEnglish.def: Everything else may change in time travel, but the language doesn't.

EvenTheSubtitlerIsStumped.name: Even the Subtitler Is Stumped
EvenTheSubtitlerIsStumped.def: When subtitles show up to translate the dialogue of someone speaking a foreign language, there will eventually be subtitles left blank because it's become impossible to translate the current saying.

ExpositoryPronoun.name: Expository Pronoun
ExpositoryPronoun.def: The specific pronouns that characters use say a lot about their character.

FamiliarSoundtrackForeignLyrics.name: Familiar Soundtrack, Foreign Lyrics
FamiliarSoundtrackForeignLyrics.def: A well-known song is covered in another language in-universe.

FanSub.name: Fan Sub
FanSub.def: A foreign work is unofficially given translating subtitles by fans.

FantasticSlurs.name: Fantastic Slurs
FantasticSlurs.def: Slurs aimed at people who are discriminated for their species rather than their ethnicity.

FanTranslation.name: Fan Translation
FanTranslation.def: An unofficial translation of a work created by amateurs.

FauxFluency.name: Faux Fluency
FauxFluency.def: A character fluent in a particular language is portrayed by an actor who isn't.

FictionalSlang.name: Fictional Slang
FictionalSlang.def: Fictional vernacular, insults, and cuss words unique to a fictional setting.

Fictionary.name: Fictionary
Fictionary.def: A made-up language based heavily on a real language.

FloweryElizabethanEnglish.name: Flowery Elizabethan English
FloweryElizabethanEnglish.def: A character talks like they're from the time of Shakespeare even when they're not.

FloweryInsults.name: Flowery Insults
FloweryInsults.def: Someone uses a well-developed and highly detailed insult.

FontAnachronism.name: Font Anachronism
FontAnachronism.def: Use of a typeface in a work where it didn't exist yet.

ForeignersWriteBackwards.name: Foreigners Write Backwards
ForeignersWriteBackwards.def: Fictional foreign languages are written in a different direction.

ForeignLanguageTirade.name: Foreign-Language Tirade
ForeignLanguageTirade.def: When the Bilingual Bonus is an angry rant.

ForeignLookingFont.name: Foreign-Looking Font
ForeignLookingFont.def: Depicting a foreign language by writing English in a different typeface.

FormalCharactersUseKeigo.name: Formal Characters Use Keigo
FormalCharactersUseKeigo.def: The association with formal Japanese speech with people who are polite, old-fashioned, mild-mannered, refined, or a combination thereof.

FrighteningForeignLanguage.name: Frightening Foreign Language
FrighteningForeignLanguage.def: A foreign language is used in order to unnerve or scare people, both In-Universe and/or the viewers.

FromTheLatinIntroDucere.name: From the Latin "Intro Ducere"
FromTheLatinIntroDucere.def: Introducing a concept with the word's etymology.

FunWithAcronyms.name: Fun with Acronyms
FunWithAcronyms.def: Acronyms that stand for or spell out something funny.

FunWithForeignLanguages.name: Fun with Foreign Languages
FunWithForeignLanguages.def: Comedic situations born from the use of multiple languages.

FunWithHomophones.name: Fun with Homophones
FunWithHomophones.def: Confusion between two different words that sound the same.

FunWithPalindromes.name: Fun with Palindromes
FunWithPalindromes.def: Words or sentences that are spelt the same backwards.

FunWithSubtitles.name: Fun with Subtitles
FunWithSubtitles.def: The subtitles are used in humorous ways.

FutureSlang.name: Future Slang
FutureSlang.def: The future has new slang words.

GenderVocabularySlip.name: Gender Vocabulary Slip
GenderVocabularySlip.def: A character pretending to be the opposite gender blows their cover by using language associated with their own gender.

Gesundheit.name: Gesundheit
Gesundheit.def: Mistaking a word for a sneeze.

GetTheeToANunnery.name: Get Thee to a Nunnery
GetTheeToANunnery.def: Things that were meant to sound dirty in the past, but sound clean now.

GoodBadTranslation.name: Good Bad Translation
GoodBadTranslation.def: A translation that is so terrible, it's humorous.

GoshDangItToHeck.name: Gosh Dang It to Heck!
GoshDangItToHeck.def: Non-profane exclamations stand in for profanity.

GotMeDoingIt.name: Got Me Doing It
GotMeDoingIt.def: A character complains about slipping into the vocabulary habits they just berated another person for using.

GoToTheEuphemism.name: Go to the Euphemism
GoToTheEuphemism.def: A character uses a euphemism for "bathroom" or what you do there.

HashHouseLingo.def: Restaurants have their own slang for menu items.

HaveAGayOldTime.name: Have a Gay Old Time
HaveAGayOldTime.def: Phrases that sound dirty now because of the evolution of language.

HidingBehindTheLanguageBarrier.name: Hiding Behind the Language Barrier
HidingBehindTheLanguageBarrier.def: Two people have a private conversation by speaking to each other in a language they know a third party won't understand.

HoldYourHippogriffs.name: Hold Your Hippogriffs
HoldYourHippogriffs.def: A work of fiction has the characters use different versions of familiar phrases and figures of speech due to the setting preventing the normal versions of the statements from making any sense.

HollywoodSpelling.name: Hollywood Spelling
HollywoodSpelling.def: Nobody asks how a word is spelled unless it's relevant to the plot.

HowDoYouSay.name: How Do You Say
HowDoYouSay.def: A Stock Phrase for a Funny Foreigner .

HulkSpeak.name: Hulk Speak
HulkSpeak.def: A character speaks in third person and uses incomplete sentences.

IceCreamKoan.name: Ice-Cream Koan
IceCreamKoan.def: It sounds deep, but it's completely meaningless.

IDoNotSpeakNonverbal.name: I Do Not Speak Nonverbal
IDoNotSpeakNonverbal.def: When attempts to communicate without speech fail.

IJustLikeSayingTheWord.name: I Just Like Saying the Word
IJustLikeSayingTheWord.def: A character repeats a phrase simply because they like the sound of it.

IncidentalMultilingualWordplay.name: Incidental Multilingual Wordplay
IncidentalMultilingualWordplay.def: When wordplay coincidentally works just as well in one language as another.

InconsistentSpelling.name: Inconsistent Spelling
InconsistentSpelling.def: A name or term from a work doesn't have a consistent official spelling.

IndoEuropeanAlienLanguage.name: Indo-European Alien Language
IndoEuropeanAlienLanguage.def: Alien languages follow the English grammar system.

InformedObscenity.name: Informed Obscenity
InformedObscenity.def: A nonsensical or innocuous word is treated as if it were a profanity.

InexplicableLanguageFluency.name: Inexplicable Language Fluency
InexplicableLanguageFluency.def: A character understands a language they've never seen/heard before.

InexplicablySpeaksFluentAlien.name: Inexplicably Speaks Fluent Alien
InexplicablySpeaksFluentAlien.def: A character somehow understands a language from another planet.

InherentlyFunnyWords.name: Inherently Funny Words
InherentlyFunnyWords.def: Words that are intrinsically amusing to say.

InMyLanguageThatSoundsLike.name: In My Language, That Sounds Like...
InMyLanguageThatSoundsLike.def: The pronunciation of one thing sounds like something else in another language.

InsultingFromBehindTheLanguageBarrier.name: Insulting from Behind the Language Barrier
InsultingFromBehindTheLanguageBarrier.def: A character insults another in a language they don't understand.

IntentionalEngrishForFunny.name: Intentional Engrish for Funny
IntentionalEngrishForFunny.def: Bad English is put in for comedy.

IntentionallyAwkwardTitle.name: Intentionally Awkward Title
IntentionallyAwkwardTitle.def: When a title is deliberately awkward to say out loud.

InternationalPopSongEnglish.name: International Pop Song English
InternationalPopSongEnglish.def: The standard, non-regional English accent used by singers regardless of nationality

InTheLocalTongue.name: In the Local Tongue
InTheLocalTongue.def: It sounds cool in its own language, but stupid or boring when translated back into English.

InventedLinguisticDistinction.name: Invented Linguistic Distinction
InventedLinguisticDistinction.def: Even a fictional setting has regional dialects

ItIsDehumanizing.name: "It" Is Dehumanizing
ItIsDehumanizing.def: Calling a person "it" to show that you do not consider them human.

JapaneseRanguage.name: Japanese Ranguage
JapaneseRanguage.def: The stereotype that Asians can't distinguish between "L" and "R" sounds.

LanguageBarrier.name: Language Barrier
LanguageBarrier.def: Trouble arises because people don't speak the same language.

LanguageEqualsThought.name: Language Equals Thought
LanguageEqualsThought.def: If the word for something doesn't exist in a language, the concept of it doesn't exist in the language's culture either.

LanguageFluencyReveal.name: Language Fluency Reveal
LanguageFluencyReveal.def: When Language Fluency Denial backfires or is exposed.

LanguageOfMagic.name: Language of Magic
LanguageOfMagic.def: Casting spells by speaking in another language.

LastSecondWordSwap.name: Last-Second Word Swap
LastSecondWordSwap.def: Replacing the last word you intended to say at the last minute.

LearningEnglishInTheEnglishDub.name: Learning English in the English Dub
LearningEnglishInTheEnglishDub.def: When a work is translated into a different language, said language is still portrayed as foreign In-Universe to the characters.

LearntEnglishFromWatchingTelevision.name: Learnt English from Watching Television
LearntEnglishFromWatchingTelevision.def: Non-humans learn to speak English from watching television broadcasts.

LeastRhymableWord.name: Least Rhymable Word
LeastRhymableWord.def: Someone tries to find a rhyming word to a word that has little or no known rhymes.

LeetLingo.name: Leet Lingo
LeetLingo.def: Obfuscating words by replacing letters with similar-looking numbers and symbols.

LeftFieldDescription.name: Left Field Description
LeftFieldDescription.def: Describing important bits in unconventional ways that don't necessarily jump out to the reader.

Letters2Numbers.name: Letters 2 Numbers
Letters2Numbers.def: Writing words as numbers with the same pronunciation.

LikeIsLikeAComma.name: Like Is, Like, a Comma
LikeIsLikeAComma.def: A character says, "like" in between every other word.

LostLanguage.name: Lost Language
LostLanguage.def: An extinct language that nobody knows how to read or translate.

LostInTranslation.name: Lost in Translation
LostInTranslation.def: The semantics of a work disappear when translated into another language.

LuckyCharmsTitle.name: Lucky Charms Title
LuckyCharmsTitle.def: Symbols that are not letters are used in a title.

LyricalTic.name: Lyrical Tic
LyricalTic.def: A singer often uses a particular vocalization in their works.

MagicalForeignWords.name: Magical Foreign Words
MagicalForeignWords.def: Using words in another language as magic spells.

MagicalProfanityFilter.name: Magical Profanity Filter
MagicalProfanityFilter.def: A magic spell or other in-universe effect that prevents characters from swearing.

Magick.name: Magick
Magick.def: Adding a "k" transforms it from flashy illusion to spiritual practice.

MametSpeak.name: Mamet Speak
MametSpeak.def: Characters speak quickly, vulgarly, and over the top of one another.

Metaphorgotten.name: Metaphorgotten
Metaphorgotten.def: A character starts off with a metaphor or analogy, but then gets sidetracked by what the metaphor or analogy implies.

MisspellingOutLoud.name: Misspelling Out Loud
MisspellingOutLoud.def: A character tries to spell a word out loud, but either gets it wrong or unintentionally spells a completely different word.

MistakenForName.name: Mistaken for Name
MistakenForName.def: Characters humorously misunderstand or misinterpret cues or phrases as names.

MixedMetaphor.name: Mixed Metaphor
MixedMetaphor.def: Combining two figures of speech into one weird phrase.

MouthingTheProfanity.name: Mouthing the Profanity
MouthingTheProfanity.def: When a character needs to say a swear word but can't bring themselves to voice it out loud.

MultilingualSong.name: Multilingual Song
MultilingualSong.def: A song sung in more than one language.

MultipleLanguagesSameVoiceActor.name: Multiple Languages, Same Voice Actor
MultipleLanguagesSameVoiceActor.def: The different dubs of a work have one actor reprising their role for the translations.

MultipleReferencePun.name: Multiple Reference Pun
MultipleReferencePun.def: Wordplay based on three or more meanings.

MyHovercraftIsFullOfEels.name: My Hovercraft Is Full of Eels
MyHovercraftIsFullOfEels.def: A character attempts to speak a foreign language, but ends up getting someone mad by unintentionally saying an insulting phrase or embarrassing themselves because their statement translates as meaningless nonsense or a humiliating phrase.

NarrativeProfanityFilter.name: Narrative Profanity Filter
NarrativeProfanityFilter.def: The narrator implies or outright confirms that a character swore when the audience doesn't hear the character use profanity.

Neologizer.name: Neologizer
Neologizer.def: A character makes up a lot of words to sound cool.

NerdsSpeakKlingon.name: Nerds Speak Klingon
NerdsSpeakKlingon.def: Geeks communicate with one another in the fictional languages of the works they like.

NobleTongue.name: Noble Tongue
NobleTongue.def: The upper-class speak a completely different language from the common folk

NonIndicativeName.name: Non-Indicative Name
NonIndicativeName.def: A character's name does not match who they are.

NoPunctuationIsFunnier.name: no punctuation is funnier
NoPunctuationIsFunnier.def: Written phrases sound more comedic because of a lack of punctuation

NoPunctuationPeriod.name: No Punctuation Period
NoPunctuationPeriod.def: A work uses no punctuation whatsoever

NuSpeling.name: Nu Speling
NuSpeling.def: In the future, words are spelled as if they were written or typed by barely-literate children.

ObligatorySwearing.name: Obligatory Swearing
ObligatorySwearing.def: A work features profanity just because it's an adult story.

YeOldeButcheredeEnglishe.name: Ye Olde Butcherede Englishe
YeOldeButcheredeEnglishe.def: Comedic parodical use of archaic English terms.

Omniglot.name: Omniglot
Omniglot.def: A character who can speak many languages.

OnceForYesTwiceForNo.name: Once for Yes, Twice for No
OnceForYesTwiceForNo.def: Trying to make the most of limited communication ability.

OneTwoThreeFourGo.name: One, Two, Three, Four, Go!
OneTwoThreeFourGo.def: Wordplay revolving around the Japanese word for 'five' sounding like the English word 'go'.

OrphanedEtymology.name: Orphaned Etymology
OrphanedEtymology.def: Characters use real-world words that should not exist in their universe.

OtherworldlyCommunicationFailure.name: Otherworldly Communication Failure
OtherworldlyCommunicationFailure.def: Speaking a language not known to humans may be the cause of this trope.

OverlyLiteralTranscription.name: Overly Literal Transcription
OverlyLiteralTranscription.def: Instructions not meant to be printed out or recited are done so anyway.

PeriodPieceModernLanguage.name: Period Piece, Modern Language
PeriodPieceModernLanguage.def: The production is a posh historical one, the language is not.

PersonAsVerb.name: Person as Verb
PersonAsVerb.def: A person's name is used as a verb pertaining to an action appropriate to the person's behavior and reputation.

PhantasySpelling.name: Phantasy Spelling
PhantasySpelling.def: When a fantasy setting spells words differently

PigLatin.name: Pig Latin
PigLatin.def: A language where you move the first consonant or consonants at the beginning of every word to the end followed by "ay", or just "ay" if the first letter is a vowel. (example: "I-ay ould-way ike-lay o-tay ing-say.")

PointOfView.name: Point of View
PointOfView.def: The perspective from which a story is told.

PoirotSpeak.name: Poirot Speak
PoirotSpeak.def: A character has difficulty properly speaking the English language.

PokemonSpeak.name: Pokémon Speak
PokemonSpeak.def: A character never says anything other than their own name.

PopularSayingBut.name: [Popular Saying], But...
PopularSayingBut.def: A character subverts a well-known idiom or proverb for laughs

Portmanteau.name: Portmanteau
Portmanteau.def: A word that is a combination of two or more individual words.

ThePowerOfLanguage.name: The Power of Language
ThePowerOfLanguage.def: When language itself is a central theme of a work.

PrecisionFStrike.name: Precision F-Strike
PrecisionFStrike.def: A character who doesn't usually swear ends up saying a curse word out of the blue, or a work that usually doesn't feature profanity features some at one point (or alternatively, a work that usually features mild profanity features a case of strong profanity).

PrepositionsAreNotToEndSentencesWith.name: Prepositions Are Not to End Sentences With
PrepositionsAreNotToEndSentencesWith.def: The misconception that ending a sentence with a preposition (a direction-related word like "to" or "through") is grammatically incorrect.

PretentiousLatinMotto.name: Pretentious Latin Motto
PretentiousLatinMotto.def: Need to know something is fancy? Give it a Latin motto.

PretentiousPronunciation.name: Pretentious Pronunciation
PretentiousPronunciation.def: A word gets pronounced in a pseudo-foreign manner in an attempt to sound fancy.

PrimordialTongue.name: Primordial Tongue
PrimordialTongue.def: One language spoken by the first humans that is the ancestor of all existing languages.

TheProblemWithPenIsland.name: The Problem with Pen Island
TheProblemWithPenIsland.def: Because website URL s do not have spaces between words, certain website names can be misread as something else.

PronounTrouble.name: Pronoun Trouble
PronounTrouble.def: Avoiding the use of pronouns to conceal a character's gender.

PsmithPsyndrome.name: Psmith Psyndrome
PsmithPsyndrome.def: A character somehow notices spelling mistakes in spoken language.

PunctuationChangesTheMeaning.name: Punctuation Changes the Meaning
PunctuationChangesTheMeaning.def: When the use of punctuation changes the tone of what is being said.

PunctuationShaker.name: Punctuation Shaker
PunctuationShaker.def: Names with punctuation marks in them.

TheQueensLatin.name: The Queen's Latin
TheQueensLatin.def: Characters in historical settings like ancient Rome speak English with British accents.

RapidFireDescriptors.name: Rapid-Fire Descriptors
RapidFireDescriptors.def: Using a LOT of adjectives for something.

RealisticDictionIsUnrealistic.name: Realistic Diction Is Unrealistic
RealisticDictionIsUnrealistic.def: Fictional characters speak without using filler words , tripping over words, awkward pauses or interrupting each other mid-sentence.

RealLanguageRepresentsFictional.name: Real Language Represents Fictional
RealLanguageRepresentsFictional.def: The author depicts a fictional language used by the characters by using a Real Life foreign language to represent it.

RecursiveAcronym.name: Recursive Acronym
RecursiveAcronym.def: The acronym stands for the acronym itself.

RecursiveTranslation.name: Recursive Translation
RecursiveTranslation.def: Translating something back and forth completely mangles it.

RichLanguagePoorLanguage.name: Rich Language, Poor Language
RichLanguagePoorLanguage.def: Rich and poor characters are distinguished by their accents and/or dialects.

RoboSpeak.name: Robo-Speak
RoboSpeak.def: Robots speak very differently from humans.

RougeAnglesOfSatin.name: Rouge Angles of Satin
RougeAnglesOfSatin.def: A spelling mistake results in a whole different word.

Scanlation.name: Scanlation
Scanlation.def: An unofficial translation of a comic.

ScareQuotes.name: Scare Quotes
ScareQuotes.def: Using quotation marks to indicate disdain or doubt of a so-called "word".

ScaryScienceWords.name: Scary Science Words
ScaryScienceWords.def: A character is intimidated by technical-sounding words.

SdrawkcabSpeech.name: Sdrawkcab Speech
SdrawkcabSpeech.def: Speech played or written in reverse.

SeparatedByACommonLanguage.name: Separated by a Common Language
SeparatedByACommonLanguage.def: American English and British English have certain differences in the terms used.

SesquipedalianLoquaciousness.name: Sesquipedalian Loquaciousness
SesquipedalianLoquaciousness.def: A character tends to use big words.

ShoehornedFirstLetter.name: Shoehorned First Letter
ShoehornedFirstLetter.def: Forcing an acronym to work by sticking a letter in front of a word where it doesn't belong.

SingleLanguagePlanet.name: Single Language Planet
SingleLanguagePlanet.def: Everyone on this planet speaks the same language.

SmartPeopleKnowLatin.name: Smart People Know Latin
SmartPeopleKnowLatin.def: You just know this character's a genius if they can speak Latin.

SommelierSpeak.name: Sommelier Speak
SommelierSpeak.def: Describing wine with overly flowery language.

SonOfAnApe.name: Son of an Ape
SonOfAnApe.def: Non-human characters insult humans using primate terminology.

SophisticatedAsHell.name: Sophisticated as Hell
SophisticatedAsHell.def: A character who usually speaks sophisticated and politely suddenly resorts to using slang and profanity.

SpaceX.name: Space "X"
SpaceX.def: Want something to sound futuristic? Just add the word "Space" to it.

SpellMyNameWithAThe.name: Spell My Name with a "The"
SpellMyNameWithAThe.def: A character is frequently addressed with "The" in front of their name.

SpeakingLikeTotallyTeen.name: Speaking Like Totally Teen
SpeakingLikeTotallyTeen.def: A character uses cheesy slang to appeal to young people, and embarrass themselves as a result.

SpeakingSimlish.name: Speaking Simlish
SpeakingSimlish.def: Characters speak in an unintelligible language where the meaning of what they say is unknown and irrelevant.

SpeaksInShoutOuts.name: Speaks in Shout-Outs
SpeaksInShoutOuts.def: Most of this character's lines are pop culture references.

SpeechCentricWork.name: Speech-Centric Work
SpeechCentricWork.def: A work that is particularly dialogue-heavy.

SpellingForEmphasis.name: Spelling for Emphasis
SpellingForEmphasis.def: Spelling out a word to emphasise it.

SpockSpeak.name: Spock Speak
SpockSpeak.def: Talking in a precise, formal manner void of emotion or slang.

Spoonerism.name: Spoonerism
Spoonerism.def: Switching the first letters of two words (e.g. saying "whack and blight" instead of "black and white")

Sssssnaketalk.name: Sssssnaketalk
Sssssnaketalk.def: Snakes and snake-like characters emphasize their Ss by hissing.

StarfishLanguage.name: Starfish Language
StarfishLanguage.def: Characters speak in a language of non-linguistic symbols.

StealthPun.name: Stealth Pun
StealthPun.def: A play on words that is subtle.

StrangeSyntaxSpeaker.name: Strange-Syntax Speaker
StrangeSyntaxSpeaker.def: An unusual word order this character uses.

StupidlyLongFillerSound.name: Stupidly Long Filler Sound
StupidlyLongFillerSound.def: A ditzy character exaggerates their speech disfluency when asked even the simplest of questions.

StutterStop.name: Stutter Stop
StutterStop.def: A character who usually stutters doesn't when things are serious.

SuddenlyBilingual.name: Suddenly Bilingual
SuddenlyBilingual.def: A character suddenly reveals they can speak another language.

SuddenlyFluentInGibberish.name: Suddenly Fluent in Gibberish
SuddenlyFluentInGibberish.def: It's suddenly revealed that a character Speaks Fluent Animal or can speak a made-up language.

SupernaturalLanguage.name: Supernatural Language
SupernaturalLanguage.def: A language that has a supernatural quality.

SurprisinglyBadNativeLanguage.name: Surprisingly Bad Native Language
SurprisinglyBadNativeLanguage.def: A character supposedly speaks in their native tongue, but it's clear that this is not the writers' native tongue.

SwitchToEnglish.name: Switch to English
SwitchToEnglish.def: Characters begin speaking in another language, then switch to the language of the work for in-universe reasons.

TWordEuphemism.name: T-Word Euphemism
TWordEuphemism.def: Referring to a word as "the [letter] word".

TactfulTranslation.name: Tactful Translation
TactfulTranslation.def: A character refuses to translate something rude into another language.

TalkingIsAFreeAction.name: Talking Is a Free Action
TalkingIsAFreeAction.def: Even in crucial situations where every second counts, there's always enough time for conversation.

TalkLikeAPirate.name: Talk Like a Pirate
TalkLikeAPirate.def: Pirates use expressions like "Arrr!", "Shiver me timbers", "ye", "me hearties", and "be" in the place of "is".

TeasingFromBehindTheLanguageBarrier.name: Teasing from Behind the Language Barrier
TeasingFromBehindTheLanguageBarrier.def: A character playfully teases another by using a language they don't speak.

TerseTalker.name: Terse Talker
TerseTalker.def: A character speaks curtly and in very short sentences.

ThatSoundsFamiliar.name: That Sounds Familiar
ThatSoundsFamiliar.def: Using a corrupted version of a word or phrase whilst not understanding the context of the original.

TheyCallMeMisterTibbs.name: They Call Me MISTER Tibbs!
TheyCallMeMisterTibbs.def: A character insists on being addressed formally.

ThievesCant.name: Thieves' Cant
ThievesCant.def: Criminals use a secret language or dialect.

TongueTwister.name: Tongue Twister
TongueTwister.def: A phrase that is notably difficult to say quickly.

TotallyRadical.name: Totally Radical
TotallyRadical.def: Creators use cheesy slang to appeal to young people, and embarrass themselves as a result.

TranslatedCoverVersion.name: Translated Cover Version
TranslatedCoverVersion.def: A cover of a song sung in a different language.

TranslateTheLoanwordsToo.name: Translate the Loanwords, Too
TranslateTheLoanwordsToo.def: Even words that are NOT in the original language end up getting translated into the target language.

TranslationByVolume.name: Translation by Volume
TranslationByVolume.def: A character tries to make themselves understood to foreigners by simply shouting.

TranslationConvention.name: Translation Convention
TranslationConvention.def: Characters canonically speaking in another language are presented as speaking the language of the audience.

TranslationCorrection.name: Translation Correction
TranslationCorrection.def: When a translation corrects visual errors in the original.

TranslationMatchmaking.name: Translation Matchmaking
TranslationMatchmaking.def: Two unrelated films, through translation, seem related to each other by name.

TranslationPunctuation.name: Translation Punctuation
TranslationPunctuation.def: Using non-standard punctuation to indicate a different language is being spoken in-universe.

TranslationStyleChoices.name: Translation Style Choices
TranslationStyleChoices.def: Cultural differences taken into account when translating a work.

TranslationWithAnAgenda.name: Translation with an Agenda
TranslationWithAnAgenda.def: A work is deliberately mistranslated to adhere to an ideology not present in the original work.

TranslationYes.name: Translation: "Yes"
TranslationYes.def: A long statement made in a foreign language becomes ludicrously brief when translated.

TranslatorMicrobes.name: Translator Microbes
TranslatorMicrobes.def: A magic device translates speech from one language to another.

TrollingTranslator.name: Trolling Translator
TrollingTranslator.def: The translator intentionally mistranslates what the foreign language speaker is saying.

TropeNamesFromOtherLanguages.name: Trope Names from Other Languages
TropeNamesFromOtherLanguages.def: An index of tropes with non-English names.

TropeNamesFromTheFrench.name: Trope Names from the French
TropeNamesFromTheFrench.def: An index of tropes with French names.

TrrrillingRrrs.name: Trrrilling Rrrs
TrrrillingRrrs.def: A character tends to emphasize their Rs.

TwoOfYourEarthMinutes.name: Two of Your Earth Minutes
TwoOfYourEarthMinutes.def: When aliens use planets as descriptors for things that are inherently of that planet anyway.

TwoWordsAddedEmphasis.name: Two Words: Added Emphasis
TwoWordsAddedEmphasis.def: A character says "Two words" or any other number of words and immediately follows it with the two words they intend to use to make their point clear.

TwoWordsICantCount.name: Two Words: I Can't Count
TwoWordsICantCount.def: An attempt at Two Words: Added Emphasis is flubbed when the person gets the number of words wrong.

TyopOnTheCover.name: Tyop on the Cover
TyopOnTheCover.def: A spelling mistake in the title or slogan of the work.

UntranslatedCatchPhrase.name: Untranslated Catchphrase
UntranslatedCatchPhrase.def: Even in foreign translations, a character's distinctive catchphrase remains in the original language.

UnusualDysphemism.name: Unusual Dysphemism
UnusualDysphemism.def: Foul language is used to refer to innocuous things.

UnusualEuphemism.name: Unusual Euphemism
UnusualEuphemism.def: Bizarre words or phrases are used in place of profanity.

VerbalTic.name: Verbal Tic
VerbalTic.def: A character has a specific way they talk, such as adding a specific word at the end of all their sentences.

VerbalTicked.name: Verbal Ticked
VerbalTicked.def: A character with a verbal tic suddenly talks normally.

ViewerPronunciationConfusion.name: Viewer Pronunciation Confusion
ViewerPronunciationConfusion.def: People have trouble pronouncing something even when the official pronunciation is available.

WantonCrueltyToTheCommonComma.name: Wanton Cruelty to the Common Comma

WhatSongWasThisAgain.name: What Song Was This Again?
WhatSongWasThisAgain.def: A dubbed version of a song has completely different lyrics from the original.

WhenIsPurple.name: When Is Purple?
WhenIsPurple.def: Combining the concepts of time, space, and color in a way that makes no sense.

Wingdinglish.name: Wingdinglish
Wingdinglish.def: Characters speak English depicted in an alternative alphabet.

Woolseyism.name: Woolseyism
Woolseyism.def: A translation alters the work's dialogue so it works better in the new language.

WordSaladPhilosophy.name: Word Salad Philosophy
WordSaladPhilosophy.def: A philosophical ramble that is completely nonsensical.

XForException.name: X for Exception
XForException.def: In an alphabetical list, X is represented by a word which does not begin with X.

YiddishAsASecondLanguage.name: Yiddish as a Second Language
YiddishAsASecondLanguage.def: Jewish characters pepper their dialogue with gratuitous Yiddish.

YouAreTheTranslatedForeignWord.name: You Are the Translated Foreign Word
YouAreTheTranslatedForeignWord.def: Immediately following up a foreign terminology with its translation.

YouKeepUsingThatWord.name: You Keep Using That Word
YouKeepUsingThatWord.def: A character uses a word constantly, but it is apparent that they don't know what the word actually means.

YouKnowTheOne.name: You Know the One
YouKnowTheOne.def: Writers deliberately write characters speaking cryptically to keep the audience stumped.

YouSayTomato.name: You Say Tomato
YouSayTomato.def: More than one accepted way to pronounce a term.

GarnishingTheStory.name: Garnishing the Story
GarnishingTheStory.def: The writers just thought including these would help make the story more appealing.

MeaningfulAppearance.name: Meaningful Appearance
MeaningfulAppearance.def: A piece of clothing can be worth a thousand words of Exposition

Spectacle.name: Spectacle
Spectacle.def: The costume department just wanted to show off.

EleventhHourCostumeChange.name: 11th-Hour Costume Change
EleventhHourCostumeChange.def: A character changes their outfit before confronting the big bad or at the end of the story.

ActionFashionista.name: Action Fashionista
ActionFashionista.def: An asskicking character who is also very fashionable.

AdaptationalCostumeChange.name: Adaptational Costume Change
AdaptationalCostumeChange.def: The adaptation significantly changes a character's outfit. Adaptational Modesty : A Stripperific character wears more modest clothing in an adaptation.

AdaptationalSkimpiness.name: Adaptational Skimpiness
AdaptationalSkimpiness.def: A character wears clothing that shows more skin in an adaptation.

AdhesiveBowTie.name: Adhesive Bow Tie
AdhesiveBowTie.def: Bow ties on characters are often depicted as being merely attached to them with no sign of a strap of some sort.

AdventurerOutfit.name: Adventurer Outfit
AdventurerOutfit.def: An outfit normally worn by someone going to an exotic place.

AgeInappropriateDress.name: Age-Inappropriate Dress
AgeInappropriateDress.def: Someone wears clothes that they're typically considered too young or too old to be wearing.

AlternateCostume.name: Alternate Costume
AlternateCostume.def: Characters in a game who have different costumes that alter their appearance.

WardrobeWound.def: Characters act like they have been wounded when their clothes get dirty or damaged.

WearingAFlagOnYourHead.name: Wearing a Flag on Your Head
WearingAFlagOnYourHead.def: Flag designs on clothing, vehicles, and so forth.

WearingItAllWrong.name: Wearing It All Wrong
WearingItAllWrong.def: Someone puts a garment on a body part it was not meant to go on.

WetSariScene.name: Wet Sari Scene
WetSariScene.def: Bollywood-specific trope of wet sari played for fanservice.

WetTShirtContest.name: Wet T-Shirt Contest
WetTShirtContest.def: Contest to determine which (usually female) character looks best in a Sexy Soaked Shirt .

WeWillNotHavePocketsInTheFuture.name: We Will Not Have Pockets in the Future
WeWillNotHavePocketsInTheFuture.def: Futuristic outfits that don't have pockets.

WholeCostumeReference.name: Whole-Costume Reference
WholeCostumeReference.def: A character wears an outfit reminiscent of a similar outfit worn by another character or Real Life person, without explicitly dressing as that character or person.

WTHCostumingDepartment.name: WTH, Costuming Department?
WTHCostumingDepartment.def: A behind-the-scenes costuming choice unintentionally makes a character look outlandish or ridiculous.

Zipperiffic.name: Zipperiffic
Zipperiffic.def: Numerous impractical zippers used to decorate an outfit.

AlternateRainbow.name: Alternate Rainbow
AlternateRainbow.def: An unconventional take on a traditional rainbow.

AmazingTechnicolorWildlife.name: Amazing Technicolor Wildlife
AmazingTechnicolorWildlife.def: Animals who are not colored realistically.

AnimatedWorldHypotheses.name: Animated World Hypotheses
AnimatedWorldHypotheses.def: When animated characters perceive their world as animated, rather than realistic.

Animesque.name: Animesque
Animesque.def: The art style is like an anime.

ArtEvolution.name: Art Evolution
ArtEvolution.def: Character designs gradually change over the years.

ArtShift.name: Art Shift
ArtShift.def: Moments where the art style suddenly changes.

ArtShiftedSequel.name: Art-Shifted Sequel
ArtShiftedSequel.def: The sequel's art style is noticeably different from the art style of the original.

ArtStyleClash.name: Art-Style Clash
ArtStyleClash.def: A work that relies on many different art styles at the same time.

BalloonBelly.name: Balloon Belly
BalloonBelly.def: Overeating causes a character to have a huge, round belly.

BlackBeadEyes.name: Black Bead Eyes
BlackBeadEyes.def: Character's eyes are small and black dots.

ByTheLightsOfTheirEyes.name: By the Lights of Their Eyes
ByTheLightsOfTheirEyes.def: In scenes taking place in the dark, characters are made visible by their eyes.

CartoonDogBreed.name: Cartoon Dog Breed
CartoonDogBreed.def: Dogs drawn so that they don't resemble any breed strongly.

CartoonThrobbing.name: Cartoon Throbbing
CartoonThrobbing.def: A character's body part gets injured, turns red, and starts swelling and expanding.

CheatedAngle.name: Cheated Angle
CheatedAngle.def: A character has part of them always facing the same angle regardless of which direction they're facing.

ComicBookFantasyCasting.name: Comic-Book Fantasy Casting
ComicBookFantasyCasting.def: Character is designed to resemble a real-life actor.

ConjoinedEyes.name: Conjoined Eyes
ConjoinedEyes.def: A character's eyes are drawn in a way that they appear to be fused together instead of being two individual eyes.

DetailHoggingCover.name: Detail-Hogging Cover
DetailHoggingCover.def: The cover has more detail than the actual animation.

DinnerDeformation.name: Dinner Deformation
DinnerDeformation.def: When a character swallows an object, their throat or stomach becomes shaped like what they just swallowed.

DisembodiedEyebrows.name: Disembodied Eyebrows
DisembodiedEyebrows.def: A character's eyebrows aren't attached to their face and float above their eyes.

Disneyesque.name: Disneyesque
Disneyesque.def: The art style is similar to that of Disney movies and shows.

EarlyInstallmentCharacterDesignDifferenc.name: Early Installment Character-Design Difference
EarlyInstallmentCharacterDesignDifferenc.def: A character's earlier appearances have them sporting a character design that is notably different from how they appear in the rest of the series.

ExpressiveMask.name: Expressive Mask
ExpressiveMask.def: Character wears a mask that is somehow still able to register their emotions.

ExpressiveSquiggleMouth.name: Expressive Squiggle Mouth
ExpressiveSquiggleMouth.def: Animated or comic character has a curved zig-zag line for a mouth to indicate strong feelings of nervousness, fear, embarrassment, or happiness.

EyeGlasses.name: Eye Glasses
EyeGlasses.def: A character wears glasses that change shape to match their emotions.

FingerlessHands.name: Fingerless Hands
FingerlessHands.def: A character has hands that lack fingers.

FourLegsGoodTwoLegsBetter.name: Four Legs Good, Two Legs Better

FourthWallPortrait.name: Fourth-Wall Portrait
FourthWallPortrait.def: A cartoon character is given a drawing where they are depicted in a more realistic style.

ImpossibleHourglassFigure.name: Impossible Hourglass Figure
ImpossibleHourglassFigure.def: A woman has unrealistically wide hips in addition to an unrealistically narrow waist.

NonStandardCharacterDesign.name: Non-Standard Character Design
NonStandardCharacterDesign.def: A character stands out from the other characters because the way they are designed differs from the usual art style.

NoodlePeople.name: Noodle People
NoodlePeople.def: Skinny characters with long, thin limbs.

PaintingTheMedium.name: Painting the Medium
PaintingTheMedium.def: Font, interface changes, or camera or editing tricks convey things about the story.

RainbowLite.name: Rainbow Lite
RainbowLite.def: Rainbows without all of the colors of the visible color spectrum.

SidewaysSmile.name: Sideways Smile
SidewaysSmile.def: Face-splitting smiles with obscured eyes viewed from the side profile of a drawn character.

TalkativeCover.name: Talkative Cover
TalkativeCover.def: Descriptive stylized text in a cover art as a part of the graphic design.

TopHeavyGuy.name: Top-Heavy Guy
TopHeavyGuy.def: A character is huge and burly from the waist up, but stringy and spindly from the waist down.

VolumetricMouth.name: Volumetric Mouth
VolumetricMouth.def: Character's mouth opens real wide when they are shouting.

WeightTaller.name: Weight Taller
WeightTaller.def: Gaining extra fat or muscle also increases a character's height.

WhooshInFrontOfTheCamera.name: Whoosh in Front of the Camera

WingdingEyes.name: Wingding Eyes
WingdingEyes.def: Character's eyes change shape to show what's on their mind.

XRaySparks.name: X-Ray Sparks
XRaySparks.def: A character has their skeleton made visible when they are electrocuted.

BigShadowLittleCreature.name: Big Shadow, Little Creature
BigShadowLittleCreature.def: A large, scary shadow turns out to be cast by a much less scary entity.

BrightnessShadows.name: Brightness Shadows
BrightnessShadows.def: Shadows used to show a bright light without actually making things brighter.

Chiaroscuro.name: Chiaroscuro
Chiaroscuro.def: One bright light source leaves everything else in shadow.

HollywoodDarkness.name: Hollywood Darkness
HollywoodDarkness.def: Darkness that isn't actually fully dark.

LightningReveal.name: Lightning Reveal
LightningReveal.def: A flash of light from a lightning strike reveals something that was hidden by darkness.

LightswitchSurprise.name: Lightswitch Surprise
LightswitchSurprise.def: Turning on the lights reveals something surprising that was hidden by darkness.

LipLockSunBlock.name: Lip-Lock Sun-Block
LipLockSunBlock.def: Two characters kiss in front of the sun, blocking the light.

MuzzleFlashlight.name: Muzzle Flashlight
MuzzleFlashlight.def: Using the firing of a gun as a light source.

NaturalSpotlight.name: Natural Spotlight
NaturalSpotlight.def: A ray of sunlight shining on something to highlight its importance.

ScaryFlashlightFace.name: Scary Flashlight Face
ScaryFlashlightFace.def: Holding a flashlight under one's chin to look scary.

ScrewTheElectricBill.name: Screw the Electric Bill
ScrewTheElectricBill.def: In fiction, a room's lights are already turned on when the characters enter.

AlienBlood.name: Alien Blood
AlienBlood.def: A character bleeds a strangely colored substance that isn't the red blood of humans, usually to either reveal or emphasize that the character isn't actually human.

AllYourColorsCombined.name: All Your Colors Combined
AllYourColorsCombined.def: A color-scheme team combines their forces into an amazing blast of rainbow-colored power.

AmazingTechnicolorBattlefield.name: Amazing Technicolor Battlefield
AmazingTechnicolorBattlefield.def: A video game level that is trippy as trippy can be.

BrightIsNotGood.name: Bright Is Not Good
BrightIsNotGood.def: Just because something comes in bright colors doesn't mean that it's good.

CaptainColorbeard.name: Captain Colorbeard
CaptainColorbeard.def: Pirate with a name of (Insert something here)-Beard.

CardinalGemConnection.name: Cardinal Gem Connection
CardinalGemConnection.def: Rubies, sapphires, emeralds, or diamonds are used to represent a set of hues.

ColorCharacter.name: Color Character
ColorCharacter.def: Part of a superhero's title is a color.

ColorCodedCharacters.name: Color-Coded Characters
ColorCodedCharacters.def: Each character has their assigned color. Chromatic Arrangement : Three to four characters are assigned three to four primary colors.

ChromaticCounterpart.name: Chromatic Counterpart
ChromaticCounterpart.def: An identical doppelgänger is assigned the opposite color of the real one.

ColorCodedSecretIdentity.name: Color-Coded Secret Identity
ColorCodedSecretIdentity.def: Someone's everyday civilian clothes just so happen to be the same color(s) as their superhero costume.

RainbowMotif.name: Rainbow Motif
RainbowMotif.def: The seven colors of the rainbow as a motif.

ColorCodedElements.name: Color-Coded Elements
ColorCodedElements.def: Fire is red, water is blue, earth is green... the list goes on.

ColorCodedMultiplayer.name: Color-Coded Multiplayer
ColorCodedMultiplayer.def: A video game with a multiplayer option has the players in different colors.

ColorCodedStones.name: Color-Coded Stones
ColorCodedStones.def: Gems can come in many colors, but this applies when they're assigned set hues.

ColorContrast.name: Color Contrast
ColorContrast.def: Two opposing things have two opposing colors.

ColorFailure.name: Color Failure
ColorFailure.def: Someone is so shocked all the color drains from them. Literally.

ColorfulContrails.name: Colorful Contrails
ColorfulContrails.def: A person or object running at high speed leaves behind a trail of color.

ColoringInTheWorld.name: Coloring in the World
ColoringInTheWorld.def: The narrative involves actively bringing or restoring color to a colorless setting.

Colorization.name: Colorization
Colorization.def: Manually adding color to what was originally made in monochrome.

ColorMotif.name: Color Motif
ColorMotif.def: A recurring color or color scheme within a work, often with symbolic meaning.

ColorWash.name: Color Wash
ColorWash.def: A visual effect to make everything take a similar hue to evoke a certain feeling.

ColourCodedForYourConvenience.name: Colour-Coded for Your Convenience
ColourCodedForYourConvenience.def: Colors are used to denote something.

DecadeThemedFilter.name: Decade-Themed Filter
DecadeThemedFilter.def: Different time periods have their own colors, filters, effects, etc.

DeliberatelyMonochrome.name: Deliberately Monochrome
DeliberatelyMonochrome.def: There's a reason why everything is black-and-white. Alternate Monochrome Version : There's a reason for why this already-colored work is now black-and-white.

SplashOfColor.name: Splash of Color
SplashOfColor.def: In a black-and-white expanse, something important is given color.

EyeColourChange.name: Eye Colour Change
EyeColourChange.def: A character's eyes change color in response to something, either literally or symbolically.

TechnicolorEyes.name: Technicolor Eyes
TechnicolorEyes.def: Eye color(s) that are physically impossible and simply unusual. Curtains Match the Window : When eyes and hair are the same color.

GlowingEyesOfDoom.name: Glowing Eyes of Doom
GlowingEyesOfDoom.def: If someone's eyes start glowing, it's time to start running.

HellishPupils.name: Hellish Pupils
HellishPupils.def: When someone's pupils become anything but round, bad things are to follow.

FictionalColour.name: Fictional Colour
FictionalColour.def: A color appears in a work that doesn't exist in real life.

GoodColorsEvilColors.name: Good Colors, Evil Colors
GoodColorsEvilColors.def: The good guys are one color, and the bad guys are another.

HadesShaded.name: Hades Shaded
HadesShaded.def: Once you go to the dark side, every color on you follows.

HollywoodChameleons.name: Hollywood Chameleons
HollywoodChameleons.def: Fictional chameleons have amazing color-changing abilities.

InconsistentColoring.name: Inconsistent Coloring
InconsistentColoring.def: A visual mistake — something's color completely changes the next time the thing is seen.

LawOfChromaticSuperiority.name: Law of Chromatic Superiority
LawOfChromaticSuperiority.def: Different colors denote different levels of quality.

MonochromaticImpactShot.name: Monochromatic Impact Shot
MonochromaticImpactShot.def: Use of Deliberate Monochrome on a heavy impact.

MonochromeToColor.name: Monochrome to Color
MonochromeToColor.def: Everything goes from black-and-white to color, color everywhere!

MutedMundanity.name: Muted Mundanity
MutedMundanity.def: Desaturated and muted ColorMotifs used to represent dullness and reality.

PaletteSwap.name: Palette Swap
PaletteSwap.def: Two sprites in a video game look exactly alike, save for their colors. Palette-Swapped Alien Food : Alien food looks like oddly colored human food.

UndergroundMonkey.name: Underground Monkey
UndergroundMonkey.def: When a video game only has one kind of enemy, but it comes in many versions.

ParanormalPalette.name: Paranormal Palette
ParanormalPalette.def: Color Motifs used to represent or symbolize the paranormal and supernatural.

PatternCodedEggs.name: Pattern-Coded Eggs
PatternCodedEggs.def: A fictional animal's egg matches the color and pattern of the animal inside it.

PowerUpFullColorChange.name: Power-Up Full Color Change
PowerUpFullColorChange.def: Unlocking great powers means a character gets a new palette to go with it.

PrimaryColorChampion.name: Primary-Color Champion
PrimaryColorChampion.def: Red and blue (and maybe yellow) are the colors of heroes.

QueerColors.name: Queer Colors
QueerColors.def: An LGBTQ character is symbolized by pride flag colors.

SecondaryColorNemesis.name: Secondary-Color Nemesis
SecondaryColorNemesis.def: As a flipside to the heroes' primary colors, villains come in hues of green, purple, and orange.

ShadesOfSuffocation.name: Shades of Suffocation
ShadesOfSuffocation.def: A lack of oxygen can make you turn a shade of red or blue.

SinglePaletteTown.name: Single-Palette Town
SinglePaletteTown.def: A place where everything is the same color.

TechnicolorBlade.name: Technicolor Blade
TechnicolorBlade.def: Metal blades that come in unique colors.

TechnicolorFire.name: Technicolor Fire
TechnicolorFire.def: Fire with lots of different colors.

TechnicolorScience.name: Technicolor Science
TechnicolorScience.def: Science looks "cooler" when all the chemicals and reactions are bright and neon.

TechnicolorToxin.name: Technicolor Toxin
TechnicolorToxin.def: Poison is as vivid as it is deadly (with purple and green being common colors for it).

TechnicolorWind.name: Technicolor Wind
TechnicolorWind.def: Wind with lots of different colors.

UndeathlyPallor.name: Undeathly Pallor
UndeathlyPallor.def: An undead character is pure white, pale blue, etc.

WorldOfTechnicolorHair.name: World of Technicolor Hair
WorldOfTechnicolorHair.def: A setting where having hair in all colors of the rainbow is the norm, as opposed to the human spectrum of blonde, red, and black/brown.
